{"lines":[{"lineId":"1780","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正月寅為月建，寅木旺，卯木次之。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575893708836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1781","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二月。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575893725220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1782","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯為月建，卯木旺，寅木次之。","logicSentenceId":"7633451613210198026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1783","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正二月木為旺，火為相，其餘金、水𡈽倶作休囚。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575893741604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1784","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三月，辰為月建，辰𡈽旺，丑未之土次之，金頼𡈽生，金為相，木雖不旺，還有餘氣，其餘俱作休囚。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575893757988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1785","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四月，巳為月令，巳火旺，午火次之。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575893774372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1786","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五月，午為月建，午火旺，巳火次之，","logicSentenceId":"7586682575893790756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1787","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561236263764020"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1788","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四、五月火旺𡈽相，其餘俱作休囚。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575893790756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1789","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六月，未為月建，未𡈽旺，辰戌之𡈽次之，𡈽生金，金為相，火雖衰矣，亦有餘氣存焉，其餘俱作休囚。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575893807140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1790","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七月，申為月建，申金旺，酉金次之。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575893823524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1791","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八月，酉為月建，酉金旺，申金次之。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575893839908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1792","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七、八月金旺生水，水為相，其餘俱作休因。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575893856292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1793","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九月戌為月令，戌𡈽旺，丑未之𡈽次之，𡈽生金，金為相，其餘俱作休因。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575893872676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1794","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十月，亥為月建，亥水旺，子水次之。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575893889060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1795","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561236263780404"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1796","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十一月，子為月建，子水旺，亥水次之。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575893905444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1797","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十月、十一月水生木，木為相，其餘俱以衰論。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575893921828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1798","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十二月，丑為月建，丑𡈽相，辰戌之𡈽次之，𡈽生金，金為相，水雖衰矣，猶有餘氣，其餘俱作休囚。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575893938212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1799","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月将章第十六月将卽是月建，又為月令，掌一月之權，司三旬之令，一月三十日内，當權淂令，操持萬卜之提綱，巡察六爻之善惡，能助卦爻之衰","logicSentenceId":"7586682575893954596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1800","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561236263796788"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1801","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"弱，能挫爻象之強旺，制伏動變之爻，扶起飛伏之用。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575893954596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1802","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月将乃當權之主帥，萬卜以之為綱領。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575893970980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1803","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻之衰弱者，能生之、合之、比之、拱之、扶之，衰而","logicSentenceId":"7586682575893987364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1804","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦旺。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575893987364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1805","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻之強旺者，能冲之、尅之、刑之、破之，旺而亦衰。","logicSentenceId":"7633451613210214410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1806","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦有變爻尅制動爻者，月建能制服變爻。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575894003748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1807","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦有動爻尅制静爻者，亦能制服動爻。","logicSentenceId":"7633451613210230794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1808","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用神伏蔵，被飛神壓住者，月建能冲尅飛神，生助伏神而為用也。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575894020132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1809","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻逢月合而有用，爻逢月破而無㓛。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575894036516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1810","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561236263813172"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1811","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月建合爻，則為月合，乃有用之爻也。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575894052900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1812","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月冲之爻，卽為月破，無用之爻也。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575894069284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1813","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月建不入爻，亦為有用。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575894085668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1814","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月建一入卦，愈見剛强。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575894102052","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1815","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦無用神，卽以月建為用神，不必得㐲神也。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575894118436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1816","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月建入卦，動而作元神者為福更大。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575894134820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1817","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動而作忌神者為禍更深。","logicSentenceId":"7633451613210247178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1818","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不入卦者，缓之。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575894151204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1819","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻值月建，旺相當權，逢空不空，逢傷無害，古有此説，予試不然，在旬内者，畢竟為空。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575894167588","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1820","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如寅月庚戌日占丶應","logicSentenceId":"7586682575894183972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1821","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" 之空。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575894282276","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1833","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢傷亦傷，却有待時之用。","logicSentenceId":"7633451613210263562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1834","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𠩄以用神逢空，𫢈卽指為不变，畢竟為空。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575894298660","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1835","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但此空者，乃目下旬内之空也，待至出空之日，則不空矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575894315044","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1836","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561236263845940"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1837","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"作忌神者，出而為禍，作元神者，出而為福，非比休囚之真空，到底而為空也。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575894331428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

tenceId":"7586682575894626340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1887","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果于本年下獄，至申年被重刑。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575894642724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1888","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大象𠮷者，從斯而恭。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575894659108","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1889","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大象凶者，出月𮞸屯。","logicSentenceId":"7633451613210312714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1890","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561236263911476"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1891","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅少生多者，大象𠮷也。","logicSentenceId":"7586682576207609898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1892","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅多生少者，大象凶也。","logicSentenceId":"7633451613210329098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1893","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大象雖凶，在月内還許不碍，出此月而受其殃。","logicSentenceId":"7586682576207626282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1894","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用神遇之，淂福不輕，忌神逢之，淂𥙯不淺。","logicSentenceId":"7586682576207642666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1895","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此言用神臨月建，並無他爻以傷尅者，凡占皆𡉅。","logicSentenceId":"7586682576207659050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1896","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌神臨月建，而用神休囚無救者，諸占大㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7586682576207675434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1897","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生扶忌神，乃𦔳惡而為虐；尅制元神，乃邀路而截糧。","logicSentenceId":"7586682576207691818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1898","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌神尅害用神，得月建尅制忌神者，名為有救。","logicSentenceId":"7586682576207708202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1899","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若月建反生忌神者，助惡而為虐也。","logicSentenceId":"7633451613210345482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1900","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如用神淂元神之生，月建，又生元神，𠮷而又𠮷。","logicSentenceId":"7586682576207724586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1901","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘","logicSentenceId":"7586682576207740970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1902","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561236263927860"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1903","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月建若尅制元神者，如梟神以奪食也。","logicSentenceId":"7586682576207740970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1957","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"李我平曰：諸書皆以月将當權，逢空不空，遇傷無害，此書以増尅制，空亦為空，傷亦為傷，明徹之極，實可","logicSentenceId":"7586682576208183338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1958","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561236263993396"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1959","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"為法。","logicSentenceId":"7586682576208183338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1960","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易冒以日尅月生，淂生之八，月尅日生，淂生之七，七分八分，何以决疑？","logicSentenceId":"7586682576208199722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1961","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽如此章𠩄存占驗，占產，不","logicSentenceId":"7586682576208216106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1962","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"增尅制，危而卽安，占痘疂見逢傷，命之不保，一死一生，七分耶，八分耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586682576208216106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1963","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日辰章第十七子水、丑𡈽、寅木、卯木、辰土、巳火、午火、","logicSentenceId":"7586682576208248874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1964","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"未土，申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1965","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金、酉金、戌土、亥水。","logicSentenceId":"7586682576208248874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1966","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日辰卽本日之曰辰，又為日建。","logicSentenceId":"7586682576208265258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1967","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日辰為六爻之主宰，司四時之旺相。","logicSentenceId":"7586682576208281642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1968","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561236264009780"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1969","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前章月令司三旬之令，令扵春則生，令扵秋則殺，春夏秋冬，各令其時，獨日辰不然，四旺俱旺，操生殺之權，與月建同㓛。","logicSentenceId":"7586682576208298026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1970","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冲旺相之静爻，卽為暗動；冲衰弱之静爻，則為曰破。","logicSentenceId":"7586682576208314410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1971","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻之旺而静者，冲之，則為暗動，愈淂其力。","logicSentenceId":"7586682576208330794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1972","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻之静而衰者，冲之，則為日跛，愈加無用。","logicSentenceId":"7633451613210460170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1973","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冲空卽起，冲合卽開。","logicSentenceId":"7586682576208347178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1974","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻之衰弱，能生扶拱合，如時雨以滋苗。","logicSentenceId":"7586682576208363562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1975","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻之强旺，能尅害刑冲，似秋霜之殺草。","logicSentenceId":"7633451613210476554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{" {"lines":[{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸書無不以青龍為吉，白虎為凶。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082383556650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天元賦曰：身旺龍持多喜慶。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082383573034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"碎金賦曰：龍動家有喜，虎動家有喪。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082383589418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卜","logicSentenceId":"7586699082383605802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"筮元龜曰：螣蛇、白虎憂尊長。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082383605802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卜筮大全曰：畏𠼫刀之白乕，喜戲水之青龍。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082383622186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"阐奥章：占疾病，螣蛇主𢀸，白乕主丧。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082383638570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此皆不以五行，竟以六神而斷生死。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082383654954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103368527935"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟千金賦曰：𧆞興而遇𠮷神，不害其𠮷；龍動而逢凶曜，難掩其凶。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082383671338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此正理也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082383687722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然則六神而不騐耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586699082383704106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"非也，乃附和之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082383720490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦之吉者，逢青龍而更𠮷；卦之凶者，逢虎蛇而更凶。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082383736874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且元武主盗賊，朱雀主是非，無不騐也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082383753258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至於家宅墳塋，不可少也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082383769642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相合之法有六：日月合爻，一也；爻與爻合，二也；","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384015402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103368593471"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻動化合者，三也；卦逢六合，四也；六冲卦变六合，五也；","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384015402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六合卦變六合，六也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384015402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日月合爻者，假令丑月占淂坎卦，世爻子水與月建作合是也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384048170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻與爻合者，假令占淂天地否卦，世應二爻俱動，卯與戌合是也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384064554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但有一爻不動，亦不為合。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384080938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻動化合者，假令占淂天風姤卦，世爻丑動，化岀子水作合是也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384097322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦逢六合者，卽如天地否卦，内外六爻自相和合","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384113706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103368609855"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是也，不動亦是。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384113706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六冲","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384130090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦變六合者，假令占淂乾為天，乃是八纯六冲卦，若外卦三爻俱動，乃是乾之泰卦，謂之六冲而變六合是也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384130090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六合卦變六合者，即如占淂旅卦變賁卦是也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384162858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻之合者，静而逢合，謂之合起；動而逢合，謂之合绊。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384179242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻與爻合，謂之合好；爻謂動化合，謂之化扶。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384195626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻静或與日月動爻合者，淂合而起，卽使爻值休囚，亦有旺相之意。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384212010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103368626239"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻動或與日月動爻合者，謂之動逢合而绊住，反不能動之意。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384228394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻動與動爻相合，乃淂他来合我，與我和好相助之意。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384244778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻動化出之爻，回頭相合者，謂之化扶，得他扶助之意。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384261162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡得諸合，諸占皆以為𠮷。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384277546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占名名成，占利利就，占婚必成。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384293930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占身發積，占宅興旺，占風水聚氣蔵風，占求謀遂心合意。","logicSentenceId":"7630458295338598400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然必用神有氣，相冝；用若失䧟，無益。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384310314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103368642623"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卜","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384326698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"書曰：萬事欣喜三六合，諸事必得久逺，有始有終。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384326698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但冝𠮷事逢之，事之必就，不冝凶事逢之，事之難结。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384343082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1jnua2/1-7630139190755835940_QQ_1776530679466.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=PuvqlSUqibUDh5Hm4Eq1U7eHrqk%3D","pictureHeight":484,"pictureWidth":216,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1jnua2/1-7630139190755835940_QQ_1776530679466.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=pl%2FrihPb9PPQqX10z9ybKJNnMgk%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1jnua2/1-7630139190755835940_QQ_1776530679466.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如丑月戊申日占歲考，得坎之困卦，斷曰：“丗爻子水，丑月合之，申日作父母而生世，卦中申金又動，又是六冲變六合，卦之全美，上卷無","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384359466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103368659007"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"疑。”","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384359466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果考一等，卽于子科髙發。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384375850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後探之變試，考過四等，所以卦得六冲變合，先否後泰之象。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384392234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如戌月丁卯日占说事，淂𣳾卦。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384408618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉亥丑辰寅子。","logicSentenceId":"7630458295338614784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：雖係爻逢六合，不冝戊月冲世，卯日尅世，而應爻暗動，月建生之，彼之淂志，官事必輪，果被杖責。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384425002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯木尅世之故耳。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384441386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用神受尅，六合亦無益矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384457770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所以危淂諸合。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384474154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若世爻失陷，難以吉斷。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384490538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1jo6x6/1-7630135667918176271_QQ_1776530762805.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=RPu2je6YSThbjnM%2FaXfAiTo9cbQ%3D","pictureHeight":460,"pictureWidth":152,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1jo6x6/1-7630135667918176271_QQ_1776530762805.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=aUDqlpDcep%2FxTJ0XfqqNFw8lPBg%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1jo6x6/1-7630135667918176271_QQ_1776530762805.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如申月丙子日","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384506922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103368675391"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占出行，浔明𢑱之小過。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384506922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世動被子日合住，必有事绊，不能動身。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384523306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伊曰：因何而阻？","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384539690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余曰：卦中子動變鬼，防児女少安。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384556074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：正因小女多病，男家催促成婚，今欲徃外求取，以俻装奩。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384572458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：所淂何病？","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384588842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：血枯成勞。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384605226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：卯木子孫，申日绝之，子日刑之，且又動而變鬼，遮嫁之不及矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384621610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384637994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因病沈，此人未去，女𢀸辰日。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384637994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫應不去者，世動而逢合也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384654378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女死辰曰者，卯木子孫變辰土鬼之","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384670762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103368691775"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故耳。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384670762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以上乃爻之遇合，卦逢以合之騐也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384687146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1jow7e/1-7630141802776264739_QQ_1776531013739.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=kiGw6EMDQqHVjmUZQNfOErh1lKU%3D","pictureHeight":496,"pictureWidth":146,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1jow7e/1-7630141802776264739_QQ_1776531013739.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=3qeciif8WNPNZ%2F4%2FwTWWFCZQ0Mc%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1jow7e/1-7630141802776264739_QQ_1776531013739.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予又騐其二冲卦變六合者，如未月丁巳日占己悔婚還可成否，","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384703530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得離卦變火山旅。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384703530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷曰：此卦從来難以𠮷斷，因淂屢騐。","logicSentenceId":"7630458295338631168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六冲變合，散","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384736298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而復聚，離而必合，此婚一㝎還成。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384736298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵次年三月仍復成婚。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384769066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1jp8ui/1-7630129687902601268_QQ_1776531201163.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=oSOWpij%2FUn%2B5HnuIHhLeO%2B%2BAO2E%3D","pictureHeight":498,"pictureWidth":202,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1jp8ui/1-7630129687902601268_QQ_1776531201163.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=fOUmjczPVO%2FI35Y9w0R7BGqOtf0%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1jp8ui/1-7630129687902601268_QQ_1776531201163.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103368708159"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸合皆以用神旺相為𠮷，獨此六冲卦變六合者，不看用神，竟以𠮷斷。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384785450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占婚姻，先吳越而後朱陳","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384801834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"；占夫妻，占叁啇後必合好","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384801834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"；占功名，始則艱難，终湏榮顕","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384801834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"；占求謀，先難後易；占身命，先困後亨","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384801834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"；占風水，巧𠁅奇逢；占家宅，先頽浚盛，曽目妻陥賊營，終湏會合；田園賣出，仍舊歸来。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384801834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六合卦變六合，爻逢六合，已為吉兆；動而又","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384883754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/3/ref/1le3cy4t8ur03/1-1757568783125.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=ERlOHkRm9LeNeysRI%2BpeOdCzB7Q%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/3/ref/1le3cy4t8ur03/1-1757568783125.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":"7548695621986729993"},"logicSentenceId":"7586699082384883754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六合，謂始终而作合也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384883754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103368724543"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占風水，百代簪纓；占家宅，千秋基業；占婚姻，白頭相守；占夥計，管飽雷陳；占功名，仕路亨通；占財帛，聚積如山；占弟兄，累世同居；占學藝，始終成就；占修錬，指日丹成。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384900138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸占用神旺臨日月者，𠮷之而又𠮷也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384916522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟占訟獄不利，冤仇難解，及占憂疑恠事，终不𫔭心。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384932906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占孕，胎安；占產，難生。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384949290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再若用神受尅，更為凶兆。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384965674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1jplhm/1-7630144767716474895_QQ_1776531610278.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=dh%2FevtESV0eggm%2B8PDQkw3TmZ2A%3D","pictureHeight":494,"pictureWidth":142,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1jplhm/1-7630144767716474895_QQ_1776531610278.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=2gBZAvYzflk5bFWWuW7Cpyu8yz8%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1jplhm/1-7630144767716474895_QQ_1776531610278.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如卯月甲寅日占風水，得困之節。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082384982058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103368740927"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余曰：占祖茔必有其故。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082385014826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自𦵏浚，何事不亨？","logicSentenceId":"7586699082385031210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今日之念，因何而问？","logicSentenceId":"7586699082385047594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明以告我，方敢决断。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082385063978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：自𦵏浚功名，因被論而歸，年近五旬，尚無子息，是以问之。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082385080362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因此茔之碍否？","logicSentenceId":"7586699082385096746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：龙自右脉而来，水亦従左而逺，源流水不歸漕之故耳。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082385113130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：何以知之？","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022221865","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：亥水子孫化申金生之，申為源流，寅日冲散，若能使水歸漕，不至傍流者，明年起用，再拜丹墀，申季㝎生麟","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022238249","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103368757311"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"種。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022238249","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼问：久逺否？","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022254633","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：六合化六合，萬載安然。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022271017","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1jpy4q/1-7630138713184534563_QQ_1776531704030.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=rfFR39QtInit1jA6aREtCehGY1U%3D","pictureHeight":476,"pictureWidth":140,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1jpy4q/1-7630138713184534563_QQ_1776531704030.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=9RaNsnOXlMkB1%2F1CurJaa6vh5s0%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1jpy4q/1-7630138713184534563_QQ_1776531704030.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古法子與丑合，丑中有土，土尅子水，謂之合中帶尅，尅三合七。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022287401","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳與申合，巳火尅申金，謂之尅七合三，皆非通論。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022303785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余得騐者，子丑作合，若于辰戌丑未月日占之，而子水並無他𠁅生扶者，言尅不言合也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022320169","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若有生扶，仍作合看，所以子水逢丑月，戌土遇卯月，申金逢巳月，再遇日建動爻","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022336553","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅者，尅之而又尅也，豈言合耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022336553","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103368773695"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅七合三，尅三合七，来人問其凶吉，若以三七而荅之，何以决人之疑？","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022369321","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1jqaru/1-7630144559414673458_QQ_1776531964118.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=BLWdNeb0vLMcddIk%2BigOrHEF7SA%3D","pictureHeight":462,"pictureWidth":208,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1jqaru/1-7630144559414673458_QQ_1776531964118.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=Y1qWUn6Mny5aW64vVj4MZ4d2Y2k%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1jqaru/1-7630144559414673458_QQ_1776531964118.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如丑月庚辰日占子病，淂剥卦。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022385705","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子水子孫，與月建作合，卦無生扶，言尅不言合也。","logicSentenceId":"7630458295338647552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又加日辰尅制，辰日又冲動戍上，以尅子水，只恐難過辰時。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022402089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼因生過九子，俱係伍𢀸，心疼之甚，卽将此子令乳，每抱卧于大廳之上，請諸親顯爵者","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022418473","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103368790079"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而圍逺之，圍至辰時，而乳母哭矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022418473","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此乃合中遇尅，病之不救，豈可謂之尅三合七邪？","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022434857","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又有三合者，申子辰合成水局，己酉丑合成金局，寅午戍合成火局，亥卯未合成木高。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022451241","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此三合者有四：一卦之内，有三爻動而合局者，一也；若两爻動，一爻不動，亦成合局，二也；","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022467625","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有内卦初爻三文動，動而變出之爻成三合者，三也；","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022467625","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103368806463"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又有外卦四爻六文動，動而變出之爻成三合者，四也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022467625","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然此三合局者，有凶有吉。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022516777","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如占功名，合成官局，謂之官𦔽；合成財局，財旺生官；倘合成子孫局者，乃傷官之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022533161","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如占求財，合成財局者，謂之財庫；合成子孫局者，謂之子局生財。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022549545","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘若合成兄弟局者，乃破敗耗財，阻隔之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022565929","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如占祖塋家宅，冝父母爻而合局。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022582313","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103368822847"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如占婚姻夫婦，冝財官旺而合局。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022598697","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占久逺喜慶之事，冝于成局，永逺堅牢。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022615081","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若占官訟，憂疑而合局者，终身錮结，其心難于消釋。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022631465","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但三合其局者，必要世爻在局内為羙，若不在于局内，湏要局生世爻為𠮷，髙尅世者為凶。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022647849","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日建、月建，但有一而在局中，謂之局旺，更𠮷。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022664233","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三爻若有两爻動，不成其局，湏待浚之日月補凑合成其局，謂之虚一待用。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022680617","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一爻明動，一爻晴動，亦作两爻動。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022697001","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103368839231"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三合局中有一空破者，待填實之月日成之；有一爻入墓者，待冲開之日成之。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022713385","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡淂三合，名利、婚姻、家宅、風水、用神旺者，無不為𠮷。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022729769","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必要世爻在局内為羙。","logicSentenceId":"7630458295338663936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若不在于局内，湏要局生世爻為吉，局尅世者為凶。","logicSentenceId":"7630458295338680320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如占㓛名，三合官局而生世者利于我；如生應爻利于他。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022746153","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如占財，財局生世利于我，財局生應利于他。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022762537","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占出行，用神在三合之内，被合而留。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022778921","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103368855615"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占行人，用神在三合之內，被合不囬。","logicSentenceId":"7630458295338696704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又有内卦外卦而成三合者，湏分内外。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022795305","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如占家宅，若居外宅，不冝外卦尅内；若居内宅，湏冝内卦生外。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022811689","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如占彼此之形者，内卦為我，外卦為他，外卦合局而生内卦者為𠮷，尅内卦者為𠮷。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022828073","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1jqney/1-7630143165554556970_QQ_1776532318323.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=izUM6aE5RX1%2BGOcWFzzhv7b3TaE%3D","pictureHeight":464,"pictureWidth":206,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1jqney/1-7630143165554556970_QQ_1776532318323.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=dKNPajyBaKQNcE9fqITDVykJvhY%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1jqney/1-7630143165554556970_QQ_1776532318323.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如卯月丁巳日，上下两村因争田水厮打，淂離之坤。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022844457","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103368871999"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：内卦為我村，亥卯未合成木局，外卦為外村，己酉丑合成金局，金来尅木，幸衰金不尅旺木，不𠯁畏也。","logicSentenceId":"7630458295338713088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"况係六冲卦變六冲，有人解散，必不成非。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022860841","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後果𭄿散。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022877225","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或问：彼此之勢，必以世應為主，如何不言世應？","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022893609","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：若無内外合局者，湏看世應。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022909993","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今彼此两村，卽内外两卦，人衆同心，彼此合局，神之妙用，靈騐顯然，故棄世應而不用也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022926377","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若非卦化六冲，未有不成非也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022942761","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1jr022/1-7630143237416108067_QQ_1776532417182.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=ZpQm5GFf%2Bv5sdc67FBERqZaUBFQ%3D","pictureHeight":468,"pictureWidth":74,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1jr022/1-7630143237416108067_QQ_1776532417182.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=hRZk6iCHnO20Rlq%2Bje0bOA1NePU%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1jr022/1-7630143237416108067_QQ_1776532417182.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如巳月丁酉日","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022959145","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103368888383"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占功名，淂乾卦變水天需。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022959145","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此公向蒙大部，考過才能第一，後因他故而未淂用。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022975529","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今有選才能之缺，意欲逓呈，又因督勦之官与討才能，随營補用，故不敢逓。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326022991913","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：爾","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023008297","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己禱告，指此缺而问神，神許之，而必淂旺官生世，再無他去之理。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023008297","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只因寅午戌三合官局，内少寅字，湏待寅日具呈，管許必得此缺。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023041065","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果于寅日逓呈，特简題用。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023057449","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此應虚一以待用也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023073833","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1srtvu/1-7630146082987442239_QQ_1776532589606.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=xH6%2BszflddQN0mJnwbY%2FbaGm3cg%3D","pictureHeight":466,"pictureWidth":208,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1srtvu/1-7630146082987442239_QQ_1776532589606.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=zIwmD0iZHjct4OfY2SYuqSK7WXs%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1srtvu/1-7630146082987442239_QQ_1776532589606.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103368904767"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如寅月丙辰日占選期，淂乾之小畜。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023090217","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：此卦以古法㫁之，午火官星一爻襡發，當計午","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023106601","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023106601","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若以動而逢合，必待冲𫔭，許子丑之月。","logicSentenceId":"7630461354230415360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今予不以此㫁，午火明動，戊爻暗動，三合而少寅字，借月建以成三合。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023122985","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本月天選，果于本月還扵闽中。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023139369","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫應遷于闽者，世動于六爻，又是官臨午火之故耳。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023155753","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此乃明動晴動合成局也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023172137","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1ss6iy/1-7630139573486682147_QQ_1776532713991.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=2tRp5w%2BU5OGUzu%2FsR6umE13bef4%3D","pictureHeight":472,"pictureWidth":204,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1ss6iy/1-7630139573486682147_QQ_1776532713991.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=uKyxF5jjanE0Gazu8R93q2xiXA8%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1ss6iy/1-7630139573486682147_QQ_1776532713991.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103368921151"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如辰月丁亥日占辨復，淂萃之","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023188521","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/3/ref/1le3cy4t8vgab/1-1757570042771.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=LhtWzBc3iWV2%2ByUhtQPVNH5KCU8%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/3/ref/1le3cy4t8vgab/1-1757570042771.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":"7548704648900411407"},"logicSentenceId":"7586699326023188521","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023188521","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内卦亥卯未合成財局，生世爻巳火之官，世爻巳火，馹馬加臨，亥日冲之而暗動，莫惜所費。","logicSentenceId":"7630461354230431744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未月㝎蒙題允，卽淂羙缺。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023204905","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後至未月，果遂題復，淂補楚中。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023221289","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應未月者，乃實空之月也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023237673","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103368937535"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"六冲章第二十","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023254057","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子午相冲，丑未相冲，寅申相冲，卯酉相冲，辰戌相冲，巳酸相冲。","logicSentenceId":"7630461354230448128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相冲之法有六","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023270441","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"：日月冲爻者，一也；卦逢六冲，二也；六合卦變六冲，三也；","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023270441","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六冲變六冲，四也；動爻變中，五也；","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023270441","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻與爻冲，六也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023270441","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冲者，散也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023335977","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占凶事，冝于冲散，占𠮷事而不冝，亦必無用神而言。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023352361","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用神旺，雖冲不碍；用神失𨺻，凶而","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023368745","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103368953919"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又凶。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023368745","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六合卦變六冲者，用神若旺，始𠮷終凶，圖事雖成，有始而無終也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023385129","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻冲有五","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023401513","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"：爻遇月冲，為月破；爻遇日冲，為晴動；休囚而遇日冲，謂之日破；","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023401513","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動爻自化回頭冲，如逢仇敵；爻與爻冲，謂之相擊。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023401513","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1ssj62/1-7630157310221320234_QQ_1776536415291.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=hIxohvKNWaUdlAbwngjpx7sT%2FpU%3D","pictureHeight":490,"pictureWidth":216,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1ssj62/1-7630157310221320234_QQ_1776536415291.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=xjMGpSjxxnSpmeuSUcpp0ol24as%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1ssj62/1-7630157310221320234_QQ_1776536415291.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如亥月壬子日占子遇害否，淂雷天大壮變地天泰。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023450665","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103368970303"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此人之子，闻傳言被人辱罵，趕去厮他。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023483433","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其父卜之，余曰：六冲變六合，必有人勸解。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023499817","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父爻持世而尅子，乃甭之責子也，不受他人之害。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023516201","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"少刻，果有人請去論理，其子理𮓩，父執棍而撃之，六被勸住，其父與子向衆賠禮而囬。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023532585","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然厮打不成者，乃六冲之變合也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023548969","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父撃子而被𭄿者，乃因日辰子水冲尅世爻，不能以撃子也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023565353","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"他書最重者，動而逢冲曰散。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023581737","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"散猶空也，如全無之象，縦有生扶，不可救也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023598121","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103368986687"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：此卦午火世動，冬令休囚之極，動遇子日冲之，何甞見散？","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023614505","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何甞全無？","logicSentenceId":"7630461354230464512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻發動，身巳動矣；父動尅子，巳撃子矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023630889","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予常論之，神兆機于動，動則必騐，只看旺衰以言重輕，不可以散而如無也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023647273","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1ssvt6/1-7630165779740934198_QQ_1776536535002.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=2i63D%2FqGMmRouWUAHSxDaXOeYKg%3D","pictureHeight":484,"pictureWidth":210,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1ssvt6/1-7630165779740934198_QQ_1776536535002.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=AgD1jzP4k%2BwiSd3HEihCWDTtOg4%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1ssvt6/1-7630165779740934198_QQ_1776536535002.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"已月戊戌日占財，淂風雷益。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023663657","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰土財爻持世，囙值旬空，戍日冲空則實，本曰卽淂。","logicSentenceId":"7630461354230480896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103369003071"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如午月丙辰","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023680041","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023680041","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占出外貿易財喜何如，淂恒之豫。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023680041","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻酉金化卯相冲，乃反吟之卦，幸辰日合之，冲中逢合，又淂戊土為財，暗動生世，雖則反復不常，却有財利。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023696425","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果𬼘人去而復反者三，盡在中途發貨。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023712809","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前日爻動化冲，如逢仇敵，乃是化囬頭之尅也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023729193","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦世爻酉金化卯，冲世而不尅世，又淂辰日冲動戌財生世，所以為𠮷。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023745577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1st8ga/1-7630154465434337295_QQ_1776536686620.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=dPvMCDkrgwoV%2FiuAdxAnZzkqhF8%3D","pictureHeight":470,"pictureWidth":210,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1st8ga/1-7630154465434337295_QQ_1776536686620.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=A%2FjWIj8hZvJtgOFRbMwMPDnL7Js%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1st8ga/1-7630154465434337295_QQ_1776536686620.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103369019455"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如酉月庚子日占文書，得訟之暌。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023761961","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅木父爻為文書，動而生世，文書必安。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023778345","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但嫌申金財動，冲尅文書，湏待寅日反冲去申金，文書必發，果于寅日領。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023794729","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古以爻冲爻，亦謂之散，旺相之爻，能冲散衰弱之爻，此卦申值秋天，不為不旺，旺金冲寅，而寅木不見散也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023811113","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1stl3e/1-7630152798131617802_QQ_1776536750320.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=BXEs74Kldq2EJAWZmKOaQiSU9Xs%3D","pictureHeight":486,"pictureWidth":224,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1stl3e/1-7630152798131617802_QQ_1776536750320.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=%2B%2BuoYR8cbh%2FqDI8Yco14ctgZGkM%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1stl3e/1-7630152798131617802_QQ_1776536750320.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103369035839"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如子月己巳","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023827497","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日占以財博藝，淂坤卦。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023827497","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：世尅應爻，乃為我勝。","logicSentenceId":"7630461354230497280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但因己日冲動亥水之財，爻生應爻，藝雖精，不能取勝。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326023843881","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"幸淂卦逢六中，必不終局，果輸不多，因他事而冲散矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326030610475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1stxqi/1-7630151737828179983_QQ_1776536822703.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=bapB%2BdTWah4q3KWD103d9XxNyeQ%3D","pictureHeight":488,"pictureWidth":214,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1stxqi/1-7630151737828179983_QQ_1776536822703.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=hKFZ1XQ73gIRz6KIOPgt5%2FAe090%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1stxqi/1-7630151737828179983_QQ_1776536822703.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古以六冲卦諸占不𠮷，予屢試之，用神失𨺻，實不為𠮷。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326030626859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用𠰥得地，湏以用神斷之。","logicSentenceId":"7630461354230513664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟占病有逺近之分，不用用神，近病逢冲卽愈，久病逢冲卽𢀸。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326030643243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及占風水，六","logicSentenceId":"7586699326030659627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103369052223"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冲飛沙走石，亦非久逺之象，其餘必𠔥用神而言。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326030659627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如自月乙未日占子久出不歸生𢀸","logicSentenceId":"7586699326030676011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何如，","logicSentenceId":"7586699326030676011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世臨子孫，以臨月建未日生之，雖是六冲卦，此子必歸。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326030676011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果于子年占卯年淂意而囬。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326030725163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此應静而送冲之季也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326030741547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1suadm/1-7630167877224333338_QQ_1776536945108.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=Iv4lMFEnH9fNfmhyUEEXBNOGNdE%3D","pictureHeight":476,"pictureWidth":220,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1suadm/1-7630167877224333338_QQ_1776536945108.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=axwHOc19dxRBUzXYZlALbTMqsPc%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1suadm/1-7630167877224333338_QQ_1776536945108.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又有巳月甲寅日占延師訓子，淂天","logicSentenceId":"7586699326030757931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103369068607"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地否變乾卦。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326030757931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以應為用神，世應相合，應臨戌父，巳月生之，可稱飽學。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326030774315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獨嫌卦變六冲，合而變冲，不久之兆。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326030790699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1sun0q/1-7630155920865968180_QQ_1776537022701.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=WZA6BM3B6O9VzhOyl3eLhPLqPdk%3D","pictureHeight":482,"pictureWidth":130,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1sun0q/1-7630155920865968180_QQ_1776537022701.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=0uC2XcNpbqFaPCRAvDVZdCO344E%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1sun0q/1-7630155920865968180_QQ_1776537022701.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或問曰：因何事而不久？","logicSentenceId":"7586699326030807083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：子水子孫值旬空，卦中未土父動，防子孫災變。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326030823467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後果两月，其子淂病辭師，未久而子𢀸矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326030839851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡淂六合變六中者，諸占先合後離，先親後踈，先濃浚淡，始榮终悴，初好浚違，先亨後否，淂而復失，成而復敗，事就而又變也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326030856235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟占官非、盗賊、结绝事者冝也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326030872619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103369084991"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如午月丙子日占𫔭典鋪，淂大壮變巽。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326030889003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：世臨午火，月建當時，曰冲不散，又化未土，乃為化合，淂助淂扶，堪","logicSentenceId":"7586699326030905387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690876199288843/1-c5b2c4fcca8abd60.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=YQLebPthhSs%2B4ygstDRNFoSO5vE%3D","uri":"read/HY0710/1/ref/1kodrli0oqqee/1-c5b2c4fcca8abd60.webp","fontType":1,"components":"禾丅䏌","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690876199288843"},"logicSentenceId":"7586699326030905387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𠮷卦。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326030905387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不冝六冲又變六冲，用神雖旺，必開不久。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326030921771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未𭛩一載，因財東為事，抄没其家，舖面𭠎矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326030938155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1suznu/1-7630165260406652943_QQ_1776537191440.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=sn%2BVacHl%2FrtreVZPLbw63EQ5Nt0%3D","pictureHeight":506,"pictureWidth":218,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1suznu/1-7630165260406652943_QQ_1776537191440.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=SyFvjhI6WF7OwDZxAbBI77PP500%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1suznu/1-7630165260406652943_QQ_1776537191440.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𬼘淂六冲變 冲，乃內外變動，交相冲撃，必主上下不和，至親反目，彼此懷奸，始終不就。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326030954539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若用神再受尅者，","logicSentenceId":"7586699326030970923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103369101375"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大凶之兆，用神旺相者，亦不久長。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326030970923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如申月乙卯日父子七人俱蒙 拿問，淂巽卦變坤卦。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326030987307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此係卦變，㢲木化坤土，名為化去。","logicSentenceId":"7630461354230530048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化去不尅，當主無妨。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326031003691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只因世爻變鬼，卯木化酉金，木被金傷，巳火子孫又化亥水，父子两爻皆被其傷。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326031020075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六冲變冲，亂冲亂擊，果俱受刑。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326031036459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古以日辰冲動爻，謂之冲散，又以爻動冲爻，亦能冲","logicSentenceId":"7630461354230628352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103369183295"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"散。","logicSentenceId":"7630461354230628352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予屢試之，旺相者冲之不散，有氣者冲之不散，休囚者間有冲散，亦千百中之一二也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326031446059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其故何也？","logicSentenceId":"7586699326031462443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神兆機于動，動必有因，雖則今日受制，浚逢值日而不散矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326031478827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"李我平曰：黄金策以空云為重，冲散為輕，易冒最重冲散。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326031560747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"细阅占騐，多因錯誤。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326031577131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"疾病章中有卯月丙寅曰占子病，淂漸之觀。","logicSentenceId":"7630461354230677504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占病遇子孫變鬼，百無一生。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326031593515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明係申金子孫變鬼，誤作寅日冲散。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326031609899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如進退章中，申月占卦，酉金發動，遇卯日中之，亦謂之散，徃徃錯誤","logicSentenceId":"7586699326031626283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如𬼘。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326031626283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兌金變震木，謂之化去，正卦為我，我去尅他，不為凶也。","logicSentenceId":"7630461354230775808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此則謂之化尅而不尅也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326031740971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"震木變兑金，謂之化来，他来尅我，回頭之尅，卽為凶兆，諸占大凶。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326031757355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯月辛巳日，来人不","logicSentenceId":"7586699326031773739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103369248831"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言所事，占淂巽變乾，問之所占何事？","logicSentenceId":"7586699326031773739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伊曰：代卜長輩功名。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326031790123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：功名湏要親占，代占難取用神，従不取㫁。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326031806507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"幸此顯而易㫁，見巽木化乾金，即為化来，回頭来尅，為绝卦也，不必問名，壽亦不久，果扵五月削職，七月而終。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326031822891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
