{"lines":[{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如午月丙寅日占主病，淂離變坎。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326031839275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"離火變坎水，回頭来尅，但因午月火旺，許之冬令必危，果卒于九月丁亥日。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326031855659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此皆不看用神之衰旺","logicSentenceId":"7586699326031872043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103369265215"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326031872043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1syuq2/1-7630168392826241078_QQ_1776538291421.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=G2dBrsW04XpStaSbs7JMIrxgD7g%3D","pictureHeight":490,"pictureWidth":140,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1syuq2/1-7630168392826241078_QQ_1776538291421.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=Y5%2BvRgRlJnKVpIJmtNnFNgYWHwQ%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1syuq2/1-7630168392826241078_QQ_1776538291421.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古以占家宅墳塋大事者忌之，𥁞屬揣摹之論，非留心扵占騐。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326031888427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予存四十秊之占騐，無一卦不關心也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326031904811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但遇一人占淂有疑之卦，數年存意探之。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326031921195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如卯月乙酉日占索房價，淂坎變坤。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326031937579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予疑此卦坎水變坤土，囬頭之尅，對伊而曰：房價事小，此卦甚凶。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326031953963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今年諸事須冝謹慎。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326031970347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後於巳月覆舟而𢀸。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326031986731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占此應彼，神預告其凶，令人早知趨避也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326032003115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103369281599"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古以占大事忌之，此卦豈非占小事而應大凶耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586699326032019499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1sz7d6/1-7630170864562798627_QQ_1776538373405.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=uxjxESccw4B1RIkgyY5bbYsvW0E%3D","pictureHeight":484,"pictureWidth":144,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1sz7d6/1-7630170864562798627_QQ_1776538373405.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=HWKmuCOThjO1kCpSzyup4FOLnN4%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1sz7d6/1-7630170864562798627_QQ_1776538373405.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"李我平曰：易冒墓絶章云：日月當令非真，却不知凶事将來，神機早兆。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326032035883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日月當時雖旺，過時則有虧消。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326032052267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"即如此篇占主病，午月淂離變坎，目今夏火雖炎，冬来豈不绝耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586699326032068651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易冒反伏章云：日月従徃則非，空破従徃則重。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326032085035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：半從徃，半従來，半凶半凶。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326032101419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"種種議論，皆非經騐。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326032117803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦軆如人之根𠥽，卦變尅绝，如𣗳連根出土，目前枝葉雖青，能保長不虧乎？","logicSentenceId":"7586699326032134187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當時雖旺，過時而衰；空破雖虚，顛","logicSentenceId":"7586699326032150571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103369297983"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"實則應。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326032150571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且半凶半𠮷之論，難作後人之法。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326032166955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此書止以回頭尅者為凶，余見易冒反伏章中之占騐，明是回頭之尅，誤作反吟休囚。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326032183339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有寅月甲子日占母病，淂坤變巽卦，坤土化巽木，此非囬頭之尅耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586699326032199723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伊書則曰：雖化旬空，休囚之反吟亦凶。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326032216107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣曰空破則重，又曰亦凶，且又牽扯亥水冲破巳火，所以凶也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326032232491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣淂卦變，止觀卦象，不看用神，卽使爻𠮷，泉竭根枯，亦 能久耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586699326504566838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103369314367"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又有寅建癸酉日占長子病，得震之兌。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326504583222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此非震木化兌金囬頭之尅耶？","logicSentenceId":"7630461354230792192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此二卦竟未看出土𮞸木尅，木被金傷，猶以震為長男，占長子𫠦以不𠮷。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326504599606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殊不知卦變囬頭之尅，少女亦 難保也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326504615990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今以彼之占騐，而語彼之錯誤，無他説也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326504632374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦有卦變，爻有爻變。","logicSentenceId":"7630461354230808576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦變者，内外動而反吟，同一卦也，","logicSentenceId":"7586699326504665142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103369330751"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如乾變坤是也：","logicSentenceId":"7586699326504665142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内卦反吟，内則不安；外卦反吟，外則不寕。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326504730678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内外反吟者，内外不安之象也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326504747062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103369347135"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"皆主成而敗，敗而成，有而卽無，無而卽有，淂而失，失而淂，来而去，去而来，散而聚，聚而散，動而思静，静而思動。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326504763446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占功名者，用神旺相，遷而又遷，陞徃他𠁅，仍復陞来;","logicSentenceId":"7586699326504779830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用神失𨺻者，𢦙降或陞，或淂或失。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326504779830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占財物聚散不常，買賣經營興廢徃来不㝎。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326504812598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占坟熒宅舎，欲遷不遷，或遷之而再遷、或目下就有遷移之事。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326504828982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占己經久逺之事者，目前卽有變動。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326504845366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103369363519"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占天時，晴而即雨，雨而又晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326504861750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占婚姻，反覆難成。","logicSentenceId":"7630461354230824960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占疾病，愈而又病。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326504878134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占盗賊官非，見而又見。","logicSentenceId":"7630461354230841344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占出行，行至中途亦反，即使到彼，一事無成。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326504894518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占行人，外卦反吟者，用神旺相必歸，不然亦移他𠁅。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326504910902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在外之人而占家宅者，内卦反吟，家庭人口不安。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326504927286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占彼此之形勢者，内反吟，我亂他㝎；外反吟，他亂我安。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326504943670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"499","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以上用神旺相，不變冲尅者，雖則反伏，事之必成。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326504960054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第","logicSentenceId":"7586699326504976438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103369379903"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"怒用神化囬頭之冲尅者，卽如卦變大凶之象。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326504976438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如卯月壬申日占随官府上任，淂比之井。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326504992822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：世臨官星，值月建而旺，随去必成。","logicSentenceId":"7630461354230857728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"囙係内反吟，必有反復，不冝世爻绝扵申日，又化回頭冲剋，此行不𠮷。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326505009206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不去者為上。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326505025590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後因官府掣籤淂缺，近扵賊營，辭而不去。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326505041974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及至官府去後，忽又因他故而随去矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326505058358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至七月城破，舆官府一同被害，與同官府","logicSentenceId":"7586699326505074742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/3/ref/1le3cy4t8xws3/1-1757581281422.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=4kiywo7Uu%2Bk3eVe2fADTSaBb580%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/3/ref/1le3cy4t8xws3/1-1757581281422.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":"7548753885361012770"},"logicSentenceId":"7586699326505074742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103369396287"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"害者，世爻與官鬼同受酉金之冲尅也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326505074742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不去而又去者，卦淂反吟之故也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326505091126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1t1nuy/1-7630168883990855726_QQ_1776538962487.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=t0tl0ypEEe0XQgaZhGpR0G%2Bv9GA%3D","pictureHeight":512,"pictureWidth":218,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1t1nuy/1-7630168883990855726_QQ_1776538962487.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=qsofWvPrv1JGegB75Ao%2BPNlFnH4%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1t1nuy/1-7630168883990855726_QQ_1776538962487.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如亥月己亥日占陞遷，淂臨變中孚。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326505107510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：世臨卯木，月建之官，又長生扵亥，曰世與官星同臨旺地。","logicSentenceId":"7630461354230874112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"許之卽陞。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326505123894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵本月闻報，由江右陞任山東，未及一載，復任江西。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326505140278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應本月陞者，卯官而值月令，陞山東者，官臨卯木，復臨江西者，外卦反","logicSentenceId":"7586699326505156662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103369412671"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吟，去之而復反也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326505156662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1t20i2/1-7630170863433711679_QQ_1776539012996.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=8ijB0mvJOtrrFxUvlIE8y4m9RpM%3D","pictureHeight":484,"pictureWidth":214,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1t20i2/1-7630170863433711679_QQ_1776539012996.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=GsePWrgk%2B5%2BJtMkQPEhQwooTHqo%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1t20i2/1-7630170863433711679_QQ_1776539012996.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㐲吟卦者，有内外而伏吟也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326505173046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如无妄而變大壮者","logicSentenceId":"7586699326505189430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326505189430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"无妄之大壮。","logicSentenceId":"7630461354230890496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内外伏吟者，内外憂鬱呻吟之象。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326505205814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦有内卦動變伏吟，内則呻吟；外卦伏吟，外則不寕。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326505222198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸占皆不如意，動如不動，焦惱呻吟。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326505238582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"531","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占名者，久困䆠途，淹留仕路。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326505254966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占利者，財源耗散，本利消乏。","logicSentenceId":"7630461354230906880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占墳塋宅舍，欲遷而不能，守之而不利。","logicSentenceId":"7630461354230923264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103369429055"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占婚姻，憂而不樂。","logicSentenceId":"7630461354230939648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"536","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占疾病，久病呻吟。","logicSentenceId":"7630461354230956032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占口舌官非，事之難禁。","logicSentenceId":"7630461354230972416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占出行，難扵動移。","logicSentenceId":"7630461354230988800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"539","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占行人，在外憂鬰。","logicSentenceId":"7630461354231005184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占彼此之形勢者，内卦為我，外卦為他。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326505271350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内㐲吟，我心不遂；外㐲吟，他意不安。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326505287734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然伏吟而較反吟者，反吟有冲有尅，用神受尅，淂禍不輕。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326505304118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伏吟之卦，用神旺相，冲開之年月，其志則伸；用神休囚，冲開之年月，憂欝而已。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326505320502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"544","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如申月癸巳日","logicSentenceId":"7586699326505336886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103369445439"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占父外任平安。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326505336886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淂姤之恒。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326505353270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：巳火日辰生父母，當許在任平安。","logicSentenceId":"7630461354231021568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獨𤍻卦淂伏吟，乃是不寕之象，任上必有事故，不淂意以呻吟也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326505369654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：聞地方貓獐之變，可有碍否？","logicSentenceId":"7586699326505386038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：日建生父，他事無虞。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326505402422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又問：何時歸来？","logicSentenceId":"7586699326505418806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：㐲吟欲歸而不能，辰秊可盻。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326505435190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後知猫徭作祟，地方不寕，驚險異常。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326505451574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅年占卦，辰年裁缺而歸，午年又補四川。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326505467958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應辰秊者，戌父化戌父，冲𫔭戌父之秊也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326505484342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應裁缺者，巳日","logicSentenceId":"7586699326505500726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103369461823"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冲起亥水暗動以尅官也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326505500726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應午年以補官者，占時遇巳日拱起午火之官，當日亥水尅之而不𥁞，今午火官星值年，依然旺矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326505517110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"561","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"李我平曰：易林補遺有曰：爻有㐲吟不𠮷，術者未闻；卦有反吟最凶，卜家誰覺。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326505533494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不看用神之衰旺，竟以反㐲為畏途。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326505549878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今野鶴此論，以比之井卦，世逢冲尅，事反㐲，身受其殃；臨之中孚，世官淂地，雖反伏，官速遷轉。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326505566262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"救人之法，何等透徹。","logicSentenceId":"7586699326505582646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561313476919348"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2","lineNum":0,"lineType":4,"content":"卷三","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136132111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"3","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"旬空章第二十六","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136148495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子旬中戌亥空，甲戌旬中申酉空，甲申旬中午未空，甲午旬中辰巳空，甲辰旬中寅卯空，甲寅旬中子丑空。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136164879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何謂旬空？","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136181263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲子至癸酉日為一旬，此十日之内，并無戍亥，","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136197647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/3/ref/1le3cy4t8zbcj/1-1757658006312.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=ZLKQJ78Oy7a1UPuJtm3k8McW%2FRM%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/3/ref/1le3cy4t8zbcj/1-1757658006312.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":"7549083341049724968"},"logicSentenceId":"7586683329136197647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以爻逢戌亥為旬空，又名空亡。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136197647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136214031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旬空之法，諸書之論太繁，有真空、假空、動空、冲空、填空、援空，無故自空，有故而空、墓絶空、害空、安空、破空。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136230415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561313476935732"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：旺不為空，動不為空。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136246799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有日建動爻生扶者，不為空，動而化空，伏而旺相，皆不為空。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136263183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月破為空，有炁不動亦為空，伏而被尅亦為空，眞空為空。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136279567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"真空者，春土、夏金，秋是木，三冬逢火是真空。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136295951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余初學卜，凡遇旬空，無法而斷，欲以之為到底全空，𨚫又應乎填實之日而不空；以之為不空，却又到底全空。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136312335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後淂多占之法，凡遇旬空，命之再占，卦𠮷者許之出旬而不空，卦淂凶者，許之空矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136328719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561313476952116"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如辰月乙卯日，占求財得家人之贲。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136345103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世，卯","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136361487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巳火。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136361487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子孫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥丑，丑卯兄","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136361487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子水。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136361487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"父母父財兄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見丑財持世，遇旬空，雖有巳火之生，巳火又化囬頭之尅，不能生丑土之財。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136377871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此財旣無生扶，當主難求。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136394255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又因三月之丑𡈽財還有氣，古法有炁不為空，不敢竟𣂢。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136410639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命之再占，世應，淂暌之損巳","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136427023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"未酉金丑，子孫卯巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父㐲，","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136427023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子永財。戍𡈽，兄鬼父。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561313476968500"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因浔此卦，合前卦而决之，竟𣂢曰：財無氣矣，不必勞心。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136427023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼問：何故？","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136443407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：前卦丑財雖則空而有氣，後卦子水財空，伏扵五爻未上之下，伏而又空，空而被尅，知其無財而無超也，果浚全無。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136459791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如子月辛亥日應世，占逺行求財，得大畜。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136476175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅木子水，戌土辰土，寅木子水官財、兄，兄官財，世逢寅木，子月亥日，俱作財神而生世，又喜應爻。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136492559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"為地頭，世應相生，乃全美之卦，獨因世值旬空，若","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136508943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561313476984884"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"執古法𣂢者，無故自空，大凶之兆，敢許之而逺去耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136508943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命之再占，又淂明𢑱世應之豊，酉亥","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136525327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丑土鬼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥丑卯父兄","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136525327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"，午火兄，財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼子，𣂢曰：此卦與前卦相同，此行大有所淂。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136525327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻丑𡈽化午火，回頭相生，目下月破，甭到地頭，巳出月矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136541711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出月而不為破，𫔭春寅卯月，以前卦决者，乃世爻出空之月也，逢子亥財生，美心如願。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136558095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：去淂成","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136574479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561313477001268"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"否？","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136574479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：甲寅日，世爻出空之後，惟行無疑。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136590863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵乙卯日起程。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136607247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後到彼地，寅卯月间，諸事遂心，滿載。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136623631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"而歸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：多占之法，損許多疑惑。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136640015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不然，止以前卦决，𣂢者，無故自空，如入深淵大壑。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136656399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺財生世，腰纒萬貫之徵，許之去耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136672783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"阻之勿去耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136689167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如寅月辛卯日，世應占父何日回，淂觀卯、己","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136705551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"未土父。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯巳未之否。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136705551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財鬼午火，財鬼父，此卦父遇真空，日月傷尅，雖則動不為空，疑其傷","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136721935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561313477017652"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之太重，予不敢𣂢，问之：去了㡬時？","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136721935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：父𫔭店扵某𠁅，離此三百多里，常去常来。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136738319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"昨有信回，這两日要到，不知起身否？","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136754703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予命之再占。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136771087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應得離變中孚。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136787471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌申金","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136803855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"，午火父。丑卯巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄、子孫、未土兄鬼父，此卦又是父動逢空，幸淂日月生父，較前卦不同。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136803855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又喜父動尅世，尅世者速至，許甲午乙未日必到，果扵未日返舍。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136820239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：此卦日月生父，許之必来是","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136836623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561313477034036"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136836623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前卦真空，何以無凶？","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136853007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神無二理，此卦若是，前卦為非。","logicSentenceId":"7633450836924071988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：前卦何甞不是。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136869391","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未父持世，目下旬空，出空而見父也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136885775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"决課之人，要識来人之念。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136902159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伊父逺渉天涯，存亡未審，必存𠮷凶之念而问，若遇真空，必不歸也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136918543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今乃徃米熟，道𠩄問者何日而囬，凑至未。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136934927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日必到。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136951311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"猶伊问曰：我父何日歸家？","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136967695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"猶神告曰：甭父未日卽至。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136984079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我初淂見，我亦動疑，故命之再占。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329137000463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若再得凶卦，卽以云新。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329137016847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣淂𠮷卦，合而决之，𠫵悟神之意矣。","logicSentenceId":"7633450836924088372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曽扵午月己丑日占隂晴，得臨之師卦，初","logicSentenceId":"7586683329137033231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561313477050420"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"初爻己大父動，當應己日必雨。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329137033231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及至癸巳日，早滿天紅日，值伙友在座，亦知易理，命之卜今日雨否？","logicSentenceId":"7586683329137049615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午月癸巳曰：淂應世旣濟，變澤火革子戍","logicSentenceId":"7586683329137065999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"申金，父亥母卯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄鬼亥，水兄鬼子。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329137065999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余曰：今日申時有雨。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329137082383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伙曰：申父雖動，日月尅之，况巳與申合，合住父爻，不雨，雨從何来？","logicSentenceId":"7586683329137098767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：不然，定有大雨。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329137115151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵申酉時雷雨交作。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329137131535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"次日，伙曰：不以月傷日合而𣂢大雨，何其神乎？","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209251368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：非獨昨日之卦","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209267752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561313477066804"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209267752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑日占過，原應巳日必雨。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209284136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"猶我而問神曰：前卦應今日之雨，今果雨否？","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209300520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"猶神而曰：今日申時有雨，不在乎尅與合也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209316904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前卦而𣂢行人鳥，猶彼曰：我父何日而歸？","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209333288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦猶神曰未日必到，不在乎空而真也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209349672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡卜易卦，必與鬼神合其機，勿膠柱而鼓瑟。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209366056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余淂多占之法，雖不能合鬼神之機，能叅悟鬼神之機也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209382440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"李我平曰：空亡之說，鬼神不測之妙，似有又無，似無又有，實有到底全空，亦有填實不空。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209398824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此以多占兩卦","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209415208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561313477083188"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合以决之，實為洩","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209415208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690868180746294/1-f96deb0c0bb58886.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=Xv2Q3wFaOKxUm2s9xKV4i%2BlfFBE%3D","uri":"read/HY1496/7/ref/1kp70c4dmf7yr/1-f96deb0c0bb58886.webp","fontType":1,"components":"𦘒皿","variants":"盡","charPicId":"7456690868180746294"},"logicSentenceId":"7586683330209415208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼神之機也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209415208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天地之理，皆従空而生，謂之懸空而待。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209431592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占遇空，不可卽以為空，須視其𠩄占之事，或近或逺，如在旬内，則為空也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209447976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然亦有冲空之曰，實空之時，事在一旬之外，許其出空之曰而應之。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209464360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若占逺大之事，尚無㝎期，非出旬可以成者，大象不𠮷，乃可謂到底空也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209480744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大象若𠮷，太歲月建六可填之，然又不如多占两卦，實妙法。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209497128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"生旺墓絕章第又二十六","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209513512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"長生、沐浴、冠帶、臨、官，帝、旺、衰、病、𢀸、","logicSentenceId":"7633450836924104756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561313477099572"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"墓、絶、胎、飬。","logicSentenceId":"7633450836924104756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余淂騐者，止騐生、旺、墓、绝，其餘不騐，不必用之。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209529896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金長生在巳，旺在酉，墓在丑，绝在寅。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209546280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木長生在亥，旺在卯，墓在未，绝在申。","logicSentenceId":"7633450836924121140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水土","logicSentenceId":"7633450836924137524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"長生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在申，旺在子，墓在辰，绝在巳。","logicSentenceId":"7633450836924137524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如圭事爻屬木，若在亥曰占卦，卽是主事爻長生扵度日。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209562664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若在卯日占卦，木旺扵卯；若在未日占卦，木墓扵未；若在申日占卦，木绝扵申。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209579048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209595432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乂：如主事爻屬木，卦中動出交文者，亦謂之主事","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209611816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561313477115956"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻，遇長生。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209611816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動出未爻者，謂之主事爻，入動墓。","logicSentenceId":"7633450836924153908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中動出申金者，謂之主事爻逢绝。","logicSentenceId":"7633450836924170292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209628200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如主事爻屬木，動而變出亥水者，謂之化長生。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209644584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動而變出卯木者，謂之化旺。","logicSentenceId":"7633450836924186676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動而變出未土者，謂之化墓；動而變出申金者，謂之化绝。","logicSentenceId":"7633450836924203060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209660968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：金雖長生在巳，須冝金爻旺相，或日月動爻生扶，再遇巳日占卦，或是卦中動出巳爻，或是金爻動而化少巳火，皆謂之遇長生。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209677352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘若金爻休囚無氣，再遇巳午火多者，烈火煎金，論尅不言。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209693736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"生也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561313477132340"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金爻雖墓扵丑，若淂未𡈽冲動，或卦中土多生金，論生不論墓也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209710120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𡈽爻雖绝扵巳，必須休囚無氣，又逢巳者，謂之绝也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209726504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若土爻旺相，或淂日月動爻生扶，再遇巳爻者，巳火反能生土，論生不論绝也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209742888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"已爻雖長生扵寅，倘日月動爻及變出之爻，又逢申字者，謂之三刑，論刑不論生也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209759272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古以土爻長生在申，又曰土長生在寅，無𠁅考証。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209775656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余以天時考之，常見土臨父母，有申日兩者，亦有","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209792040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561313477148724"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子日雨者。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209792040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又見𡈽臨子孫，有申日晴者，有子日晴。","logicSentenceId":"7633450836924219444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，故知土長生扵申，旺扵子，實知土寄生扵申而無疑也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209808424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曽扵午月己卯日占世應妻病，淂震之豊戌、申、午、","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209824808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辰，𡈽財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅子辰土財爻為用神，近病逢冲卽愈，許之當愈扵辰日，不然，酉日必愈。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209824808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"浚囙連日昏沈，竟扵子日起床。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209841192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"許辰日愈者，辰土逢值之日也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209857576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"許酉日者，辰與酉合，動而逢合之日也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209873960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今愈子日者，辰𡈽財爻。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209890344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"旺扵子也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561313477165108"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"李我平曰：生旺墓绝之論，金生在巳，木生在亥，水生在申，火生在寅，四大長生，理之正也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209906728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟𡈽寄生，未淂實考。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209923112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"法云：火𡈽長生寅上排，明知子上是胞胎。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209939496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卽𡈽寄生扵寅。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209955880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今五行家戊𡈽生寅，己𡈽生酉，易冒雖曰惟𡈽之長生不一，申中有坤，𡈽生扵申，若分隂陽，則戊𡈽生寅，己土生酉，亦未淂其實。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209972264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"據此專以天時考証者，土寄生扵申，萬古而不易也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209988648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"各门類題頭，聰註章第又二十六浚章，分门各類，當用字眼，恐其繁紧，不便全冩，止用","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210005032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561313477181492"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"題頭。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210005032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽如後有用神冝旺，不可指㝎旺扵四時，但淂用臨日月，𢦙遇日月動爻，變爻生扶，或用爻遇長生、逢帝旺，皆謂之旺。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210021416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用神化𠮷，凡用神，元神動，化囬頭生，化長生，化帝旺，化比𦔳，化","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210037800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日月皆為化𠮷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用神，化凶。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210037800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡用神，元神動，化，囬頭尅，化绝、化墓、化空、化破、化鬼、化退神，皆為化凶。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210054184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歳君卽當年太𡻕𡻕五歳者，太歳五者，卦之第五爻","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210070568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561313477197876"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五位，每卦之第五爻為君位。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210070568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易曰：九五之尊者。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210086952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身郎世爻，古用卦身、世身，余試不騐而不用。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210103336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡後有遇身者者，卽是世爻，非卦身、世身也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210119720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三墓者，用爻入曰墓入動墓，動而化墓，此三墓也，非古之世墓、身墓、命墓也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210136104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主象主事爻自占卦世為主象，又名主事爻。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210152488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占父毋兄弟，卽父母兄弟為主事交。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210168872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210185256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"老隂之為少陽曰變，老陽之為少隂曰化。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210201640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561313477214260"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古言變者，如物消而長，退而進也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210218024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化者，猶物成而敗，進而退也。","logicSentenceId":"7633450836924235828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予試不騐。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210234408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化進神、化長生者，雖化","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210250792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/HY3039/7442289681326145588/1-1740497575730.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=ygpwROoFMF0%2Fp0pPookwEh05Z%2FU%3D","uri":"read/HY3039/2/ref/1ksoilizpsrop/1-1740497575730.webp","fontType":3,"components":"𠂉灬","variants":"亦","charPicId":"7475377158592987176"},"logicSentenceId":"7586683330210250792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉，變鬼、變回頭尅者，雖變，二凶。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210250792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後各章凢言變者，卽是化爻，化即是變。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210267176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"静而逢值逢冲。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210299944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如主事爻臨子水，不動，後逢子日午日應","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210316328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210316328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"餘倣此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7633450836924252212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動而逢合逢值。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210332712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如主事爻臨子發動，後遇丑日子日應之","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210349096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"。餘倣此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210349096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561313477230644"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太旺者逢墓逢冲。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210365480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如主事爻臨午火，又遇巳午月日占卦，或卦中巳午爻太多，後逢亥子日應之，又有戌日應之，乃火入墓也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210381864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘敇此。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210398248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衰绝者遇生遇旺。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210414632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如主事爻屬金，占卦扵巳午月日，卽是休囚無氣，後逢土月日，㦯到秋令，當時則旺矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210431016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210447400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入三墓，俱喜冲𫔭。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210463784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如主象臨午火，火墓扵戌，後逢辰日則應","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210480168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210480168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"餘倣此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7633450836924268596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561313477247028"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇六合，亦冝相擊。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210496552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如主事爻與日月作合，或動與爻合，或動而","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210512936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，或凶或𠮷，必待冲𫔭之日月應之。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210512936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如主象臨子，與丑作合，後逢午未日應之，","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210529320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月破喜逢填合。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210529320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如子月占卦，主事爻臨午火，乃為月破，後逢未日應之，謂之破而逢合。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210545704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又有逢午日應之，填實之日，則不破矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210562088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旬空最愛填冲。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210578472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561313477263412"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旬空章註觧極明。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210594856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大象𠮷而受尅，湏待尅神受尅。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210611240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假令用神臨辰，𡈽淂日月生扶，乃為大象𠮷也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210627624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘被寅卯尅害，浚逢申酉日冲尅，尅神則𠮷，餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210644008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大象凶而受尅，湏防尅者逢生，卽如前說。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210660392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用神臨辰，𡈽旣無日月動爻之生，乃為大象凶也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210676776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再逢寅卯尅制者，浚逢寅卯亥日則凶。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210693160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元神来助来扶，湏看用神衰旺，忌神来尅来冲，觀乎元氣興衰，","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210709544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561313477279796"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元神忌神章註觧極明。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210709544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化進神，逢值逢合，且如申動化酉，乃為進神，為禍為福，有應申月日，有應巳月日，化退神，忌值忌冲。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210725928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽如酉動化申，有應申月日有應寅月日。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210742312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"間有應扵獨發獨靜、獨𤼲章内詳之。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210758696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"間有應扵變爻動爻，","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210775080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561313477296180"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如爻臨戌圡，變出酉金，有應戌日，亦有應酉","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210775080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210775080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勿謂爻之不騐。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210791464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逺近當分，逺事㝎之以年月，近事應之扵日時。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330210807848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"conte {"lines":[{"lineId":"585","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"進退神者，爻之動而化也。","logicSentenceId":"7633450836924497972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化進化退，𠮷凶禍福，有喜忌之分。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347390496808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所喜者冝扵化進，所忌者宜化退神。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347390513192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"617","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古以動日月而化空破，且許不進。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347390660648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦旬空化空破，亦能進也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347390677032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347390693416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如卯月乙丑日，占","logicSentenceId":"7633450836924629044","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巳火未土，酉金，子孫財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰","logicSentenceId":"7633450836924629044","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅","logicSentenceId":"7633450836924629044","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子水父母。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"求婚成否，得噬嗑。","logicSentenceId":"7633450836924629044","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"變比。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"于水。","logicSentenceId":"7633450836924645428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌𡈽申金。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347390709800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財兄未𡈽，財爻持世，化進神，巳火。","logicSentenceId":"7633450836924661812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子動而生世，但因巳火化子水，回頭之尅，必待午。","logicSentenceId":"763345 {"lines":[{"lineId":"669","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古以動日月化空破，謂之不進，此卦動非日月而化破，𡖋能進也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347951452160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如未月丁卯日，占功名終得出仕否？","logicSentenceId":"7586683347951468544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天火同人變单卦。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347951484928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：若以古法㫁者，子孫動而尅官，終身而無官也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347951501312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予許辰季出仕，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7586683347951517696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌土子孫雖動，幸化。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347951534080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"退神，不尅官也，辰年冲去成𡈽，是以許之，果扵辰","logicSentenceId":"7586683347951550464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561348653858856"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年浔選，豈可謂之動空化日月而不退耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586683347951550464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如申月辛卯日，占病，淂澤天夬卦變大壮，此公因抱危，","logicSentenceId":"7586683347951566848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/3/ref/1le3cy4t98g1f/1-1757832926370.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=zeL8sE3DGfNIhrih88i6y1XktUY%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/3/ref/1le3cy4t98g1f/1-1757832926370.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":"7549834270983323663"},"logicSentenceId":"7586683347951566848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：子孫持世，明日辰日：必遇良醫。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347951566848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵次扵用鈢而愈。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347951583232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：子孫化退神，何其用藥亦劾？","logicSentenceId":"7586683347951599616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：動變皆屬秋金，當權得令，占近事，豈可曰退？","logicSentenceId":"7586683347951616000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若占久逺之事，待休因之時退者是也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347951632384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"686","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如丑月癸卯日，占妻病眼，此藥愈否，淂臨之泰。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347951665152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/3/ref/1le3cy4t9ajw3/1-1757832214459.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=zWhAUHXmEN6OOpxh6sqf4PdTCAE%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/3/ref/1le3cy4t9ajw3/1-1757832214459.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":"7549831671601643520"},"logicSentenceId":"7586683347951681536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：兄動化進神，靈丹莫救。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347951681536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其妻夗扵甲辰日。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347951697920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561348653875240"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此乃兄動臨日𭚔而化旬空，亦可謂之不進耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586683347951714304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如戌月癸未日，占病，得乹之夬，㫁曰：久病逢冲莫治。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347951730688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又是父爻持世，妙藥難醫。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347951747072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖化退神，非病退也，乃精神命脉漸漸消枯之象也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347951763456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"防丑月冲破未土，而無路矣，果卒丑月。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347951779840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"696","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如戌月己卯日，占母血崩，一年有餘，得同人變解。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347951796224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯木父母值臨日建，上爻戍土以生申金，金生亥水，若非丑土化進神，以塞其水，此父母爻淂此接續相生，災雖險而何碍？","logicSentenceId":"7586683347951812608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今父母木爻旣無水養，且","logicSentenceId":"7586683347951828992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561348653891624"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化退神，精血大敗，捱至丑月旺𡈽，以绝其源，湏防危險，果卒扵丑月。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347951828992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此乃父臨日建，不化空破亦能退也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347951845376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"702","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如卯月癸酉日，占父，近病，淂萃之否。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347951861760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未土父動化進神，戌值旬空，近病逢空卽愈，許次日退災，果扵甲戌出空卽愈。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347951878144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此乃父爻休囚而化空也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347951894528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若以古法，動日月化空破，尚且不進，今休囚而化空，可就愈耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586683347951910912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"742","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又卯月丙申日，衙役占官府陞否，淂解之困。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347952271360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官動化進神，秋来得令，必遷，後報陞扵四月。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347952287744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應巳月者，動而逢合之月，申金又長生扵巳，此乃動日月而化空破，豈可謂之不進耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586683347952304128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"745","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561348653957160"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如酉月乙丑日，占試中否，淂兑之訟。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347952320512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：未父化進神，巳火官動而生世，𠮷兆顯然，㘴以待報，果扵寅日掲㮄，中第入名。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347952336896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古法動破散化日月，尚不能進，此卦動散化空，亦能中矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347952353280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"749","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如未月丁丑日，占母路隔千里，何時来，淂火天大有變井卦，初爻子水化出丑，父子與丑合，被合不来。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347952369664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未父化進神，亦應不来。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347952386048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"幸淂未土生起酉金兄爻，兄化退神而合世，母在不来，兄弟必来。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347952402432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：有妹無弟。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347952418816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵次年三月妹至。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347952435200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此乃兄弟爻空化空，","logicSentenceId":"7586683347952451584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561348653973544"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦能退也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347952451584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動静隂陽及覆遷變。","logicSentenceId":"7633450836925268020","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前卷動變章註解極明。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251946496006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太過者，損之斯成。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251946512390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊註：主事爻重疂太多，事不專一，故冝損之。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251946528774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如","logicSentenceId":"7586689251946545158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423393718291"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土為主事爻，爻中多逢辰戍丑未，謂之太過，湏待寅卯月日尅制玉爻，然後成事。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251946545158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或占時淂遇寅卯月日者𡖋好。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251946561542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：不獨後逢寅卯月，曰後逢辰月辰日者，二許成事。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251946577926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何也？","logicSentenceId":"7586689251946594310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰乃土之墓庫，謂之用爻重疂，須墓庫以收藏是也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251946610694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣𬼘。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251946627078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不及者，益之則利。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251946643462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何謂不及？","logicSentenceId":"7586689251946659846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若主事爻止有一位，又不旺相，謂之不及，其事難成。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251946676230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423393734675"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如金為主事爻，若在夏天占淂，卽為休囚无炁，若淂日辰、動爻生之，或待後来逢生助之月日，皆有利益，其事亦成。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251946692614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余以此論是理，但要主事爻原有根蒂，衰而逢生者，如旱苖之得雨也，勃然而興，故謂之有助有扶，衰弱休囚六吉。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251946708998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
