ginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1065","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"他事由他動念，慎勿提他。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280471842835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1066","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"他之心事未動念而占，我提醒他，呌他占者，乃我之念也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280471859219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1067","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曽有父呌子占功名，","logicSentenceId":"7586689280471875603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1068","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561481286303785"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1069","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午月辛酉日，占功應世，名淂萃，變遯。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280471875603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1070","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"未父酉亥卯巳財未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1071","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戍兄子申官父，此子十有一嵗，父呌他占，将來有切名否？","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908928000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1072","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若以官星持世，夏火當陽，未土父爻為文章，父化進神，切名有望。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280471891987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1073","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豈知父呌子占，乃父之念也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280471908371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1074","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦乃是父占子也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280471924755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1075","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父動尅子，兄動傷妻，此子未年而死。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280471941139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1076","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未年夗子者，未土父動，值未年，以傷子也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280471957523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1077","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫應七月傷妻者，卯木爻絕扵申也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280471973907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1078","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561481286320169"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1079","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予今亦甞呌人而占，另有一法，先向伊曰：甭之某事，湏占一卦。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280471990291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1080","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目下我起之念，甭且莫占，待少刻忘懷。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472006675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1081","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甭忽想起，另起念而占之，卽甭之念也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472023059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1082","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"屢騐我占，必以直告，切莫昧己。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472039443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1083","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此等極多，難以枚舉。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472055827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1084","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有為婚相，故占月令，有因功名，故占流年，有現任官府，欲望他人之缺，不便言之，故占在任吉凶。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472072211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1085","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有孝㢘不明言。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472088595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1086","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卜㑹試，渾问功名，有已单職，渾问功名，有已生子，故問有子否。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472104979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1087","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如未月癸亥日，世應","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472121363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1088","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561481286336553"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1089","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占流年，淂艮卦。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472121363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1090","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅子戊申午辰，官財兄子父兄，此人己徃東前拔例，故占流年，祗謂命有功名，流年必現。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472137747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1091","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"却不知占功名，以官為官，最喜官星持世。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472154131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1092","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占流年以官為鬼，不宜官鬼持世。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472170515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1093","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予以此理告之，彼曰：煩人援例，不知成否？","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472186899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1094","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：此卦官星持世，長生扵亥日，業已成矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472203283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1095","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥水為財，明明財旺生官，果扵申日，文書實收俱到。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472219667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1096","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應申日者，寅木官星持世，静而逢冲之日也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472236051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1097","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"善以流年作鬼所者，如天逺矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472252435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1098","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561481286352937"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1099","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如子月乙酉日，世應，占現任吉凶，淂需","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472268819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1100","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子戊申，辰寅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子卦：財兄子兄官財。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472268819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此公因本省有缺出，不便明问淂否，故以現任吉凶而问，祗謂淂缺卦之必𠮷。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472285203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殊不知周易之理，问缺之淂否，子孫持世而不淂，问現任之吉凶。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472301587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫持世而休官，予必问明。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472317971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"公曰：问陞遷。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472334355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予始告曰：此缺不淂，果不淂。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472350739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若以占現任之吉凶者，休官之兆也，六非天逺耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472367123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1108","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561481286369321"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如午月辛毋日應世，因母有病，故问𣴑卯巳","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472383507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1110","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"未土辰財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅子年，淂益之无妄。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472383507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄子午火財兄父。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472399891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"買賣人占沇年者，自然以財交為重。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908944384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦旺財持世，未土之財又動，當許發財。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472416275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若以問毋病㫁之，最忌財爻發動，財動尅母，其母夗扵甲辰日，應世爻𫝕土虫空之日也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472432659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後賢凡遇卜流年月令者，先以此理曉之，兩無誤矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472449043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦若以發財而㫁，豈無謗耶。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472465427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占逺應近，務必笛心。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908960768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1119","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561481286385705"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天下之理生扵動，有機則動。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472481811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡来占者，事在目前，心神迫情，两心相感，起課之人，精神鳥聚，吉凶立見。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472498195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若事尚無機，或占後運，或占不阅㔹之事，甚有作戲談而问，占卦之人，不淂己應之，两心毫無相攝，卦点茫然。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472514579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦之成者，成以逺而報近事，或以近事而報逺。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472530963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908977152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世，如未月丙辰日，占未酉亥申","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472547347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1126","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"午灭鬼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰財，淂咸之大過。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472547347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父兄子，兄","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908993536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1129","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"亥水，子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908993536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1131","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"孫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472563731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此人闲问家中常現白人，必有古窖，何時淂財。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478909009920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472580115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1135","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561481286402089"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：卦中鬼變子孫，目下子女不村。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472580115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：小女出花。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472596499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：湏防交日。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472612883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果死扵交。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478909026304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：彼问何年而得財神，報目下而死。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472629267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女應亥，曰者，午火鬼化凌水子也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472645651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如酉月甲辰日應世，占本月月令，淂遯戊申午申","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472662035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1143","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"午火辰鬼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之姤，父兄鬼，兄，亥水父，世化午火交水，回頭尅世。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472662035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰年占卦，在午年子月而死，占月令而现壽元。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472678419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此六占近而應逺也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472694803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如申月戊辰日應世，","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472711187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1148","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561481286418473"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占買易，淂比之井子戊申","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472711187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1150","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卯巳未，鬼父。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財兄，子酉亥兄。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472711187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此人常徃外方貿易，偶甭闲，問明歳利扵何方，卦淂世爻卯水，動化酉金冲尅，七月占卦，八月而死。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472727571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"猶神報之，大數已終，何必来年之问？","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472743955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占此應彼，必湏詳察。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472760339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大凢占出卦象，必湏细為詳查。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472776723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦有不應所问之事，而反應所未问之事，其故何也？","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472793107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神有舎小事而報大事，有舎小告而報大凶，有舍此應彼，舍彼應","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472809491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1158","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561481286434857"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此，占我應他，占他應我，乃旦夕禍福将至，機之一動，卦之必現。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472809491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故曰：知㡬其神，此之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280472825875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如己月己未日，應世，占小厮病，子戍申","logicSentenceId":"7586689280802553862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1162","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卯木巳鬼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未財兄子","logicSentenceId":"7586689280802553862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1164","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"申金子孫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父兄。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280802553862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：此卦不應小子病，而應今秋功名，有碍。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280802570246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：何也？","logicSentenceId":"7586689280802586630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：世臨卯木之官，化申金子孫之尅，是以知之。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280802603014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：我问小子，如何應在功名？","logicSentenceId":"7586689280802619398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：神之盛，常常如此，舍小事而報大凶，神儆公之，諸事湏冝","logicSentenceId":"7586689280802635782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1171","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561481286451241"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"慎也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280802635782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵七月被論单職。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280802652166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此占他而應我也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280802668550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如申月戊寅日，世應占身病，淂坤之比。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280802684934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉","logicSentenceId":"7633451478909042688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1177","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"亥丑財。卯巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未子戊兄鬼父兄，断曰：世爻酉金雖绝扵寅。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478909042688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：幸而秋间旺相，自身不碍，湏防九十月妻妄之危。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478909059072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人水財爻，化戍土囬頭之尅。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280802701318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：我病甚重。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280802717702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：子孫持世，不藥而愈。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280802734086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果然其病卽愈，九月妻𢀸。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280802750470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此又占我而應彼也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280802766854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如：卯月丙午日，龍元虎蛇勾、朱","logicSentenceId":"7586689280802783238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1186","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561481286467625"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，占小人口舌，淂乾世丶〇⺀應⺀之，需。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280802783238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1188","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戌父申午官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰寅子子兄申父財子。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280802799622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：旣占口舌，如何淂此吉卦？","logicSentenceId":"7586689280802816006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"公曰：有何吉𠁅？","logicSentenceId":"7586689280802832390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：青龍天喜、文書持世，午火官星臨。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280802848774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰建而生世，今年太嵗在巳，嵗君又生世爻，㝎有非常之喜，不出十日應之。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478909075456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"公曰：小人口舌，成非否？","logicSentenceId":"7586689280802865158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：疑神之報，大喜之日，卽小人潜㐲之時也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280802881542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵戊申曰闻報起用，小輦潛形。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280802897926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應申日者，寅木財空，申日冲起","logicSentenceId":"7586689280802914310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1198","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561481286484009"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅水，以成三合之故。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280802914310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"呌善。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280802930694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不细加詳察，而以口舌㫁者，又如天逺世應。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478909091840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如：未月丁亥日。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280802947078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1203","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"酉亥子丑卯巳未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占母病，淂坤之剥。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478909108224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅財兄鬼父兄。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280802963462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：此卦不現，母病，而現，子女，有災。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478909124608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：何也？","logicSentenceId":"7586689280802979846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：令堂近病，卦淂六冲卽愈，只不冝爻中現出子孫變鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280802996230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伊曰：小児初生两月。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280803078150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：八月，防之。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280803094534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵八月，其子驚風又来，卜之應世。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280803110918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉月丁卯日，占子，子","logicSentenceId":"7633451478909140992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1213","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戌申金，亥丑卯父。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1214","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561481286500393"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"病，淂旣濟之单兄鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478909140992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥兄鬼子。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280803127302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：卯木子孫臨月破，又動出申金傷尅，雖值日辰難過。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478909157376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉曰卯日。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280803143686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：還有救否？","logicSentenceId":"7586689280803160070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：向占母病，已應八月死子，今又淂此凶卦，何以救之？","logicSentenceId":"7586689280803176454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果死扵卯日。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280803192838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫應卯日者，乃實破之日也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280803209222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余因好友貧困之極，携銀數两，親徃赠之，彼尚不知，卽凂占卦，謂目下一事，约淂二十餘金。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280803225606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不知得否？","logicSentenceId":"7586689280803241990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑月甲申日，占應世，得同人之經戌申午亥水丑卯。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478909173760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1226","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561481286516777"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：日建仆財以生世，此財必得。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280803258374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"问：在何日可得？","logicSentenceId":"7586689280803274758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：今日就得。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280803291142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：事尚未成，如何就淂？","logicSentenceId":"7586689280803307526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予始悟曰：是也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280803323910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我欲贈他，他尚未知，必神告曰：目下就見。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280803340294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財矣，何必他问？","logicSentenceId":"7586689280803356678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予卽與之，命他冉占一卦，占得離卦，兄文持世卦，淂六冲。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280803373062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余曰：先淂之卦，應我相贈之物，後卦全無影响，果然。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280803389446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此乃占彼而應此也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280803405830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"李我平曰：黄金策、千金賦，乃誠意先生所著。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280803422214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"昔有人曰：有能易一字者，予以千金。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280803438598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後因刻板錯鋘，以訛傳訛，致白玉生瑕。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280803454982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不意野鶴老人前後增如，另仆解註，","logicSentenceId":"7586689280803471366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1241","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561481286533161"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以成全璧。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280803471366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予不能遺以千金，従此名之曰萬金賦可也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280803487750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"口過天時章第三十五","logicSentenceId":"7586683347662880814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"増刪黄金策。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天道旱澇不時，易爻隂晴可測。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750236315711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古以晴雨之占，不可以自試其術而輕瀆鬼神，如亢旱求雨，澇則求晴，始可卜之。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347662897198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：不然，正可以此試其術也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347662913582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何也？","logicSentenceId":"7586683347662929966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦之㣲妙，初學難知。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347662946350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以人事而","logicSentenceId":"7586683347662962734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549133496320"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"試者，取騐不速；以天時而試者，目前見効。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347662962734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天時之隂晴，人间之禍福，皆不經乎五行，天時淂騐，人事騐矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347662979118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予初學卜，皆賴天時之巧應，淂其㣲奥之㫖趣也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347662995502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫為日月星斗，動則萬里晴光。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347663011886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黄金策以才動者，八方咸仰晴光，非也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347663028270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫發動，萬里無雲。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347663044654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財為子孫之元神，財動維晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347663061038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘如子孫休囚空破，或現而不動者，必不大晴，常有浮雲薄霧。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347663077422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549133512704"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如卯月甲午日占晴，","logicSentenceId":"7586683347663093806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申金子動化進神，申酉日碧天如洗。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347663093806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：凡存占騐，當存奇徴巧騐。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347663126574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦顯而易見，何故錄之？","logicSentenceId":"7630461750236332095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：令初學者易知，由淺以入深也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347663142958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"竒騐奧理，後卷有之。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347663159342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1t2psa/1-7630171411340328987_QQ_1776539592533.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=tXEDYgbHlh3PHOtGULvw54abcCg%3D","pictureHeight":502,"pictureWidth":150,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1t2psa/1-7630171411340328987_QQ_1776539592533.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=605PuCZRCOatFlmVw1sl5%2F8dF2Q%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1t2psa/1-7630171411340328987_QQ_1776539592533.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母為雨雪雹霜，發則八方潤澤。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347663175726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占湏冝分禱，或求晴，或求雨，或求雪求霜，念專扵一，而神告矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347663192110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又冝分請求扵何地禱曰：城内雨","logicSentenceId":"7586683347663208494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549133529088"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"否？","logicSentenceId":"7586683347663208494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"晴否？","logicSentenceId":"7630461750236348479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或占某郷，或占某省。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750236364863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不然，天下何日不晴，何日不雨，指其地而占之可也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347663224878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"法以父母為天地，天地闭塞而日月掩藏，此亦近理。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347663241262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予以父母為濃雲重霧，父動傷子，掩其日月也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347663257646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所以父爻發動，雲霧迷天，日月掩藏而雨矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347663274030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1t32fe/1-7630174685359439910_QQ_1776539656239.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=J0mSHMijJBtenhR6nWYnRbU3bzo%3D","pictureHeight":510,"pictureWidth":216,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1t32fe/1-7630174685359439910_QQ_1776539656239.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=skZ4tRFUMRaInx0ZujSqAH7vGKY%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1t32fe/1-7630174685359439910_QQ_1776539656239.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如巳月甲戌日占天何日雨，淂小過之旅。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347663290414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因連日大晴，本日卯時，占何日雨，卽扵辰時起雲，","logicSentenceId":"7586683347663323182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549133545472"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰末巳初，雷雨交作。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347663323182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應辰時者，戌日冲辰父而暗動，雷雨交作者，戌化巳火鬼也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347663339566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻財天氣晴明，財動尅父而生子孫，𠩄以主晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347663355950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如酉月乙巳日占𠥽日隂晴，得升之恒。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347663372334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦丑土財動，化出午火子孫，上半日雖晴，常有浮雲掩日，自午時之後，滿天红日無雲，所以財爻","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716292654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549133561856"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖主晴明，難免無雲，不至午時而見子孫，始大","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716292654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睛也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716292654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官鬼雷霆霧電。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716309038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官鬼乃父母之元神，動則生父，故主雷霆霧電。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750236381247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或為黑雲，或應雷霆，不拘春夏秋冬，不可執以為雷，濃雲黑霧者是也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716325422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1t3rpm/1-7630179307428085800_QQ_1776539718888.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=%2FY%2FIIpKMtqCcCoVnz6Rkf6jZf0M%3D","pictureHeight":492,"pictureWidth":216,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1t3rpm/1-7630179307428085800_QQ_1776539718888.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=UyM6%2B8EFvmzlt4%2Bz1qgHr9dtYts%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1t3rpm/1-7630179307428085800_QQ_1776539718888.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如巳月丁卯日占天何日雨，淂恒之大過。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716341806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻酉鬼暗動，申鬼明動，化進神。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716358190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本日申時霹窟驚天，逺方大雨，而本𠁅灑来㡬㸃。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716374574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：想因父爻","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716390958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549133578240"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月破。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716390958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：非也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716407342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父爻若動，雖臨月破，亦有大雨。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716423726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應乃太虚，逢空雨晴難㝎；","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716440110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丗為大堁，凝尅天變非常。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716440110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：占雨用父爻，占晴用子孫及財爻，與世應何干？","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716456494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予嘗占兩占晴，一卦不現，再占兩卦，六爻不動者，務必求其動而騐之。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716472878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何故而曰雨晴難㝎","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716489262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"？","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716489262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假使人问趨避，亦可荅曰：我難㝎鄅。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750236397631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至扵世久受尅而天變者，或係偶然凑合一両卦斗，何淂以之為法","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716522030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"？","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716522030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余常占淂官父兄爻尅世者不少，未見天變。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750236414015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716554798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549133594624"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二句冝删之。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716554798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若論風雲，全憑兄弟。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716571182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟發動，雖至風雲，乃雲淡風輕之景，非晴非雨之天。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716587566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"每見兄動，而曰月扵雲中穿走，乍隠乍出耳。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716603950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1t44cq/1-7630176606145101843_QQ_1776539752156.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=qTKd%2BYpcydnPVA21k1apjGfTNRU%3D","pictureHeight":496,"pictureWidth":216,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1t44cq/1-7630176606145101843_QQ_1776539752156.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=5pj7FZLgy4%2FRCMmXTlTgicAhcj8%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1t44cq/1-7630176606145101843_QQ_1776539752156.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如午月丁效日占本日隂晴，淂遯之否。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716620334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：兄動為風雲，今日還是隂天。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716653102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：申時要見曰色。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716669486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：何也？","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716685870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：申金兄爻為雲，化出卯木，則","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716702254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549133611008"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻是出雲霧中，變虫日色之象。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716702254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果一日隂雲，申時而見日色，次日卯時大晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716718638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更詳四李推詳，洌配五行叅决。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716735022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黄金策曰：父母爻四時主雨，若臨金水，兩大而未止；若臨火土，兩小而不乆。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716751406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"語覺子曰：此係不論衰旺，四時皆以父臨水則雨大，臨火則雨小。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716767790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣不論旺衰，如何後","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716784174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"章又曰：父持月建，必悲隂兩連旬。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716784174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假使巳午未月，火土當令之時，正大雨施行之際，若值父臨火土而發動，如以旺","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716816942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549133627392"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"哀而㫁者，當生隂雨速旬。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716816942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若以五行叅决論火士者，當㫁之雨小。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716833326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古法之謬，何以不丹？","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716849710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更可咲者，舊註有云：冬天以子孫為霜雪。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716866094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣以子孫為霜雪，倘值冬令，占晴以何爻而為曰月？","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716882478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"昔賢悖理之謬，當時而不省悟者，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716898862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1t4gzu/1-7630163068845277230_QQ_1776539788730.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=lr%2FgwEM9HaVT3%2B%2BOouQ8xoJeHUk%3D","pictureHeight":508,"pictureWidth":238,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1t4gzu/1-7630163068845277230_QQ_1776539788730.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=20mOpy8yy3e1gSkCq728KjqDQHo%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1t4gzu/1-7630163068845277230_QQ_1776539788730.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如子月己友日","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716915246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549133643776"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"連日雪，占何日晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716915246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：両爻火鬼暗動，今日還是隂天。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716931630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯木財爻化出子水子孫，明日卯時必晴，果於次日卵時雲開","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716948014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日岀。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716948014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此子水者，旣臨月建，又有亥日拱之旺之，無云比差，以之為霜雪，不獨不晴，卽當雪深十尺。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716964398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所以占天時，不論旺衰，亦未有以子孫為霜雪也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716980782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"晴或逢官，為烟為霧。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347716997166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊註：卦淂晴兆，爻中又有鬼動者，必有濃雲重霧，或惡風晦暗，冬或大寒，夏或大熱，必非風和日麗","logicSentenceId":"7586683347717013550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549133660160"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之天。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347717013550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予以此論有理，但須分别時辰。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347717029934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"即如辰月己卯日","logicSentenceId":"7586683347717046318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占本日隂晴，淂屯","logicSentenceId":"7586683347717046318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之臨。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347717046318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷曰：寅木子孫化進神，今日大晴。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750236430399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五爻戊土鬼動。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347717062702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戍後時必起黒雲，果於戌時星斗無光。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347717079086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若以一曰之烟霧訢者，錯也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347717095470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雨而遇福，為電為虹。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347717111854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如辰月丙辰日因連日隂雨，占本日情否，","logicSentenceId":"7586683347717128238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淂困之比。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347717128238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦二爻𫝕土，旣是父持月建，又持日辰，化出巳火生之，豈非有雨之兆？","logicSentenceId":"7586683347717144622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而亥水子孫發動，化出申金，予竟不以虹霓㫁之。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347717161006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"許申時天闻，亥時大晴，果扵亥時萬里無雲。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347717177390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫為日月星斗，勿以之","logicSentenceId":"7586683347717193774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"為雲為虹。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347717193774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊註謂：父爻空而無兩子孫及財爻空而不晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347717275694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余常占雨，父毋休囚不動，果是難望。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347717292078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若值空者，勿謂無望。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347717308462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"常淂父爻動而逢空不應，冲空之日，卽應填實之期，百靈百騐。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347717324846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財與子孫空者𡖋同。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347717341230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𬼘雄財八鬼，晴明不乆。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347717357614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊係財化鬼，隂晴未窆，非也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347717373998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如巳月甲寅日囙","logicSentenceId":"7586683347717390382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549133709312"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"連日晴，占何日雨，","logicSentenceId":"7586683347717390382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得既濟變蹇。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347717390382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若","logicSentenceId":"7586683347717423150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以財化鬼，隂晴未定。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347717423150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𬼘卦卯木子孫化辰土鬼，豈可曰隂晴而未定耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586683347717439534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殊不知卯木子卯日晴，辰土鬼辰日天變，則不晴矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347717455918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予㫁辰日天隂，巳日必雨。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347717472302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何以知？","logicSentenceId":"7586683347717488686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其己日兩卦中，申金父爻晴動，動而逢合之日，果扵𫝕日天變，巳日大雨。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750236528703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故曰子孫財爻化鬼，晴之不久。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347717505070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父動化財化子，乃雨之不乆，非隂晴而難㝎也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347717521454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父化兄，父化鬼，或卦中父動兄動，皆主風雨交仆。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750236545087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若論前後，動者為先，變者為浚，卽如兄化父，先風而後雨；鬼化父，春夏占者，先雷浚兩覺。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347717554222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子曰：鬼動雖為雷電，應雷者少，累雲者多，不可執之。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347717570606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前卦午火父動，未時一陣大，兩酉時卽晴。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750236577855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後卦申金父動，庚申日雨，辛酉日半晴半隂，後時大晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347717849134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前卦不惟父持月建，且臨彼辰，後卦父持月建，辰日","logicSentenceId":"7586683347717865518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549133774848"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生之，旺莫旺如此也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347717865518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"似此之旺，且無風雨連旬，而况他乎？","logicSentenceId":"7586683347717881902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余試天時，旺衰不論。","logicSentenceId":"7586683347717898286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如辰月戊申日占本日隂晴，淂中惇之小畜。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750236610623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑土兄動化進神，臨月令，又長生扵申日。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750236627007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若論旺衰，旺之無比，並不見狂風","logicSentenceId":"7586684635086585882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"累日。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635086585882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只見一日隂雲","logicSentenceId":"7630461750236643391","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而已。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750236643391","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：九動化進神，不見狂風者，以何爻而主狂風？","logicSentenceId":"7586684635086618650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：禽動化進神，乃狂風耳。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635086635034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊註：官鬼空伏，父母無炁而財爻旰動者，必旱。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635086667802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子","logicSentenceId":"7586684635086684186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孫空伏，妻財无炁而父爻旺動者，必潦。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635086684186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再遇日月動爻生扶者，潦必至扵浸没。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635086700570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：若重旺哀，此論何甞無理。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635086716954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予存四十餘年之占騐，天時無日不占。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635086733338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時當潦者，鬼動点雨，兄動与雨，父鬼休囚無氣者，動亦有雨。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635086749722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時當旱者，父持月建，𡖋不過濃雲重霧灑塵而已。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635086766106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故章後有云：競發父官，連朝風雨。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635086782490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡遇卦中父鬼亂發，而雨水連","logicSentenceId":"7586684635086798874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549133807616"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"绵而不止也。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635086798874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福徳帶刑，日月必蝕。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635086815258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此乃特占日月之論，不可以占隂晴之卦、偶而湊合者而妄㫁也。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635086831642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占雨，","logicSentenceId":"7586684635086864410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘父爻不動，而妻財晴動者，𮟃主晴明；占晴，","logicSentenceId":"7586684635086864410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若財子不動，而父母晴動者，還主有兩。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635086864410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊係晴利父爻之入墓，謂父爻入墓，或動而化墓，","logicSentenceId":"7630461750236659775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549133824000"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必主晴明。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750236659775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予以為非父爻入墓冲闬之時，則雨何淂利扵占晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635086913562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"悼父動化退神，勢必情也。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635086929946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如北月戊辰日久雪占晴，淂随之震。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635086946330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷曰：鬼化退神，雨将止矣。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750236676159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵酉時霧散天開。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635086962714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡淂父化退神，雨命将止；兄動化退神，雲将開矣。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750236692543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫財爻化退者，晴不久矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635086979098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余以此論是理。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635087044634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此章首句原係妻財發動，八方咸仰晴光，予故攺曰子孫發動，萬里晴光，實此意耳。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635087061018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父衰鬼旺，少雨濃雲。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635087077402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦值暗冲，雖空有望。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635087142938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金鬼動而逢空，差遇本日日建相冲，或浚遇冲空","logicSentenceId":"7586684635087536154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549133905920"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"實空之日，必然動雷。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635087536154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂之金空則响。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635087552538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金化金者，迅雷霹震；火鬼動者，電掣金蛇。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635087568922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如未月丙午日占","logicSentenceId":"7586684635087798298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何日雨，淂離之旅","logicSentenceId":"7586684635087798298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549133938688"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635087798298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：卯木父動，臨扵旬空，己酉日若不雨者，卯日必雨。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750236807231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：如何㝎在两日？","logicSentenceId":"7586684635087831066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：不難。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635087847450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"角再占一卦，又淂藏卦不動。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635087863834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：此卦還與前卦相同，爾再占一卦。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635087880218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又淂艮之謙：","logicSentenceId":"7586684635087896602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：甲寅日隂雲，乙卯日必雨，辰日而又晴矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635087912986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：何以知之？","logicSentenceId":"7586684635087929370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：此卦又是寅木鬼動，值旬空出","logicSentenceId":"7586684635087945754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549133955072"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空之日，必於天變。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635087945754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前卦卯木父變辰土子孫，故知卯日必兩，辰日必晴。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750236823615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵寅日宻雲，卯日大雨，辰日大晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635087962138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𠩄以動則不為空矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635087978522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雨遇财興，欲雨湏淂財墓绝。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635087994906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占雨湏冝父動鬼動，倘父鬼不動，又見財與子孫動者，湏待財爻入墓之日，及臨绝之日，𦆵淂有兩。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635088011290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占晴湏冝財動子動個。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635088027674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若父毋又動，湏待父爻臨墓絶之曰，方能淂晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635088044058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如戊月丙午日占","logicSentenceId":"7586684635088060442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549133971456"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何日雨，淂坎之井。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635088060442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：今日占雨，如何又動財爻？","logicSentenceId":"7586684635088093210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"想是大旱而無兩也。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750236839999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：非也。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635088109594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化出酉父，自日就當有兩，但因日建又是午火，必待戊日午火入墓，方纔有雨。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635088125978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵酉日天變，戊日而雨。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635088142362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午火財爻墓扵戌也。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635088158746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如午月乙卯日占天何日晴，淂晋之歸妹。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750236872767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549134004224"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：父鬼疂見，乃連朝風雨之象。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750236889151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"次日又占，又是鬼父同興，果雨四十餘日。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635132788763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未月甲午日占天何日雨，淂屯變益。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635132821531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大旱望雲霓。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750236905535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中父爻不動，子孫重疂，化進神，疑其亦爻入墓之日必雨。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635132837915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又令他人占之，又淂財興子動，次日又占，並無父動鬼動，知其旱矣，果扵兩月不雨。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635132854299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549134020608"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦得反吟，晴雨終湏反復。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635132870683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1tc74a/1-7630190290339446799_QQ_1776542304261.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=e%2B7YyQgf%2FKIGXI666WDWCvaFSGA%3D","pictureHeight":508,"pictureWidth":218,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1tc74a/1-7630190290339446799_QQ_1776542304261.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=0YVGe8dw%2B4r7Q2rDzVwQLJ0vNfg%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1tc74a/1-7630190290339446799_QQ_1776542304261.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如辰月庚寅日占何日晴，得觀之升。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635132887067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：卯水財現，明日必晴。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750236921919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但卦淂内外反吟，晴而還雨。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635132903451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵次日睛晴而又雨。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635132919835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻逢伏象，旱沧離待冲開。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635132936219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伏吟卦動如不動，子財動者，冲開之日必晴；父爻動者，冲開之日必雨。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635132952603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549134036992"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如辰月甲戌日占雨，淂大壮變震卦。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635132968987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占雨父爻不動，兄鬼同動，八動生風，無雨而有風也。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635132985371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽扵本日申時冲開寅木，拔木任風。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133001755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合父鬼冲開，有雷則雨；","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133018139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"含財兄尅破，無風不晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133018139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母合住，本主不雨。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750236938303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇鬼動冲開，必待雷震而浚有雨。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133034523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中若無鬼爻動，而他爻冲動者，亦必有雨；他爻又無冲動者，須待冲開之日有雨。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133050907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財子兩爻被合，亦同此推。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133067291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549134053376"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：合父鬼冲開，冲開之日必雨；合財合子，冲尅之日必晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133083675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有雷有風者，乃偶然耳，不必執之。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133100059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"半晴半雨，","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133116443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中財父同動。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133116443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊註妻財父母同興，或是子孫鬼爻同動，必然半晴半雨。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750236954687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余以此論即謬，殊不知各應其時。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133149211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如酉月癸未日占何日情，淂訟之随","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133165595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133165595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦子孫父母同興，寅木父化巳火兄，又是一日","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133181979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549134069760"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隂雨，直至戊時天開而見星斗，應戌時晴者，戊土子孫而值時也。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133181979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又雨又晴，爻上母子皆動。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133198363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如己月丙申日占何日雨，淂臨之蒙。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133214747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中父毋子孫同動，因巳火父空，交日冲空，則實亥日而雨，卽扵亥日酉時晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133231131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應酉時者，上爻動出酉金子孫之故耳。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133247515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前卦父與于孫同動，戊土子孫，應本日戊時晴；","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133263899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549134086144"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133263899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦父與子孫同動，應他日之雨晴之時也。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133263899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：卽此两卦論隂晴各有其時，豈可謂之半雨半晴耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133296667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如酉月初五戊子日占中秋月，得小過","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133329435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之豊。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133329435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中辰父發動，當許中秋有雨。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750236971071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殊不知應在初九辰日卽雨。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133345819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰月癸巳日占甲午日監造，此日雨否？","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133394971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼以父動有雨。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133411355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：甞見占日應時，且看今日申戊時而無雨者，明日實有雨也。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133427739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵本曰申時禮。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133444123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549134118912"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼又問曰：如何申時雨？","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133460507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：成土長生在申。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133476891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又問：雨乆逺否？","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133493275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：父化退神，雨之不乆，明日必晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133509659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵次日大睛。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133526043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
