{"lines":[{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：或問予曰：有動而逢合逢值，可能實知其一日也。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133542427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：昔人不知多占之法，亦不明其此理。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133558811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"錯形有之，天機未肯全洩，全在人之通變。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133575195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聖人立敎，設此天時，敎人以騐人事。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133591579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽如子孫持世發墊，占天時者，皓日當空，無雲㸃缀，及至墓绝之日，黑暗無光，若占身命，𠛴烈轟轟，揚揚淂志，浚逢墓衰","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133607963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549134135296"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之秊，災非同至。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133607963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故予首言敎人以天時而騐人事，取効之速。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133624347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今𣣔實知一日者不難。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133640731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曽因官長有事，命在旦夕，因占淂子孫持世，勸之勿憂，必蒙赦宥。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133657115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼不肯信，意欲先尋自陳。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133673499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予設一法。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133689883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉月內子日占何日雨，蒙之臨：","logicSentenceId":"7630461750237020223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊一申前卦寅木父當應寅日，此卦午火父火長生扵寅，亦是寅日。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133722651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又呌人占，淂随之屯。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133739035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又見亥水父動，知寅日而必雨也。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133755419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何也？","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133771803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥水父動，動而逢合之日，二應寅日。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133788187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余以前三卦俱應寅日而雨。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133837339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦未土動變申金子孫，此應一爻獨發，知其未時必雨，申時大晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133853723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"清晨徃彼安慰而曰：卜公之卦，子孫持世無憂。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133870107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"公不肯信，試看今日未時雨，申時晴者，公知我卦之靈，從此不湏憂也。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133886491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼留扵家，見午末未初雨從西南而来，未時大兩，申時雲散天𫔭，合家喜曰：真神卦也。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133902875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：旣知天時，何難知其人事？","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133919259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"公冝寛心。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133935643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"避半月，果蒙息赦。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133952027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此因滿城欲装擡阁以賽神，因連曰忽雨忽情，不敢装纷。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750237052991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余以此三卦合而决之，至癸未日必大晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635134099483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前卦未土財化出午火子孫，古法謂之“合住財爻”，不晴，","logicSentenceId":"7586684635134115867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予甞淂騐，冲開之日必晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635134115867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"况此卦子日占之，子水巳冲開午火，而未土不能仆合，故知未日必晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635134148635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第二爻丑土父母為雨，化出子水子孫為晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635134165019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦","logicSentenceId":"7586684635134181403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應未日冲開丑土，而子水子孫不能與丑仆合，点","logicSentenceId":"7586684635134181403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549134217216"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當晴扵未日。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635134181403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第三卦午火子孫，子日冲之而晴動，動而逢合之日，七應晴於未日，果扵癸未日萬里晴光。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635134197787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如寅月癸酉日，因連日雨，占何日晴，寅木子孫獨發，亥日不晴者，寅日必晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635134214171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"許亥日者，動而逢合之日，許寅日者，寅木值日也。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635134230555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但六不能實指一日。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635134246939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又命人占，得夬之需。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635134263323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549134233600"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前卦寅水子孫動而至晴，常有應在，動而逢合之亥日，亦有應在寅日。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635134279707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦亥水財動，故知逺日而無疑矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635134296091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"况亥值旬空，亦應實空之日。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635134312475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵亥","logicSentenceId":"7586684635134328859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日大晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635134328859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如申月己卯日早上天隂，占今日雨否，淂夬之大壮。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635134345243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因天隂而问兩，神不報雨而報酉時大晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447296051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予疑神之意雨已来矣，雨則不久，酉時卽晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447312435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵午未時小雨，申時雲開，酉時大晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447328819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦常多，後賢須冝會","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447345203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549134249984"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"意，要知雨巳来矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447345203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神不報雨而報晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447361587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：酉金爻動，動而逢冲，謂之散，又化退神，如何𡖋晴","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447377971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"？","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447377971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：旺金如何淂散？","logicSentenceId":"7630461750237069375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申金月建，如何淂退？","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447410739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如卯月甲辰日天隂占兩，淂","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447427123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"艮之乾。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447427123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：從今日天隂起，有四日不晴。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750237085759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：今日晴否？","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447459891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：辰土兄化子水財，子水長生扵申，申酉時必晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447476275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明日巳曰㦯晴㦯兩，午未日必有大雨，申日大","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447492659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549134266368"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447492659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：何以知之？","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447509043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：自初文辰土一動，連動四爻，父化鬼，兄化父，乃連朝之不晴也。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447525427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第五文子水財化申金子孫，故知申日必晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447541811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵連日咸隂，或雨或晴，直至申，日萬里無雲。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447558195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"547","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如己月朔日庚辰占一月隂晴，淂坤之","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447574579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"師。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447574579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：巳火父動，父持月建，隂雨連旬。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447590963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此爻巳火父動，又是父化兄，風雨靡常，此月天澇。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447607347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：書中雖","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447623731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549134282752"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有此說，予試不騐。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447623731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明日已曰必雨，他日未必，果扵次日小雨。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447640115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所以前篇予闢其隂雨速旬之謬，浚賢不可不察。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447656499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"593","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如己月丁亥日，因連日雨，占何日晴，得屯之噬嗑。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750237118527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外卦父化父，鬼化鬼，還有連朝風雨。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447951411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上爻子水化出巳火財爻，要到巳日方晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447967795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：鬼旺而化退，父衰而化進，何以斷之？","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447984179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：父化父，鬼化鬼，乃神告我","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448000563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"連日之風雨也，何論𦔽衰？","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448000563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要知神意，旣欲報我","logicSentenceId":"7630461750237134911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549134348288"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"連日之雨，又要報我已日之晴，非此爻象，歇盡此意。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750237134911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今又以旺衰進退言之，乃不知通變之人也。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448033331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"621","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"断曰：内卦辰土父動，又化寅木之財，辰日有兩而","logicSentenceId":"7630461750237151295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561627444592655"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不大。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750237151295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉兄化出未土父，未父又化巳火鬼，必到未日而有大雨。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448197171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵辰日小雨，未日大雨。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448213555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"626","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1tmqdm/1-7630381441076412467_QQ_1776587209093.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=2BEkz7ej%2FYGeCE7CmLs9amnbtJg%3D","pictureHeight":504,"pictureWidth":220,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1tmqdm/1-7630381441076412467_QQ_1776587209093.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=XT3fifMwD5iuuw%2FWiA5cbVYBBPo%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1tmqdm/1-7630381441076412467_QQ_1776587209093.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"627","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如寅月甲申日友約亥日逰春，予曰：連日雨雪，慮逰玩何能盡興？","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448229939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"友曰：今早占淂亥水子孫動，亥日在晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448246323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予卽卜之，淂豫之震。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448262707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：子日方晴，夜日未必。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750237167679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"友曰：我占亥水子孫，兄占子水子孫，必是亥、子日俱晴。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750237184063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：非也。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750237200447","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄占亥水子孫者，旺扵子日也，亦應子日晴，非亥日也。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750237216831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果於亥日還雪，子日大晴。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750237233215","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"643","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸書卜身命，謂“妻財子祿一卦能包，壽天窮通六爻乗盡”殊","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448311859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不知父子、財官、兄弟，各有相忌相傷，若以一卦而棄形者，卽如父母旺相，蝮慶之徵。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448311859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：父旺傷子，豈世之有父母者，皆無子嗣之人也？","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448328243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：見兄則","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448344627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561627444625423"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財莫能厂，又為尅妻之神。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448344627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：兄弟爻興，紫荆並茂。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448361011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘值旺兄持世，尅妻耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448377395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耗財邪？","logicSentenceId":"7630461750237249599","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"手足無傷耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448393779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易林補遺有曰：兄動妻若財耗散。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448410163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"執此論者，世之貧人寒士，盡皆失偶之人。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448426547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至扵財官子孫，皆同此論，不暇细辨，勢必無而欲者，卽先賢猶在，執此问之，知与無從置喙。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448442931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"656","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：余今淂其法者，分占之法也。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448459315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占父母，占兄弟，另占一卦。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448475699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占终身財福何如，占终身功名有無，占終身夫妻偕老否，占终身子嗣及壽元俱冝分","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448492083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448492083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"660","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561627444641807"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"終身財福章第三十七","logicSentenceId":"7630462821926436900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"662","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福財旺神，鐘鳴鼎食之家。","logicSentenceId":"7630462821926453284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"663","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊係既冨且壽，世爻旺相無傷。","logicSentenceId":"7630462821926469668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"664","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：占財宜扵旺相，占夀溜重世爻，未闻財福不旺而世爻獨旺，卽許冨與壽也。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448524851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"執此論之，世之多壽者，悉皆冨貴之人也。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448541235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"666","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占終身敗福，世爻財交子孫爻，三者無一失隖，㝎是家殷户足，福祿绵長。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448557619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財世旺相而福神不旺者，乃先冨浚貧之人也。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448574003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何也？","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448590387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫者，則之源也，水","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448606771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561627444658191"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無源流，終湏枯涸，謂之財旺福空，榮犀不久。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448606771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世與福爻旺相，而財爻不旺者，乃無財享福之人也。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448623155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣曰無財，焉能享福？","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448639539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此人必有現成之事業，止知坐享，不知生發。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448655923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或是財托他人掌管，止知花費，不識艰難。","logicSentenceId":"7630462821926486052","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財與福爻旺相，而世爻不旺者，乃冨厔之貧人也。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448672307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"677","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：以上之論不旺，所包者廣，無氣失陥，謂之","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448688691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不旺；得地有氣，亦謂之不旺；空破墓绝，亦謂之不旺。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448688691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561627444674575"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財福旺，而世爻不旺而有氣者，後逢生旺之年，仍復牡相，故謂之財福司權，榮華有日。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448721459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財福両旺而世爻無𪸓者，不為吉也。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448737843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖則豊衣足食，不免痴啞喑聾，或遭疾病官非，或係慳啬鄙俗。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448754227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財福两旺而世爻失陥者，更為凶也。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448770611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖有禹斛金銀，難買長生藥石。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448786995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"685","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前論财與福神，雖則不旺，六冝有氣，若失陷者，俱為凶兆。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448803379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財福失陷，五見傾家。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448819763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟動空及動而破者不妨，㝎應實破實空之年月也。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448836147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"688","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561627444690959"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財與世休囚，竈金生歷之宅。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448852531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"690","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻、財爻、福爻三者無氣，或空破墓绝，或動而變凶，乃無衣乏食之人也。","logicSentenceId":"7630462821926502436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻淂地而財福失陥者，此人身强力健，或有小謀小技，亦可支撑度日。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448868915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻福爻有氣，財無氣者，雖則貧寒，樂享清福。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448885299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻財爻有氣，福爻而無氣者，此人雖無積蓄，手頭常過金銀，或代人掌财，再得日月動爻生扶者，六許小成。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448901683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"694","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561627444707343"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如卯月甲申日占終身財福，浔復之頥。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448918067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五爻亥水財、世爻子水財，皆長生扵申日，惟不當令，却淂日建之生，獨嫌酉金福神破而化绝，生平衣祿不少，難扵蓄積成家。","logicSentenceId":"7630462821926518820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果此人自三十七歳入典鋪掌櫃，財東更換者三，此人依然在櫃，活至七旬之一，每年工食飬家。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635497627694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此應財爻持世，遇長生也。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635497644078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生四子二女。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635497660462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若執古法而兼訢者，卦中子孫破而","logicSentenceId":"7586684635497676846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561627444723727"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化绝，乃無子也。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635497676846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"703","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1tn30q/1-7630383959126458403_QQ_1776588181128.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=b%2BMLXa4h2Rzh0vpSumCwEVFxFh4%3D","pictureHeight":498,"pictureWidth":222,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1tn30q/1-7630383959126458403_QQ_1776588181128.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=60bunVHUMOgmQarHx1CtTcFrjYk%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1tn30q/1-7630383959126458403_QQ_1776588181128.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"704","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黄金策曰：“世位休囚，非貧卽夭。”","logicSentenceId":"7586684635497693230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予以為非。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635497709614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貧者須觀財福，夭者单用世爻，非夭即貧，不是卜易之理。","logicSentenceId":"7630462821926535204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"707","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世居空地，終身仆事無成。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635497725998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"708","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊註：大忌世空，一生百事無成。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635497742382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"709","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余以此論近理，但未分出旺而與動。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635497758766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻旺而空者，謂之帶旺匪空；動而空者，動不為空。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635497775150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇日建冲者，冲空則實。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635497791534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中若足，財福淂地，冲空實空之年，勃然發福，豈曰無成？","logicSentenceId":"7586684635497807918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"713","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561627444740111"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如戊月辛亥日占终身財福，淂沙之觀。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635497824302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷曰：世爻雖空，月建合之，亥日生之，子水財爻動而生世，卯年一㝎成家。","logicSentenceId":"7630462821926551588","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑年占卦，果至卯弈。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635497840686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼時鼎㝎之初，雲貴未平，此人扵川中帶出附子、黄連藥材，數坦勃然，家畜數千餘金。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635497857070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"従此置業成家，連年豊足。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635497873454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此豈可謂终身仆事無成耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586684635497889838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"720","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1tnfnu/1-7630385731761225747_QQ_1776588447482.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=ZrcT96eU9Gv6CKL%2B1JhNE43vPN4%3D","pictureHeight":520,"pictureWidth":162,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1tnfnu/1-7630385731761225747_QQ_1776588447482.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=%2FXt769o3u3qs9qjpx9xTjKLH0GE%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1tnfnu/1-7630385731761225747_QQ_1776588447482.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"721","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如酉月辛未日占終身財福，浔頥","logicSentenceId":"7586684635497906222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561627444756495"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635497906222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄父財財兄父，㫁曰：財爻持世，雖有未日拱扶，不冝旬空，且卦中無火生助，占身命之最忌也，難許成家。","logicSentenceId":"7630462821926567972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此人自二十五歳至五十外歳，東奔西走，一事無成，後因貧極，従戎外出，不知所终","logicSentenceId":"7586684635497938990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如此者，謂之生午，仆事照成可也。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635497938990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"727","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身入墓郷，到老求謀多戾。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635497971758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"728","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻有三墓，但有一墓者，若休囚無氣，主其人如醉如痴，不伶不利，動静行藏，必不響扶，凡為不遂。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635497988142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"729","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561627444772879"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：世爻者，淂臨扵日月，或日月生扶，或動而化言，不逢冲墓之年，果然顛倒","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498004526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"昏迷；及逢墓庫冲","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498004526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"開，如苖遇雨。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498004526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"請云福至心伶。","logicSentenceId":"7630462821926584356","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻中再有財福相生，或財福旺相者，陡仗冨足，故曰墓中人，逢冲之年而發，豈可謂到老而多戾耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498020910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"735","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1tnsay/1-7630413381073305615_QQ_1776594521954.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=gUjOYZG4vgo9vtltGxMSh9bnJJk%3D","pictureHeight":510,"pictureWidth":226,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1tnsay/1-7630413381073305615_QQ_1776594521954.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=aH0Psi6Ne4LnkVCL1Ju1sreGrJw%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1tnsay/1-7630413381073305615_QQ_1776594521954.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"736","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如午月丙戌日占終身財福，得莭卦。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498037294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此人旺財臨世，平素手有餘錢，亦因世入戌墓，酷","logicSentenceId":"7630462821926600740","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561627444789263"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"好痴賭。","logicSentenceId":"7630462821926600740","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後至己年，囙開鉛鑛，連闬數穴，冨冠一郷。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498053678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：古法常應冲𫔭戊墓之年，此卦而應冲世之年。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498070062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"742","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦宫衰弱根基淺，爻象豊隆命運髙。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498086446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"743","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻象興隆，占身命最重。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498102830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻、財爻、福爻淂遇生扶，自𦀟命運髙强，惟卦宫之衰弱者不騐。","logicSentenceId":"7630462821926617124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"常見根基淺薄之人，卦宫極旺，不可為法。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498119214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若问成家，嫌六冲之為卦。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498135598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"747","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊註：凡遇六冲，必主其人作事有始無终。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498151982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前卦六","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498168366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561627444805647"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冲，前三十年生涯次泊；後卦六冲，三十年浚家業凋零。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498168366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：非也。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498184750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若只以两卦六冲，㫁六十年之休咎，而世與財福置之於何地？","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498201134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若世福財爻無氣，再遇六冲卦者是也。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498217518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"754","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1to4y2/1-7630414341179441194_QQ_1776594641240.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=k9bdGbY0tFMkwbjIydNjtL0Xz4w%3D","pictureHeight":508,"pictureWidth":226,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1to4y2/1-7630414341179441194_QQ_1776594641240.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=LwPYFkaGy0IMqh03vG9vKbcpCMo%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1to4y2/1-7630414341179441194_QQ_1776594641240.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"755","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如寅月乙巳日占財福，淂大壯。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498233902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余見此卦世旺、官旺、文旺，見其人才品異常，问曰：近朱冋作何事？","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498250286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：在庠。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498266670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因家寒，意欲行醫，不知財福何如？","logicSentenceId":"7630462821926633508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：卦中官文両旺，寅年必有際遇，午","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498283054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561627444822031"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未年㝎登金榜。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498283054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伊曰：予知不能，竟無此念。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498299438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：爾雖以財惟问，而神告曰：将来還可成名。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498315822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後果扵寅年醫好富翁，厚贈讀書。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498332206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午年一榜，富翁及親友又贈援例縣令，未㡬丁艱，及至補缺，未㡬𦊱誤而歸，囊箧消","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498348590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498348590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應寅年者，寅年而實空也；應午年發者，世爻而值年也","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498381358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"；功名反復而不久者，六冲之卦也","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498381358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"；窟囊消索者，子水財爻绝扵日也。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498381358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"770","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"安知創業，喜六合而成爻。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498414126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"771","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊註：占身命淂六合卦，主其人春風和氣，交游必","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498430510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561627444838415"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"善，謀事多逐。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498430510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若前合後合，主一生利逹，百事如心。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498446894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予以至其人善扵交遊，春風和氣者有之，若以百事如心，未必然也。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498463278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必以用神乗之，爻象吉者，吾之又𠮷；爻象凶者，合六無益。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498479662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"777","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動身自旺，羈力撑持。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498496046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"778","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊註：世爻不遇日辰動爻生扶，而自强自旺，其人必白手成家。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498512430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此果屢騐。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498528814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但須財爻持世，而自強自旺，多見成家。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498545198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若兄父官鬼持世，未必成家，侄可撑持而己。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498561582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"782","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561627444854799"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如申月壬子日占终身財福，世臨辰土，旺扵子日，並無刑傷冲尅，鳥無生扶，真可謂之自独自旺。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498577966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此人向来稍有家業，因賭致貧。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498594350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今问将来還有發旺否？","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498610734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：兄爻持世，永無發福之秋。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498627118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且世爻逢退，難許長年。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498643502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後當夫頭，死扵丑年。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498659886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"789","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1tohl6/1-7630407127144824883_QQ_1776594867526.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=g9MnyWax3p4%2F7pjmqmEDUqqH01Y%3D","pictureHeight":500,"pictureWidth":142,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1tohl6/1-7630407127144824883_QQ_1776594867526.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=gECwQnBGjog6X3jyIkFHXXo4Qds%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1tohl6/1-7630407127144824883_QQ_1776594867526.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"790","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衰世遇扶，因人剏立。","logicSentenceId":"7630462821926649892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"791","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此果屢騐。","logicSentenceId":"7630462821926666276","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻無氣，淂遇日月動爻，有一而生扶者，必有好人提技。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498676270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但忌要財爻持世，或日月動爻","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498692654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561627444871183"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"作財以生世，因人照看成家。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498692654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若兄父持世，僅可度日。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498709038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"屢","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498725422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見日月生世，貴人生世，常得官貴垂青。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498725422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"799","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1tou8a/1-7630416429149552690_QQ_1776594980025.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=VUnInJ7u%2BUvDwRshjrVAGG1Xluk%3D","pictureHeight":506,"pictureWidth":214,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1tou8a/1-7630416429149552690_QQ_1776594980025.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=aBNFw6pwy7KBpriT00zTieKrfh4%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1tou8a/1-7630416429149552690_QQ_1776594980025.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"800","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如丑月內辰日占终身財福，淂未濟之暌。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498741806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"801","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：兄爻持世，耗財之神，雖淂寅木相生，而財不聚。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498758190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：作何事可以成家？","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498774574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：木生火旺，木火通明，胸中靈巧，况朱雀臨父，聿硯可以營生。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498790958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"浚囙叔父仆衙门，命之貼𭂁，淂上人之意，儘可度日，而財","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498807342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561627444887567"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不聚。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498807342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"叔父提抜者，應寅木，父爻生世，又是茟硯","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498823726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"營生","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498823726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498823726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"810","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日時合胁，一生偏淂小人心；嵗月尅冲，半世未沾君子徳。","logicSentenceId":"7630462821926682660","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"811","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻不論旺衰，但淂歲月日建有一而生扶者，仕者君息寵愛，君子相親，下人忠敬，平人者必淂貴客扶持。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498856494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：父来生得父軰之㤙，兄来尅受兄之累。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498872878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此則間有騐者，不可執之。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498889262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻有氣，或被日月有一而冲尅者，仕者上位相陵，同軰不睦，小人毀謗。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498905646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"815","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若太歳五爻中尅者，君恩","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498922030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561627444903951"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"失寵，世若休囚者更甚。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498922030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平人而淂此者，官貴欺凌，親朋妬忌，下軰欺侮。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498938414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世若休囚更甚。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498954798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"820","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇龍子而無氣，他清髙二是寒儒。","logicSentenceId":"7630462821926699044","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"821","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此果屢騐。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498971182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡得青龍子孫持世，必然立志髙逺，不慕富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635498987566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽子孫無氣，六主绝俗超群，寕甘寒薄。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635499003950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"824","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1tp6ve/1-7630413381073928207_QQ_1776595141191.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=C0BCpF%2BMxKSV0qFkxqTilnpsDQQ%3D","pictureHeight":502,"pictureWidth":220,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1tp6ve/1-7630413381073928207_QQ_1776595141191.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=I%2B%2BFOqGqu4wc3jXH3o%2FL2oqsnL8%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1tp6ve/1-7630413381073928207_QQ_1776595141191.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"825","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如酉月癸丑日占终身除㓛名之外，何事可為？","logicSentenceId":"7586684635499020334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561627444920335"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：財星伏扵二爻，又值旬空，正所謂内外無財，伏又空，財莫能聚。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635499036718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且喜子孫楣發，遇青龍，雖不持世，𡖋主清髙。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635499053102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生平非義不取，不以冨貴後心。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635499069486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：租有恩蔭，己讓舍第承襲，今欲扶枝遍逰，取樂山水，可能如願否？","logicSentenceId":"7586684635499085870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余曰：亥水子孫變鬼，財爻又空，子宛妻空，绝俗離塵之輩，如有此志，此卦騐之極矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635499102254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：予年四十有三，二十一嵗妻亡之後，竟未續纷，子女皆無。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635499118638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：卦之相合，必如其願。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635499135022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後","logicSentenceId":"7586684635499151406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"835","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"闻此人逰川廣滇黔，及至十餘載之後，致書扵家，竟入華","logicSentenceId":"7586684635499151406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561627444936719"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山，不知所終。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635499151406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"838","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觉子曰：予因父子兄財官鬼各有相忌，難以一卦决之，是以分占淂理。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635499167790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然六有不占財福，卦中現出旺財，不问功名，爻象現出官旺，目下刑妻尅子，不待另占，卦中先現刑傷，不可不细加詳查。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635499184174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"840","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：旣謂分占，何故又言𠔥㫁？","logicSentenceId":"7586684635499200558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：此理難向俗人而言，来人欲占事者，其機動矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635499216942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人之至親，莫過扵骨肉，人之浔志，莫過扵利名。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635499233326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神不告已问之事，而告未问之事者，以重大者而先告也。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635499249710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽如此卦，福遇青","logicSentenceId":"7586684635851587594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561627444953103"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍，清髙之客；子孫變鬼，绝後之人，兼之財伏而空，乃是離塵絶俗。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635851587594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以此數事，正合福遇青龍，清髙之客也。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635851603978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"似此顯而易見，何須另卜再占","logicSentenceId":"7586684635851620362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"？","logicSentenceId":"7586684635851620362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"850","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不然，此財爻者，以之為財帛空郎，以之為妻楼空耶？","logicSentenceId":"7630462821926715428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"851","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢虎妻而旰強，雖鄙俗偏為冨客。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635851653130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"852","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊註謂白掃臨財持世，其人雖不知禮義，能必家","logicSentenceId":"7586684635851669514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"853","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"道殷實。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635851669514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"854","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此果有騐。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635851702282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"855","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：旺財若有制服，𡖋粗知文墨。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635851718666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此又非理之論。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635851735050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺財逢制，乃應将米之破败也，豈以文墨言？","logicSentenceId":"7586684635851751434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158270483"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2","lineNum":0,"lineType":4,"content":"卷六","logicSentenceId":"7679047739829813263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如午月丙子日占世應財福，得𢑱之豊。","logicSentenceId":"7679047739829829647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉亥","logicSentenceId":"7679047739829846031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"母土，亥午火，丑卯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世臨白虎，化出，旺財生世，果此人目不識丁，鄙俗不堪，農庄儘可度日，人丁六畜豊盛。","logicSentenceId":"7679047739829846031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊年占卦，值子年，庒被蝗䖝食盡，全家瘟疫，六畜亦瘟。","logicSentenceId":"7679047739829862415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應子年者，占時原有子日冲其午火，因午火而值月建，可以相敵，今遇子年，増其冲尅，所以破敗。","logicSentenceId":"7679047739829878799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母持身，辛勤勞碌，鬼爻持世，疾病绵纏。","logicSentenceId":"7679047739829895183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇兄則財莫能聚，遇子則身不犯刑。","logicSentenceId":"7679047739829911567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158286867"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黄金策自此之後，皆非理也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047739829927951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母官鬼持世，竟可以勞碌疾病而斷邪？","logicSentenceId":"7679047739829944335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊註：有云：貴人占者，不可以此㫁之。","logicSentenceId":"7679047739829960719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼占身命，馬知不是貴人，便實知不是貴人，青知将来不貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679047739829977103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曽有人占財福，酉月壬辰日應世，占淂恒卦，","logicSentenceId":"7679047739829993487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戌申午酉亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑財官子官父財。","logicSentenceId":"7679047739829993487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"问曰：爾適間禱告，曽问功名否？","logicSentenceId":"7679047739830009871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：生意之人，何有㓛名之念？","logicSentenceId":"7679047739830026255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：此卦財生官旺，竟可问名。","logicSentenceId":"7679047739830042639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：","logicSentenceId":"7679047739830059023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158303251"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天有落下來之官，亦不到我頭上。","logicSentenceId":"7679047739830059023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命再占名，世應淂噬嗑變否。","logicSentenceId":"7679047739830075407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳","logicSentenceId":"7679047739830091791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"未酉財，辰寅子父。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子","logicSentenceId":"7679047739830091791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官","logicSentenceId":"7679047739830091791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財兄未。","logicSentenceId":"7679047739830091791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：世爻未土之財，變出申金之官，明明以財而變官。","logicSentenceId":"7679047739830108175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前卦財旺生官者，因世臨月建之官，辰日冲動戌土之財，暗動生世，雖可許名，不敢指以年月。","logicSentenceId":"7679047739830124559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後卦世臨未土，動而逢空，實空之年，包爾出仕。","logicSentenceId":"7679047739830140943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵卯年援例入監。","logicSentenceId":"7679047739830157327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳年初任兵馬，即加納縣令，未","logicSentenceId":"7679047739830173711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158319635"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年再任江南。","logicSentenceId":"7679047739830173711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊註：官鬼持世，疾病綿纒，若是貴人，勿以此㫁。","logicSentenceId":"7679047739830190095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此人原非貴人，豈可謂之疾病绵纏耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679047739830206479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如巳月己丑日，占终身財福，得歸妹之臨。","logicSentenceId":"7679047739830222863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌申午丑卯巳，官父兄未父財官。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070704660515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：卦中財福不旺，而官文兩旺，如何不问求名？","logicSentenceId":"7679048070704676899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：功名之念已灰。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070704693283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：世臨日建，月建生身，必主顯貴薦舉，巳午年，富貴逼人来也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070704709667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵午年保","logicSentenceId":"7679048070704726051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158336019"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舉，雖非科甲，身為科甲之官，此豈可謂父母持身，辛勤勞碌耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679048070704726051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母臨身，勞碌貧寒之輩。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070704742435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：黄金策乃卜筮之宗，未有占身命而以父子財官兼㫁之理。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070704758819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余曰：旣不為信，卽看父母持身之解註，便可知矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070704775203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂占身不可見父兄官鬼持世，世爻遇父，則尅傷子女，一生勞碌，不淂安逸。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070704791587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豈非父為尅子之神，又為一生勞碌之神耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679048070704807971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"執此論之，但遇父爻持世，不獨勞碌，抑且無子，世之無子者，悉","logicSentenceId":"7679048070704824355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158352403"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"皆勞碌之人也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070704824355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：占㓛名，父母持世，以之為詩書文館，如占財福，以之為勞碌辛勤。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070704840739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官不旺而父旺者，雖不見用扵朝廷，名盛文傳，衰而又逢冲尅，卽欲寄食扵公门，凶多吉少。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070704857123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如于月乙未日，占終身財福，得兊卦。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070704873507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未酉亥丑卯巳，父兄子父財官，㫁曰：卯木之財，而入未曰之墓，巳火之官，休囚無氣，名不能成，利不能就。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070704889891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惜乎旺父臨身，財彌髙而","logicSentenceId":"7679048070704906275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158368787"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"利彌寡，况淂卦遇六冲，一事無成之象。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070704906275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後見屢逢顯貴，聘之才高氣傲，皆不得皆不得，瓜期而辭歸矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070704922659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目撃十有餘載，貧寒淡泊，後随表弟陞任雲南，不知所終。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070704939043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如午月壬寅日，占終身財福，得豊卦。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070704955427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌、申、午、亥、丑、卯，鬼父、財兄、鬼子。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070704971811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古以占財者，喜之尅世，却不知占目下之财者，财尅世者必得。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070704988195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占终身之財福者，不冝財爻尅也，乃生平受財之累，因財之害也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705004579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且嫌父母持世，一世","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705020963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158385171"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無安逸之日，休囚又遇日冲，而為日破，如蜂釀蜜，誰苦誰甘？","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705020963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果此人原係農庒之貧人也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705037347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勞碌勤耕，稍成家業。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705053731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後因逆子賭摶，首其子，並告窩赌之人。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705070115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其人自縊，致成人命，產業蕩費，氣鬱而亡，探之死扵午年，乃囙世爻申金，午月尅之，寅日中之，故逢火尅而死。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705086499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄又臨世，財耗貧寒。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705102883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊係遇兄則財莫能跟。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705119267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觧註有云：世逢兄爻，必尅妻妾，一生必不跟財。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705135651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣以之為尅妻，又以之為破","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705152035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158401555"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耗。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705152035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"執此而論，世之傷妻者，皆貧困之人也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705168419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假使貧者偕老，冨者㫁法，何以决之？","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705184803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故予以分占之法，實得理也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705201187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：凡占財福，見父持世，雖不許之富足，亦看旺哀。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705217571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺則貧而好義，衰則多疾招非。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705233955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得日月生扶，貧而樂。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705250339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得日月作，財而合世，冨而驕。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705266723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺臨蛇虎元武，奸盗詐偽之兇頑。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705283107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衰遇勾陳雀武，背負肩挑之窮漢。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705299491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"受尅受制，下賤隸卒。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705315875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得合得扶，上人擡舉，全在人之活變，觀其輕重而言。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705332259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158417939"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官衰無破，公門異術資生。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705348643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官鬼持世，休囚無氣者，乃綿缠疾病殘病之人也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705365027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若有貴者，或入公門，或挟術行道。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705381411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再遇日月動爻，貴人扶助，皆得貴客相親，從此成家立業。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705397795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財若無氣，空有虚名而己。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705414179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財弱有扶，商賈百工事業。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705430563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財爻福爻自来旺相者，或商㦯賈，或守農庄，乃生成之冨足，樂享豊饒。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705446947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘遇衰財扶世，或臨日月動爻，生扶合助者，暴發興家，守農庄，年時豊稔，習工","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705463331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158434323"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"藝，巧奪天工，慕道修行。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705463331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"皆為子孫持世。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705479715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫乃恬澹之神。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705496099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如若持世，孤立無助，又遇財爻失陥者，若有髙尚之志，許之為道為僧。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705512483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若無出家之念，不可妄㫁。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705528867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殊不知見子則身不犯刑，計之生平，不犯官刑可也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705545251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"家傾名喪，乃因官鬼傷身。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705561635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡遇官鬼尅世，世爻旺者，生平多招刑憲，或招嫉妬，或小人暗害，或殘疾纒身。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705578019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若鬼旺身哀，乃身喪","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705594403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158450707"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"家傾之兆，勸之不必以財福為问，速尋趨避之法可也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705594403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如世爻動而變鬼尅世，及日月作官鬼而尅世者，更凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705610787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如辰月甲寅日，占終身財福，得風澤中。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705627171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"孚變水澤莭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：世爻臨未土，辰月助之，亦作有氣，但嫌日建傷身。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705643555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上爻卯水之鬼，化出子水之財，正謂之助鬼以傷身也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705659939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不必以財福為问，可问凶災。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705676323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：可逺避否？","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705692707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：今年九月、十月不可出門，可以避之。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705709091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705725475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158467091"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"扵九月蒙官差遣，此人雇人代頂而去，中途遇害。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705725475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"似此之法，禍亦可避。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705741859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如卯月癸未日，占終身財福，得革之家人。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705758243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外卦，世與日月同為三合，以為吉卦，不冝世爻變鬼，又化回頭之尅。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705774627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上爻，未土又尅目下，雖則無妨，今年丑月冲開其合，或是酉月冲開卯木，湏妨不測。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705791011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果至巳月而生惡瘡，卒扵酉月。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705807395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財化退𠔃，不利扵己。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705823779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158483475"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財爻持世，化進神，或動而生世者，事業從此而進，家道自此豐亨。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705840163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若化退神，家業自此漸退，日剥月削，漸至消索。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705856547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若世爻再被刑冲尅害者，非漸退也，災非卽見，物覆財傾。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705872931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世逢合住，受制扵人。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705889315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世臨財爻，或被日月動爻合住，雖則豊衣足食，㝎然受制扵人，事不由己。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705905699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻若臨父兄者，而得日月動爻合住，衣食僅可度日，難扵豊足。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705922083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158499859"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻無氣而被合，財福無氣，兄動乹中，乃奔走受制之下賤也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705938467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"終身功名有無章弟三十八","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705954851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
