{"lines":[{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官父興隆，文章見用。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705971235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡淂旺父持世，官動生之，或官星持世，父爻旺動。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705987619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或官星父爻旺動，生合世爻，或日月作官星，父母，生合世爻，皆主成名之象。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070706004003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"學成文武藝，貨與帝王家，鬼財摇發，纳栗成名。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070706020387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158516243"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官星持世，財動相生，或丗臨官，動化財，或世臨財，動化官，或官星、財星動而生合世爻，或日月作官星、財星，生合世爻，皆主納粟以奏名也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070706036771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如辰月乙未日，占世應，终身功名有無，得地火明𢑱變豊。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070706053155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此公原是武䕃，已任𤰞官，目病告退，卽無官矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070706069539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"问：将来還有功名否？","logicSentenceId":"7679048070706085923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦丑土官星持世，化出午火，財旺生官，卯年占卦，巳年援例，連連加纳，官至府","logicSentenceId":"7679048070706102307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158532627"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"佐，未年出仕，戌年陞任黄堂。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070706102307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古法以動而逢冲謂之散。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070706118691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此係未冲世爻之丑土，竟不見其散也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070706135075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如戌月壬子日，占終身功名有無。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070706151459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得困之兌卦。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070706167843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：寅木財爻持世，化出官星，終身之功名，以財而淂之也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070706184227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：目下意欲援例。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070706200611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：援例必妥，第恐不能出仕，六合優以冲，有始無终之象，果已考職，忽害眼疾，雙目失明，","logicSentenceId":"7679048070706216995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158549011"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獨旺扵官，立功建業。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070706216995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡卦中財典父爻，皆不淂地，而官星獨旺，或日月作官星而生世，或虎臨世動，或乕臨金鬼動而生合世爻，皆主立功以成名也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070706233379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如戊月戊辰日，占應世，终身功名有無，淂寅子戊酉亥丑蛊卦。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070706249763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄父財，官父財、日月作財生世，白乕臨金官持世，若入文途，必以援倒。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070706266147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若入武途，可以立功。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070706282531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：有功名否？","logicSentenceId":"7679048947368722484","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：官","logicSentenceId":"7679048947368738868","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158565395"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"星持世，日月生之，豈曰無官，後此人亦未食糧，竟随營破寨，奮勇當先，主帥嘉之，即以職官，不出五載，連建竒功，官至元戎。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947368738868","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947368755252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如辰月己巳日：占戌。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947368771636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"申官，午卯巳未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"終身功名有位否？","logicSentenceId":"7679048947368788020","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財自子，兄子財，此公考過州佐，因缺少人多，问将来淂缺否？","logicSentenceId":"7679048947368804404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予見此卦五爻，申官化進神長生，有巳日辰月生之，但嫌不來生合世爻，疑是應扵獨發，請再卜之。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947368820788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：攺日虔誠再卜。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947368837172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：更好。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947368853556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158581779"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰月丁未日，世應占得晋之姤，","logicSentenceId":"7679048947368869940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"未巳卯巳父，酉財官，未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官申兄、酉亥父。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947368869940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余囙此卦參悟前卦。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947368886324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前卦官化進神，動扵五位，不臨世合世，非分内之官也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947368902708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦内得反吟，巳火之官被亥水冲去，明明現出，分内之官，已冲壞矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947368919092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"将来之功名，非此考定之州佐也，另有奇𠁅。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947368935476","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：従何而得？","logicSentenceId":"7679048947368951860","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余曰：前卦官搖五位，官出特恩。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947368968244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦未土日建動扵五位，似長生而生世爻，必得勅㫖而立","logicSentenceId":"7679048947368984628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158598163"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"軍功。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947368984628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此公亦知易理，问曰：兄父持世，如何有官？","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369001012","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余曰：此膠柱也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369017396","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若非世值兄交，何淂五位之文書而生世，官星旺化進神，前卦已㝎就矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369033780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼又问曰：此時多事之際，正有此念，不知何方為吉？","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369050164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：前卦申官化酉官，此卦世爻又臨酉金，西去大利。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369066548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果徃西行。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369082932","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未㡬連立奇功，官至副使，加衔方伯。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369099316","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午年升任山東。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369115700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歳五生世，平歩登雲。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369132084","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡淂太歲及五爻生世，或日月入爻動而生世，皆","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369148468","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158614547"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主庶民食祿，平步登雲。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369148468","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"湏要太歲入爻，又冝發動。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369164852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘淂五爻生世，六要發動，而世與官星鳥冝旺相，方可㫁之。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369181236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古有存騐。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369197620","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙戌年戌月乙卯日，占闻駕至。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369214004","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"吉凶何如？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此人雖係庶民，乃一方之首領，忽闻駕至，迎之而淂将軍之爵。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369230388","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太嵗與五爻月建動而合世，世爻卯木之官又臨日建，神之徴騐如此，此非知我者神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369246772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158630931"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福徳動搖，豈是廟廊之容。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369263156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡得子孫持世，卦中子孫發動，終非貴客。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369279540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如戌月丁卯日，占终身功名有無，得需卦。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369295924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：子孫持世，休问㓛名。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369312308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：作何事可以成名？","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369328692","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：任甭才能𠋣馬，力能舉鼎，終身不許成名。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369345076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但此人㓛名之念切甚，讀書苦勝囊螢，文重當時，竟未遊泮。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369361460","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後從戎二十餘載，或立軍㓛，或援例纳粟，","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369377844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158647315"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奔馳扵名利之塲，皓首無成。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369377844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此子孫尅官之徴","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369394228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"騐也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破空臨世，终湏白屋之人。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369394228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世静而臨，旬空月破，官逢月破旬空，皆主不淂成名。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369410612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟世與官星空破而動者，不以此㫁。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369426996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如己月乙卯日應世，占終身功名，得旅己未酉、申午辰，肃兄子財、財兄子。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369443380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：雖是爻逢六合，嫌其子孫持世，官逢月破，勿想成名。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369459764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：業己援例。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369476148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：費盡萬金，终難食祿。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369492532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158663699"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後至子年淂病，丑年淂蠱疾而終。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369508916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又扵寅月丁卯日，曽占一人，巳考職矣，问後運、陞選何如，亦得此卦。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369525300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌年在地方多事，被人告發，革織","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369541684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"提问。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"終身功名之占，止知功名之有無。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369541684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中若現功名者，再问或文或武，㦯入公门，任其本念，指其事而占之，其騐如响。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369558068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"君以一卦妄以文武㫁之，乃欺人之法也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369574452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曾遇武隂，占终身功名，卽此功名，终身還是另有功名。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369590836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朱龍武虎蛇勾","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369607220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158680083"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯月戊子日，占世應，得大過，變井未酉","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369607220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"亥。酉亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"廿","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369607220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"父。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官、申官父財，斷曰：另有㓛名。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369607220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中之酉金官星已臨破矣，卽是身上現在之官也，破而無用。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369623604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"幸世爻化出申金之官，回頭生世，申乃今年之太歲，将来另有顯爵，出自特恩。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369639988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：従何而得？","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369656372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：元武臨亥水，父爻發。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369672756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動，必目息盗安民之策而淂之也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369689140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：我何能有此長才？","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369705524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又问：應在何時？","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369721908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：寅年淂官，申年出仕，","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369738292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158696467"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後果因盜賊之事，除首有功。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369738292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅年叙功，先得武爵，後又改為文職。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369754676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申年陞任陕西副使，随陞粤東臬憲，亥年㘴陞藩䑓。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369771060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予扵子年到公署，又占。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369787444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯月辛丑日，占浚應世運㓛名，得歸妹。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369803828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"變戍申。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369820212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午丑","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369836596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"。卯財。巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"震父兄官父寅鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369836596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：我特逺来，指望占得𠮷卦，預報開府，奈何事與心違，不惟不能開府，且有退休之兆。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369852980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"公曰：何也？","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369869364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：月建之財，現扵卦象，尅世尅父，雖無币動，難","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369885748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158712851"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"免長上之災。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369885748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世点逢傷，自身六有險厄。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369902132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵寅年丁父艱，卯年回籍，至中途淂病而终，乃因丑土父母持世，叠叠卯木而相尅也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369918516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"壽元章第三十九","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369934900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻旺相，永享長年。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369951284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身位休囚，湏防大折。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369967668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占夀元，獨以世爻為根本。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369984052","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻㦯旺或相，或臨日月，或淂日月生扶，及動爻生扶，或動而化生化旺、化回頭生者，乃大壽之徴也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947370000436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻休囚，防之扵冲尅之年，再有刑傷尅害者，動","logicSentenceId":"7679048947370016820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158729235"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而逢合逢值之年，静而達值逢冲之年，皆在應期章内斷之。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947370016820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"休囚随鬼入墓，衰逢助鬼之傷，皆為凶兆。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947370033204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世動化退化鬼，及化囬頭之尅，化绝化墓、化破化空，夕陽無限好，只恐不多時。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947370049588","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"皆扵應期章内决之。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947370065972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應如辰月乙巳日，卯巳未、丑卯巳占壽，淂中孚，","logicSentenceId":"7679048947370082356","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼父兄，兄，鬼父。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世臨未土，巳日生之，月建扶之，遂児孫期頤之祝，必享長年。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947370082356","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：看在何時？","logicSentenceId":"7679048947370098740","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：古以初爻管五年，","logicSentenceId":"7679048947370115124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158745619"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二爻管五年，共作三十年。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947370115124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再占一卦，又作三十年。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947370131508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余試四十餘載，並無應騐，不以為法，止以世爻衰。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947370147892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺而㫁長短，欺人之法，予不為之，依此卦象，過二十載，公再卜之。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947370164276","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此人占卦之時，五十三矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947370180660","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後至七旬之一，相遇而曰：向年所占夀元，還可記否？","logicSentenceId":"7679048947370197044","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：占得中孚卦，原許二十年。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947370213428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後再占。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947370229812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼咲而占。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947370246196","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申月己卯日，占淂應世山","logicSentenceId":"7679048947370262580","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"澤損變復卦。寅子戊鬼，丑卯己鬼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉财兄兄父寅。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947370262580","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158762003"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：適间若是一爻鬼動，公之壽則不久矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947370278964","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今見多鬼揺發，反為不碍。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947370295348","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今年太𡻕在子，還享八年之福，至未年是其時也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947370311732","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：何也？","logicSentenceId":"7679048947370328116","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：未年者，鬼多入墓，又是世逢年破，果終扵未年七月。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947370344500","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如巳月己酉日，占夀，得大畜之泰。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486162979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"應世，寅鬼。子戌。辰夤，子鬼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：世臨寅木之鬼，晚景多災，世值休囚，又逢日尅，今嵗流年太歲在辰，還可保其無碍。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486179363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"防申年木绝扵申，浚扵未年，淂蠱症，交春之日而死。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486195747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此六卦","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486212131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158778387"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之奇騐也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486212131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元神冝扵安静占壽世為根本，元神為滋生之物，冝旺而静，不冝動揺。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486228515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其故何也？","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486244899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占他事，冝元神動者，動則而有力也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486261283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占夀，元不冝發動，動則巳有期限矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486277667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"非元神值绝墓之年，卽在元神被冲尅之嵗。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486294051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如亥月丁卯日，占乂世夀，淂妬之小畜","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486310435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"。戌申午火，酉亥。丑父。未土。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父兄。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486310435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486326819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兄子子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158794771"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486326819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：世臨丑土，化子水而合之，應爻午火生之，乃為世爻淂地長壽之徵，然反不冝火動生土，猶恐子年冲去午火，是其時也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486343203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果卒扵子年。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486359587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應子年者，世爻動而逢合之年，又是冲去午火，不能生世。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486375971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如辰月乙卯曰，世應。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486392355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占壽淂中𤓳之。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486408739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸卯","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486425123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"。巳未父兄。丑卯，巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486425123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未酉兄鬼父。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486441507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：世爻未土，月拱日尅，可以敵之，反不冝巳火動而生世。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486457891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今嵗太嵗在申，予恐亥年不利，後卒扵","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486474275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158811155"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌年。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486474275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應在巳火入墓之年也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486490659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌神最怕動搖。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486507043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌神不動，自是平安，動則已有限期矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486523427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"非應逢合之年，必應逢值之歳。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486539811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應如寅月己酉日，占寅","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486556195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子成子父。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯巳","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486556195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"未父。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩，淂剝之旡妄。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486556195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486572579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午财鬼子，㫁曰：世化申金，回頭之生，不冝寅月冲破，又嫌戌未二土動而尅水，有尅而無生也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486572579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"湏防卯嵗。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486588963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果呼扵卯年，乃應戌犬逢合之年尅世也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486605347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158827539"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如酉月癸亥日，應世占夀，淂𣳾之明𢑱，戊交丑辰","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486621731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寅鬼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子子財，兄兄丑財，此卦寅木鬼動而尅世，當應寅年亥年，却死于辰年，世爻所值之年也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486621731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃是世爻辰土逢𫝕年，而𮞸鬼尅應世。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486638115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如子月乙交，曰：","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486654499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子兄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戍申丑卯己占终身財福，卯鬼父鬼子財。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486654499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：勿以財問，问夀可也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486670883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳火世爻，日月冲尅，豈","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486687267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158843923"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當子水又加尅之？","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486687267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三十六歳逢丑年，湏防水厄。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486703651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：此其何故？","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486720035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：坎宫屬水，日辰月建，是水，又動出子水，是以防之。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486736419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忽扵世年卯月卒，卯世應日，楊友偕一人占流，未酉交丑","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486752803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卯財。巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年，淂兌之随父兄子父寅鬼，㫁曰：今年六月，若非井中之險，逢竹木之災。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486752803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中日月尅世，二爻寅卯又尅，目下世空，可以不碍。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486769187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六月世爻出空，逢羣木以傷，數保無危。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486785571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"楊友曰：此位","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486801955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158860307"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"姓郭，前歳占身，数許，今年不利，今又如此，果然底耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486801955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：數與數合，不獨于低。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486818339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後果于六月随主避暑園林。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486834723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二十九日，向人而言曰：某人説我必死，今日念九，飯吃七碗，如何淂死？","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486851107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"少刻，持褲徃塘內，在獨木船上洗之，忽然船已離岸，岸上一人呌曰：無怪乎，某人説甭死于水中，今船離岸，不死何為？","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486867491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其人心忙，以手划船，而船不動，竟下水，欲以一手板船，一手戊之，豈知船輕，連人而覆，旣𢀸于木，又死。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486883875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"于水。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486900259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"少刻，主人随令家人戽乾船水，呌兩人番船，","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486916643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158876691"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"竟番不過，豈非數耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486916643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古法占流年財尅世者，以財㫁之。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486933027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予竟以本多尅世，防木為害。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486949411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"千金賦曰：卦遇凶星，避之則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486965795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦忌神動搖，世爻空三，豈可避邪？","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486982179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世又如午月己丑日戊申午","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486998563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卯財巳未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占壽，淂否之遯卦。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947486998563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父兄鬼申鬼父，㫁曰：𬼘卦不可㝎壽，世與妻財同化回頭之尅，间有應扵傷妻，湏再占一卦，","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487014947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158893075"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世又淂比之屯子戊","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487014947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"申卯巳未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財，兄子鬼父，","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487014947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兄子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻随鬼入墓，故知前卦乃應自身之夀也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487014947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但不敢以年月㫁之。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487031331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：湏求直判。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487047715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：非我不言，因卦中之年月難㝎，世爻卯朩，有應，逢值，有應，逢冲，有應木絶於申，有應木墓於未，再占一卦，可以决之。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487064099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應又淂蒙之臨","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487080483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寅子父戌午辰寅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158909459"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉鬼子兄子。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487080483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"父巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：此卦淂其年也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487096867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上下寅木動而尅世，木墓之年，乃未年也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487113251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：有凶事否？","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487129635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：前卦木被金傷，臨元武而動，湏防盜賊。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487146019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後扵申年，城破而亡，還應木绝扵申也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487162403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"趨避章弟四十","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487178787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聖人作易，原令人趨吉避凶，若使吉不可趨，凶不可避，聖人作之何益，世人卜之何用？","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487195171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：年灭月禍，可以避之，死生如何能避？","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487211555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：安于正寢者，雖有可避","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487227939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158925843"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之方，亦不湏避。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487227939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"康莭先生臨終，呼弟子沐浴更衣，群弟子哭曰：先生何不息神辟榖，以樂天年？","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487244323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先生曰：不怕二程夫子咲，要作神仙有甚難？","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487260707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故曰可避而不避也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487277091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若占淂𢀸扵水者，莫近河邉，𢀸扵刑者，不可違條犯法，未有不化㓙而為𠮷也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487293475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曽扵漢口卯月壬寅日占索應世債，淂否？","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487309859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"益之中字卯巳未𪣗","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487326243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寅兄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子兄子財財桇父。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487326243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158942227"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此人欲渡江索債，因屢取不淂，欲與之厮闹，问：淂财否？","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487342627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成非否？","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487359011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予見此卦本日日辰動化進神尅世，因世爻落空，辰時出空，被日月動爻之尅，必有危亡之褐，留之早膳，過此時辰，去亦不遲。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487375395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼必欲去，予苦留之。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487391779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"飯後去到江邉，忽而跑囬，向予拜謝沾命之恩。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487408163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：此其何故？","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487424547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：今早四隻大船擺渡，行至江心，忽起暴風，畫行覆没，此時屍滿長江，若不蒙之，苦留，已在结中矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487440931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：依數全無救星，㝎是兄之徳行，我有何功，此非避耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487457315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158958611"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"最忌官鬼尅世，凡占防患尅世者，皆不為吉，獨鬼爻尅世更㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487473699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火鬼湏防火災，水鬼湏防水害。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487490083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水鬼尅世，沈溺之憂。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487506467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土鬼傷身，礬墻之厄。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487522851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金鬼，劍刀斧鉞，乕元，盜賊兵戈，蛇雀官鬼，兼防火厄，勾陳田土，又係牢獄。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487539235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青龍雖是吉神，尅世，亦為㓙象，或因酒色亡身，间有喜中起禍。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487555619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣以五行六神而㝎，再以八卦叅之，乹、兌為寺廟，又屬金刑。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487572003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坎、兌以水為災，勿執弓弩。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487588387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"離是火炎，又","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487604771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158974995"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"為蟹鼈。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487604771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"震有舟車之冦，㢲防婦女之奸，坤艮郊野山林，又為老婦、妖童之惑。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487621155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸類多门，在人通變。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487637539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如丑月戊子日，占雀龍、元虎、蛇勾，夢淂益之中孚，","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487653923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"應世卯巳寅未辰，兄子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄子，財財卯父。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487653923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此人因夢一身之血，入河洗之。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487670307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：血乃財也，洗去者，破財之兆。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487686691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今又占淂此卦，元武發動，化進神，尅世尅財，不獨刦財，還防身𮞸本害。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487703075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㢲宫屬木，又作木動尅世，木害須防。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487719459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：何以避之？","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487735843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：世與","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487752227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158991379"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木爻皆在内卦，出外可避。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487752227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㢲為少女，勿貪红婦。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487768611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：應在何時？","logicSentenceId":"7679048947487784995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：交春就可避之。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948077559860","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：年近嵗逼。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948077576244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如何逺去？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948077592628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不意果扵正月亥日，宿扵妾房，被賊明火入室，席捲一空，身受木噐也傷。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948077609012","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若不宿扵少婦之室，或者扒墻而出，未必身受其傷。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948077625396","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獨冝袖徳随身。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948077641780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占夢兆，占漂洋過江，占踰險偷関，占防瘟疫，占防病，占誤食毒物，","logicSentenceId":"7679048948077658164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"占","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逺隣火起，占防仇害，占避難，占賊盜生發，占孤身夜行，占宿店廟，","logicSentenceId":"7679048948077658164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382159007763"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占入山，占仇人訛詐，占己㝎大罪，占入不毛。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948077658164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大凢一切憂疑驚恐，防災防患者，皆冝子孫持世，或福神動扵卦中。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948077674548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古法但淂子孫乗旺動，飛殃横祸化為塵。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948077690932","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948077707316","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如午月丁亥日，占夢，子","logicSentenceId":"7679048948077723700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊申，亥丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯","logicSentenceId":"7679048948077723700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼兄鬼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前夫呌去，己随去矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948077723700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄亥父丑卯子，斷曰：世爻支水，雖臨日辰，豈當重重土尅？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948077740084","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今冬防危。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948077756468","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵九月小産成癆，膜月而死。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948077772852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如戍月戊申曰，應世","logicSentenceId":"7679048948077789236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382159024147"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占夢，三母呌去，己卯巳未申午辰随去矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948077789236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼父兄，子父兄，凶夢相同，生夗各别。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948077805620","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前卦世爻變鬼，𢀸扵臘月。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948077822004","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後卦子孫持世，竟無凶矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948077838388","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：雖然子孫持世，難為吉兆。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948077854772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若值月破，許之出月無憂；若臨旬空，許之出旬無患。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948077871156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未至出旬之日，盡屬虚疑空憂。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948077887540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如己月庚辰日，占防憂，淂夬卦，世臨子孫，值旬空，事之不结，终日憂煎。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948077903924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又扵乙酉日占淂无妄，世臨","logicSentenceId":"7679048948077920308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382159040531"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午火，子孫又值旬空，事又及覆不结。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948077920308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉日又占，得節之坎卦。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948077936692","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：甲寅日則事结矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948077953076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：何也？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948077969460","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：世下巳午，變出寅木，子孫又值旬空，幸淂卦遇六冲，所以结矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948077985844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果结扵甲寅日。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078002228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅在内，世在外，冝扵外避。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078018612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅神。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078034996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若在内，卦動而尅世，宜出外避之。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078051380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅神若在外卦動而尅世，宜在家避之。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078067764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如寅月丁未日，曰占世應流年，淂益之暌，巳未酉辰","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078084148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寅兄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078084148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382159056915"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子財鬼財卯父，予曰：今秋必有險厄。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078100532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅木動爻臨月，建化進神尅世，此時木盛貪榮，不耒尅害。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078116916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六七月衰墓之時，防土木之厄。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078133300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：可避否？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078149684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：冝徃外方可避。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078166068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又问：何方為吉？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078182452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：目下去者，冝徃西方，六七月去者，宜徃東方。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078198836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何也？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078215220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六七月木衰矣，所以反冝于東。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078231604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此人竟未出门，推至七月𥘉七，又淂凶夢。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078247988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"初八卽往東行，廿八地震房塌，人口被傷，獨伊淂免。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078264372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如卯月巳未世應","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078280756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382159073299"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日，占淂𠌘卦，戊申午丑卯巳兄子父兄鬼父子。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078280756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"過鄱陽，忽起暴風，水冲舵去，其舟旋扵湖内，小价擲錢。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078297140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予闻所得何卦，荅曰：天澤復。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078313524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：子孫持世，何足為憂。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078329908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"仍復睡卧。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078346292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"少刻，一陣大風，将船吹送其岸。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078362676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世又如申月戊申日，占被巳未酉申午辰人訛詐，可成非否？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078379060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淂","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078395444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"旅兄子卦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財財、兄子。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078395444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：子孫持世，何之為懼？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078411828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必不成，非分文勿使，不","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078428212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382159089683"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必理他。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078428212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予詳酉金旺，財臨應爻，又曰：我雖勸爾外文勿使，應財旺甚，是非雖無，只恐不淂不使錢耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078444596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後果仇家央煩當道說合，無奈費過四數。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078460980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世在外尅在外，宜扵家居。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078477364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻與忌神皆在外卦者，不可出行，宜居家可避。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078493748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世與忌神在内卦者，不可家居，冝扵外避出行。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078510132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"章云：路上有官休出外，宅中有鬼莫居家。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078526516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"同此意耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078542900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"545","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078559284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如未月丙子日，占僕成申午午","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078575668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辰寅，財兄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382159106067"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人為禍否？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078575668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淂解之：震鬼子子寅子。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078592052","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此公知僕役變心，意欲處治，尚無實跡，故占之。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078608436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁卦者，若執奴僕為財，則迂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078624820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼旣防患，只看忌神。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078641204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦世臨辰土两重，寅木傷之。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078657588","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：不獨此人，還有附従者。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078673972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：何法𠁅之？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078690356","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：彼無實跡，如何䖏之，但未月乃木之墓，七月乃木之絶，此两月乃败露之月也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078706740","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"公冝出外，自能免禍。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078723124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果依計而行。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078739508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"往坟庒上，住過半月，两僕人逃矣，一婦随去，一婦未去。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078755892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未去之婦而曰：彼二人原欲害主而逃，今因出外，","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078772276","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580908773412"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不能傷害，此非避㐫之法耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078772276","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"避患扵生世之方，趨吉扵福神之地。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078788660","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"565","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡避兵、避盗、避瘟、養病、避是非，皆冝避扵生世之方，及子孫之方為吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078805044","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫若發動扵卦中，不拘尅世、生世、持世，俱以為吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078821428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雀龍、元、沛、蛇、勾。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078837812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如己月戊辰日，占，","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078854196","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乂應世酉丑子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥丑卯巳","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078854196","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"防流兵，淂臨之暌。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078854196","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳則酉兄鬼父，彼時流兵為害，到𠁅𮞸殃。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078870580","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此人知易，占淂此卦，終","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078886964","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580908789796"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日業憂。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078886964","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予问其故，彼曰：己酉丑合成金局而尅世，世爻又臨螣蛇之鬼，數在结中，萬萬莫能逃矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078903348","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予咲而曰：甭與兵賊同居，保爾無事。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078919732","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：何也？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078936116","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：子孫合成金局，尅去身邊之鬼，復何憂也？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078952500","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：酉金子孫旺扵巳月，又化巳火，論尅，如何論生？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078968884","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：酉金淂丑未二土以相生，如何論尅？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948078985268","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後果屢逢兵變，此人或避或不避，皆不逢驚。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948079001652","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自癸未年占淂此卦，直至庚寅年，地方大㝎，向予而曰：子孫為福神，信乎有騐。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948079018036","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"585","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世之看書不到，論理不徹，以吉為凶者，","logicSentenceId":"7679048948079034420","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580908806180"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不獨我一人而已。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948079034420","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"應世","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如巳月内成日，占，通","logicSentenceId":"7679048948079050804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戍申兄，午辰、寅、子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鄉避亂，淂乾之大有。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948079050804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父未鬼，父財子，衆以子孫屬水，金動生之，北方為吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948079067188","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：非此議論。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948079083572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄動化進神，乃破財之象，午火淂令而生世，徃南避之為吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948079099956","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"信予之言，皆從南避，浚果賊從北來，放火燒村而去，房屋稲谷盡成灰燼，乃申金兄動破財之故耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948079116340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所以生方為吉，子孫之方六吉，又當以旺衰分别。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948079132724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580908822564"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火雖鬼方，生我何碍。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948079149108","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世遇生扶，百年正𥨊。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948079165492","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身𮞸尅害，五類推詳。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948079181876","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占終身结果何如？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948207583266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但淂世爻旺相，或有動爻，日月生扶，或動而化吉，皆許無疾而佟。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948207599650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如若世逢尅制刑冲，湏以五行兼六神而斷。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948207616034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"受五行之尅，以疾病而言。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948207632418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如無六神之凶，卽以横三。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948207648802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一火若傷金，肺經之病；土未刑水，腎受其傷。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948207665186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"607","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水尅火以傷心，金尅木而肝疾，𦜉胃虚弱皆回。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948207681570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木旺刑沖，傷損腰傷，乃為仇神獨發。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948207697954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580908838948"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𠔥螣蛇以心驚，帶青龍而酒色。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948207714338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勾陳腫脹，朱雀顛狂，虎必血災，元因氣淄。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948207730722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乕元金鬼，難免监贼兵戈；水鬼龍元，冝逺江湖池井。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948207747106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蛇雀木鬼犯官刑，臨火湏防焚害。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948207763490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蛇木又言缢佼，勾陳土鬼牢獄。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948207779874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諺云：一様之生，百様之死。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948207796258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦如神見，理冝细詳。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948207812642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如未月癸𬈫日，","logicSentenceId":"7679048948207829026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"郎蛇勾，朱龍元世應。占㝎何罪，淂中卯木巳火鬼父。未丑卯巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"字變臨卦，酉金亥水兄兄鬼父，","logicSentenceId":"7679048948207829026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580908855332"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：木鬼臨白掃，绞罪㝎矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948207829026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但幸世臨月建，木鬼雖動，又被酉金回頭之尅，外卦及吟，事必反復，雖定依罪，終有攺移。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948207845410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果議絞罪。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948207861794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後蒙駁審，改活罪。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948207878178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"625","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"父毋壽元章四十一","logicSentenceId":"7679048948207894562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"626","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占祖父祖母，占父占母，湏宜分占。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948207910946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古以陽爻為父，隂爻為母，予試不騐。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948207927330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"628","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父臨日月，椿庭晚歳榮華；母值破空，萱神殘年樵悴。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948207943714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"629","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母爻或旺或相，或臨日月，或日月動爻生扶，及","logicSentenceId":"7679048948207960098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580908871716"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動而化，，長享遐齡。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948207960098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母爻休囚，不遇刑傷尅害，晚年多病，還保無傷。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948207976482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"休囚又被刑冲，或日月動爻之尅，及動而變凶，承歡冝早。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948207992866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世如丑月庚子日，先","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208009250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戍申午酉亥丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占父壽，淂姤卦。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208009250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"父元鬼兄子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父又占母壽，淂大壮。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208025634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應之升。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208042018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208058402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"午火申父。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰寅","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208058402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子水財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄子","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208058402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丑土兄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先鬼","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208058402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"母土兄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580908888100"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：前卦兩現父母，取月建丑土為用神，旺扵子日，又與日合，蒂固根深，大椿永茂。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208058402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後卦午火父母動被日冲，初爻子水又動，此午火有尅無生，目𥘉爻子水化出丑土，貪合，不耒，尅火，防丙子年，加以太嵗冲之，是其時也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208074786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸酉年占，至乙巳年三十餘載，復遇其人而问曰：尊翁健否？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208091170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荅曰：甚健。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208107554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"问乃堂，荅曰：果终扵子歲。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208123938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若以古法，陽為父，隂為毋，前卦母戌兩現，俱以旺而㫁者，如天逺矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208140322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208156706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580908904484"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208156706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如：卯月庚寅日，子","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208173090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戌申父申午。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰占毋壽，淂寒之謙。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208173090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
