{"lines":[{"lineId":"661","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208189474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"亥兄，兄鬼父。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中两現父母，取戌土動爻為用爻，春占休囚，雖則卯與戌合，嫌日月同尅，論尅不論合也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208189474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉年占，戌秊，辰月而終。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208205858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此應動而逢值之年。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208222242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應辰月者，冲戌之月也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208238626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208255010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如：酉月庚申日，寅子戌，午辰寅占母壽，淂蒙變渙。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208271394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"父鬼子巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄子父寅木父母，秋占凋零，逢绝，逢冲逢尅，五爻子水獨","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208287778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580908920868"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"發相生，無根之木，生之不乆，防午年冲去子水，為子者，勿逺逰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208287778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯秊占，果終扵午年。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208304162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此應冲去元神之年也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208320546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208336930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如：巳月乙酉日，卯","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208353314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"未已財。酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥酉占父夀，淂㢲之姤。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208353314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兄子午，鬼父財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：亥水父臨月破，又被未土相傷，雖則酉曰冲動，卯木尅土，土旺木衰，不惟難扵長年，且無長月，果终扵本年冬至月。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208369698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應子月者，冲去午火，而未土以尅交水。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208386082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208402466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580908937252"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如卯月丙寅日，卯，","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208402466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巳未丑卯巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占祖母夀，得中孚。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208402466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼父、兄兄鬼父。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208418850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：巳火父母，日月生之，且有大壽。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208435234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"689","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伊曰：家父為祖母拜斗，許拜七年。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208451618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我因家父勞扵公事，我停妻未娶，代為禮拜。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208468002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：可見喬梓大孝，感格天心。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208484386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦日月相生，勿謂非神之力。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208500770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌年占。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208517154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及至次年，偶因痰堵，此子又來，卜之。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208533538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世丑月庚子日，占戊申午丑卯巳，淂歸妹變𣸪父兄鬼父。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208549922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"財鬼寅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580908953636"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦未装畢，家人来曰：老太已去世矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208566306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此子急去。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208582690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予詳此卦，丑土父母旣臨月建，又有午火暗動相生，雖則木動尅圡，化退神，豈無救耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208599074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"随即趕到其家，北人土俗，臨終，不肯停床，已抬扵门板之上，痰壅扵喉，稍有㣲息。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208615458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予以白生𥖎三錢，滚水化開，掀牙灌之，忽而呌曰：冷甚！","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208631842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"随卽復移，燒炕，又活十有三載。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208648226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"704","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"兄弟章弟四十二","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208664610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"705","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占兄弟，湏冝问明，或因弟兄不睦，问将来和好","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208680994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580908970020"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"否。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208680994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"囚，因弟兄雖多，将来淂濟否？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208697378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或问将来有弟兄否？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208713762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"710","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或占兄第夀元，便扵判㫁。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208730146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟旺相，遇生扶，紫𠛼並茂。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208746530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟爻或旺或相，或臨日月，或日月動爻生扶，及動而化𠮷，長枕大被，和睦致祥。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208762914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第位休囚兼受制，鹰序分飛。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208779298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟爻休囚者，若问得濟，雖有如無。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208795682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若问将來有否，從此無矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208812066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如問弟兄之壽元，長年有限，倘休囚又逢破空，及日月動，又刑尅，或動而化凶者，諸占","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208828450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580908986404"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"皆不吉也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208828450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"719","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍元、虎蛇、勾、朱如申月丙辰日，占","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208844834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"應世","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"弟兄和好否？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208844834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淂濟","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208861218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"。巳未土，酉父。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰寅子否。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208861218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大有之乾","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208877602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官申金兄，兄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父、財子，弟兄臨月建，未土父動以相生，又化出兄爻。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208877602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：弟兄雖多，有一位屬猴者淂濟。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208893986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼问：何故？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208910370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：神兆扵動，動而變出，以臨月建，自是超羣抜類。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208926754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：果有舍弟屬候。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208943138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"去年曽叨一弟，餘二人皆従别業，可見數之靈騐如此。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208959522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遲一科，又登甲榜。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208975906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580909002788"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如卯月戊辰日，世乂應，占弟兄，淂震之兊戌","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208992290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"申午辰鬼寅兄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子財、","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208992290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"酉子鬼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208992290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948208992290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予見此卦，為伊赧然，问曰：此因何事而告？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948209008674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：愚弟兄四人尚未分家，问将来和睦久逺否，終有反目否，當分居否？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948209025058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余曰：此卦大凶爻，凶卦，㓙大有不。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948209041442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"測之過。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948209057826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"內卦兄弟化進神，金鬼忐化進神，動而冲尅，震木變兌金，点化回頭之尅，㓙之極矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948209074210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬午年占，至甲申年，弟兄四人同時被害，大小男女悉陥","logicSentenceId":"7679048948209090594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580909019172"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"賊营。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948209090594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"751","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應申年者，木绝扵申。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948209106978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如未月辛酉日，應⺀世，占弟兄還有否？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948209123362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淂子戍","logicSentenceId":"7679048948209139746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"申金，父母系丑卯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣濟變单","logicSentenceId":"7679048948209139746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兄鬼亥水。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948209139746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兄鬼子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：弟兄雖有，必不淂濟。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948209156130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥水兄爻持世，申父動而生之，此一位淂濟之弟尚未生也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948209172514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應爻之子水雖則出現，已值旬空，故曰必不得濟。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948209188898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：果一位舍弟已淂顛狂之症，所以再问有無。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948209205282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：必有，乃異母所生。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778008591","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：何也？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778024975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：父母化出之爻也，是以","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778041359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580909035556"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"知之。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778041359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又問：子水之兄弟臨空而不淂力是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778057743","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥水持世之兄弟，如何点不淂濟？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778074127","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"矛曰：第四爻申金化出之亥水，卽是此爻。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778090511","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦之微妙，爾豈得知。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778106895","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後果異母有出，父亡而撫之。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778123279","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予目擊其成人後事，未考古法，卦無父母，而有兄弟，胞扵異母，予未淂試。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778139663","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"775","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫婦之占，亦湏分别。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778172431","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或占妻壽，或占夫妻偕老。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778188815","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合盛，占夫妻和睦否？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778205199","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戒占妻有刑傷破敗否。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778221583","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占妾占婢，一卦止占一人，不可槩問。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778237967","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580909051940"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"财福生身，可遂唱随之願；應爻合世，堪為附和之神。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778254351","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黄金策尃以應爻為妻，其故何也？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778270735","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因其身命章中父子、弟兄、妻財、官鬼一卦，而𠔥㫁之，正恐屢以財為妻者，又以何爻為財帛，不得不以應爻而為妻位，不顧騐與不騐，竟以應爻為妻。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778287119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖然，以應為妻者，点非全非理也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778303503","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占妻，財爻為重，應爻次之。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778319887","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財爻旺相，應爻空破，仍以吉断。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778336271","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應爻旺相，則爻空破，卽以㓙推。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778352655","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應旺財旺，吉而又𠮷，應破財破，凶而更凶，","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778369039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580909068324"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故以應爻為附和也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778369039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財爻㦯旺㦯相，或臨日月，或曰月動爻生扶，及動而化吉，又與世爻相生合者，如占偕老，㝎然舉案齊睂。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778385423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若問和睦，白首必無反目。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778401807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若问妻命之妍","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778418191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690888891842614/1-ac9e05c3f4f36f9c.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=pB8g978TZo%2BpS9mtKfOa5r0shF8%3D","uri":"read/HY1260/1/ref/1koehfqmag561/1-ac9e05c3f4f36f9c.webp","fontType":1,"components":"女𧈧","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690888891842614"},"logicSentenceId":"7679048948778418191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，入夫門，夫家随牡。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778418191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"796","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占妾占婢，指而问者，点同此㫁。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778434575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則動化㐫，失履遺簪之嘆。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778450959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"弟兄持世，叩盆箕踞之悲。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778467343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財動化㐫者，乃化鬼、化回頭，尅化退神，化绝化墓、化破化空之類是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778483727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不拘何问，玉碎珠沉。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778500111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"801","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580909084708"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"弟兄持世，或兄爻動扵卦中，或日月臨兄弟以傷财，或兄化財爻，不拘问妻问妾，皆生不淂。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778516495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"長生則旺，兄衰，终湏反目。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778532879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅世财退，必主生離。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778549263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"805","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄爻持世而財爻旺者，不能尅妻，終乖琴瑟，相見如仇。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778565647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄爻持世，財化退神者，点同此意。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778582031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"非反目，卽生離。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778598415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"808","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世如酉月辛巳日，占夫：酉亥丑辰寅，子婦将米和好否？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778614799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淂","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778631183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"810","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"𣳾子卦，財兄兄鬼財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"811","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄爻持世，以尅妻財，幸友水財爻，酉日生之，財旺，","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778631183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580909101092"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"難扵尅害。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778631183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：目下不和，将来和好否？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778647567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"815","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余曰：巳日冲動交水，又臨馹馬，妻財臨馬而暗動心去，難笛生離之象。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778663951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此人自此之後，常為此事而占，十有餘次。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778680335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若非兄爻持世，㝎逢財化退神，後竟生鄅。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778696719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黄金策。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778713103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世為一生之本，應為百世之妻。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778729487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦世應相生，如飽宣昵桓氏之岳者，失于里也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778745871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如戌月癸卯日，占應世夫婦何如，有刑尅心。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778762255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巳未酉中午，兄子財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰，淂旅之蹇子","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778778639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戌申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778778639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兄子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580909117476"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：不獨世應相生，且喜世與財合，當許相守百年。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778795023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奈何世爻空而且破，欲合而不能，更嫌財化退神，在有生折之事。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778811407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果自娶入门，並無和氣，後竟休之。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778827791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應財受制，结髮难扵偕老；動妻枉相，續绮，堪許白頭。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778844175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"832","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中財爻多現，若分正庶者，自當以應爻臨財而仆正妻之住也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778860559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘被日月動爻冲尅，及動而化㓙，乃结髪之有傷也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778876943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若得他爻之財旺相，或動而化","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778893327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"835","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580909133860"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉，及他爻變出之財旺相，生合世爻者，乃再娶之妻，反逐白頭。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778893327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如若財爻不臨扵應，又以正卦之財為正妻，變爻之財為更娶。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778909711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻若尅身非刑傷，必然姤悍。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778926095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻財尅世，世若休囚空跛，或墓绝威。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778942479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動而變㐫，或随鬼入墓，但逢一者，夫命天亡，旺相尅世，世爻淂地者，雖無刑傷，必𮞸悍婦。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778958863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應财生世，非内𦔳，卽獲外財。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778975247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580909150244"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中但遇財爻生合世爻，点不可止。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948778991631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以和羙㫁之，间有應在，淂妻家之財力也，否則内君必善。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948779008015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"扵","logicSentenceId":"7679048948779024399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"持家。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如巳月丁未日，占世應夫妻偕老否？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948779024399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淂无戌申","logicSentenceId":"7679048948779040783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"午。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"850","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰","logicSentenceId":"7679048948779040783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子寅，子父。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妄變觀財鬼","logicSentenceId":"7679048948779040783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"853","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"854","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財","logicSentenceId":"7679048948779040783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"855","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"財兄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948779040783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"滿盤俱是財爻，世爻變出之未土，與世爻相合，此未土之財，乃正妻也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948779057167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"858","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨日建，遇月生扶，不獨婚老，且許賢。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948779073551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"859","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七周南。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948779089935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果此公美妾十餘，正夫人賢而無妬，夫妻同庚而生，妻活八旬有一，夫年八十二歳。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948779106319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580909166628"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦若以世應相冲相尅而㫁之，逺如天樣。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948779122703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"863","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"子嗣章第四十四","logicSentenceId":"7679048948779139087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"864","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡问子嗣，湏明告之。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948779155471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或已有子，後還生否？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948779171855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或問現在之子，将來可保長年否？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948779188239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或従不生育，終有子否？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948779204623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易告未来，不告已徃。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948779221007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽如占天時，神報将来之旱潦，不言昨曰之隂晴。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948779237391","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爾若含湖而问，假使從前有子，問浚米還可生否？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948779253775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"871","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"浚若不生，神必現無子之卦，不報已前之有，乃現後来之無。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948779270159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"872","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁卦之人，依卦而","logicSentenceId":"7679048948779286543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"873","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580909183012"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"874","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁，蒲肯服耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948779286543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"875","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又有現今有子，将米若难存者，神点現無嗣之卦。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948779302927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甭雖曰有神，告曰無神，肯阿䛕耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948779319311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"877","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽如寅月癸亥日，曰世應占于嗣多少，得坤","logicSentenceId":"7679048948779335695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"878","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"酉子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"879","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥丑。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948779335695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"880","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卯巳鬼。未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"881","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之艮寅財兄，申父兄。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948779352079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"882","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：鬼變子孫，子孫變鬼，有一而遇者，皆無子也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948779368463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"883","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦兩現無子之兆。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948779384847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"884","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：少年艱扵子嗣，自五旬之外，連得四子，長子已六歳矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948779401231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"885","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：依此卦象，恐","logicSentenceId":"7679048948779417615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"886","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580909199396"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"887","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"俱難存。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948779417615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"888","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼甚不恱。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948779433999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"889","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豈知婢妾極多，三五年内，生者生，而夗者夗，生過九子，並無一存。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948779450383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"890","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨终過侄立嗣，承襲世職。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948779466767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"891","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福徳旺隆，育児賢徳。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948779483151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"892","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福徳卽子孫爻，若旺遇生扶，或臨日月，或帝旺長生。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948779499535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"893","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"扵曰：或動而化吉，必產賢児。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948779515919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"894","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫衰弱，生子愚痴。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948779532303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"895","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫爻哀弱，必生愚痴之子。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948779548687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"896","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衰而被尅，休囚無氣，或墓他空破，或動而化㐫，或日月動爻冲尅，或父","logicSentenceId":"7679048948779565071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"897","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580909215780"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"898","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化子，子化父，鬼變子孫，或父母持世，皆主生而不存。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948779565071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"899","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子動逢空不碍，必得子扵冲空實空之年。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948779581455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"900","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：黄金策子化兄，生児不肖。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948779597839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"901","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殊不思化兄乃回頭之生，如何不肖？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948779614223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"902","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"註解又曰：化鬼点不肖。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948779630607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"903","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化鬼者百無一活，豈不肖而巳耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933197876","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"904","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申月辛卯日應世，占子嗣，淂復。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933214260","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"905","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"906","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥丑","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933230644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"907","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"908","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰、寅","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933230644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子水財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"910","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：身帶吉而子扶，喜闻鶴和。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933230644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"911","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦申金月建作子孫以生世，有子之兆。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933247028","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"912","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上爻酉金子孫，日神冲動","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933263412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"913","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580909232164"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"914","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以生世，定有逺方之子來家之象。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933263412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"915","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼喜而曰：我扵三十七歳有子，已十八矣，因亂失散，至今並無所出。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933279796","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"916","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余曰：恭喜，明現子従六爻動来生世，此子必歸。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933296180","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"917","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：何時淂見？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933312564","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"918","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：明嵗甲辰與酉金相合，㝎然淂意而歸，果扵次年六月。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933328948","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"919","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父子相逢，財化子，可辨正出席出卦，有财而無子孫者，須看變出之爻，變爻子孫，乃庶出也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933345332","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"920","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽斷曰：正無所出，㝎淂偏生。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933361716","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"921","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦有子孫，變交点有子孫，又非此論。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933378100","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"922","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"昂","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933394484","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"923","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以變爻之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"924","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580909248548"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"925","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子為晚子也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933394484","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"926","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘若正庶俱已生子，而問賢愚者。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933410868","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"927","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又以正卦之子為正出，變出之子為席出也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933427252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"928","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如己月己酉日，占應世子生而不存，捋来寅","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933443636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"929","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子水、戊土交水，丑財兄財卯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"930","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"存否？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933443636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"931","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得賁之无妄鬼","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933460020","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"932","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"申金，午火，辰土。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"933","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933460020","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"934","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子孫父兄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"935","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933460020","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"936","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余曰：尅過正妻否？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933476404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"937","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：還是结髪。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933492788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"938","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：傷過正妻，方可存子。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933509172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"939","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：何也？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933525556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"940","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：内卦亥水之財，卽為正妻，破而被尅，五爻子水財爻，乃為再娑之妻，變出申金，子孫，必生子也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933541940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"941","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但五爻子水点，被戍土之尅，","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933558324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"942","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580909264932"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"943","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖化長生，又有酉日之生，不免多病。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933558324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"944","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯年占，果扵巳年死。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933574708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"945","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻卽扵冬月續衆。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933591092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"946","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申年淂子，此婦月中淂病，久卧床榻。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933607476","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"947","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子化子，湏知本宫他宫。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933623860","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"948","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫化子孫淂騐者二：少年無子，淂此者，應多生子也；現有子，淂此者，應子而多孫也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933640244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"949","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"老年無子，淂此者，極他人之子而為子，湏冝分别。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933656628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"950","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化出他宫者，立異姓之子，化出𠥽宫，五族中孫侄。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933673012","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"951","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580909281316"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"952","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如子月戊戊日占應世，現巳有子，還有子。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933689396","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"953","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933705780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"954","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊申辰","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933722164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"955","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"956","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子子否，淂屯之莭。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933722164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"957","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄鬼、父鬼卯兄子孫化子孫，又逢月建相生，不㯮多子，抑且多孫。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933738548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"958","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼问曰：命有㡬個？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933754932","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"959","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：古有此法。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933771316","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"960","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余因不合其理，不敢以之而欺人也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933787700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"961","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：古法如何有錯？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933804084","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"962","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余曰：古以水一、火二、木三、金四、土五，數止扵五。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933820468","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"963","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假使文王生百子，何以㝎之？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933836852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"964","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予以占多寡者，旺相者多，占賢愚者别。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933853236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"965","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占一卦，旺相者賢，屢試不錯。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933869620","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"966","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余今以聦明","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933886004","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"967","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580909297700"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"968","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而㫁此卦，看浚米騐否。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933886004","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"969","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動爻寅木子孫，乃現在之子也，化出卯朩子孫，乃将米之子孫也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933902388","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"970","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目下現有㡬位？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933918772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"971","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：有四。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933935156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"972","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余曰：還有四位。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933951540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"973","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"浚遇十餘載，果淂四子。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933967924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"974","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予至其家，見屬兔者，一隻眇眼，其餘不帶殘疾。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948933984308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"975","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：此子将来貴顯。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934000692","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"976","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：何知？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934017076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"977","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：前卦變出。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934033460","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"978","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯木子孫，與月建相刑，與日辰相合，刑中帶合，旣帶破相，自然榮貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934049844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"979","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此子十四歳入學，因明末大抖未舉，考貢首，遂官至叅政。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934066228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"980","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"浚事未考。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934082612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"981","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如：己月丁自日應世，","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934098996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"982","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580909314084"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"983","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占子有無，淂未濟","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934098996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"984","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己未酉，兄，午子財，辰寅，父。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"985","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之節子戌申，兄子巳。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934098996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"986","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此人目屢生女，且六無存，问終有子否？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934115380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"987","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内卦辰土子孫空而跛尅，乃無子也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934131764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"988","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"幸外卦未土化出子孫，勸之早张螟蛉可也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934148148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"989","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：正有此念。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934164532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"990","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻兄有子，甚是聦明，意欲極之，不知可否？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934180916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"991","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：離宫化出他宫，原該異姓之子。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934197300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"992","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"浚果極之為嗣。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934213684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"993","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如亥月庚子日應世，占子嗣有無淂屯子戌申辰","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934230068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"994","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寅子子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"995","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580909330468"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"996","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之節。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934230068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"997","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄鬼父鬼卯兄，此公年逾六旬，並無所出，自知易理。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934246452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"998","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"揭此卦甚喜，以為世爻子孫又化子孫，月建合之，日辰生之，有子必多。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934262836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"999","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豈知子孫化子孫，非己出也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934279220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1000","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"次年三月，佟扵任浚立侄孫承嗣。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934295604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1001","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父占子，知其易養，子臨貴離曰成名。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934311988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1002","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父占子，止知易養，難㫁冨貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934328372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1003","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫旺相，尅制官星，子若休囚，焉能食禄，所以易飬否，不難知也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934344756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1004","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫旺相，或動而化吉，㦯臨日月，或日月動爻生扶，或","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934361140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1005","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580909346852"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1006","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"長生帝旺，皆許成人。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934361140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1007","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如休囚空跛，動而變㓙，水泡風灯。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934377524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1008","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至扵子孫之冨與貴者，旺相，又遇生扶，自然富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934393908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1009","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若以科甲科名而㫁者，乃欺人之法也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934410292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1010","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黄金策曰：子帶貴人，自有登天之日。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934426676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1011","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：禄貴臨爻，童年拜相。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934443060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1012","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以貴禄臨子孫而化鬼者，不為化鬼，乃為化官，卽許登天拜相。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934459444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1013","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予查天乙貴人臨爻，並無禄到貴人臨馬，止有丁巳日見亥水子孫，乃為贵人與馬同宫，餘皆不是。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934475828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1014","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有祿者，並無貴人與馬。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934492212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1015","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此信筆之妄談也，何嘗經騐？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934508596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1016","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"况予屢占子女者，子孫燮。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934524980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1017","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580909363236"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1018","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼，萬無一沽，","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934541364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1019","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"應世。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1020","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如亥月丙辰日，占子戍","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934541364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1021","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"申兄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1022","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午酉","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934541364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1023","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1024","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934541364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1025","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1026","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易養否，淂姤之旅父未鬼，兄","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934541364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1027","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"奇鬼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1028","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父交水，子孫臨月建，五爻兄動，以相生，旺，莫旺扵此也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934541364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1029","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若以吉神論之，丙日以亥為貴人，貴莫貴扵此也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934557748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1030","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豈知子孫變鬼，𢀸扵次年五月。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934574132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1031","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黄金策舊有官鬼無傷，曺彬取印终封爵。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934590516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1032","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：官鬼無傷者，必是子孫爻被傷被尅，休囚無氣，所以不能傷尅官鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934606900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1033","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣是如此，衰弱之子孫，","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934623284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1034","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580909379620"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1035","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又能封官封爵，余不信也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934623284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1036","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：父身有氣，車糺顯名。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934639668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1037","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：父占子，父為忌神，或動或旺，必扵尅子，救死不暇，何淂顯名？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934656052","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1038","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：疑是嬰児之自占也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934672436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1039","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：法児者，乃無知無識之孩童。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934688820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1040","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占富占貴，全在人之一念。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934705204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1041","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三五嵗之嬰孩，可知冨貴而動念耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934721588","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1042","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"况身命後鄣有曰：若卜嬰児之造化，固知非代占耶。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934737972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1043","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我占六親，不冝世爻化鬼，占父母、兄弟、妻妾、児孫，先看世爻，雖占六親，常有","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934754356","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1044","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580909396004"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1045","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帶出自身之㓙者。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934754356","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1046","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻化鬼、化回頭尅，休囚、化空破墓绝，及随鬼入墓，日月同尅，休问他人，且防自夭。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934770740","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1047","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"常问父母，六有兼應児孫，常見占父毋之卦爻中帶出刑傷兄弟、児孫、妻妾者，有占児孫，六有兼應父母、兄弟、妻妾者，不可不知。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934787124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1048","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此謂占此而應彼也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934803508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1049","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此論前已表明，非予𥚃諄告之目，予屢占而屢見也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048948934819892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1050","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"李我平曰：黄金策身命章，父子、官鬼、兄弟、妻財，雖則","logicSentenceId":"7679048949474263092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1051","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580909412388"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1052","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不當槩論，其理還细，惜乎悖謬者多。","logicSentenceId":"7679048949474263092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1053","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金鏡㣲慶，不宜有也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048949474279476","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1054","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易冒雖有分占之意，論理太粗。","logicSentenceId":"7679048949474295860","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1055","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽如问壽夭，而曰破、散、冲、空，㝎之夭存。","logicSentenceId":"7679048949474312244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1056","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有占騐。","logicSentenceId":"7679048949474328628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1057","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子命亥日占浚行午限终扵亥，是以终也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048949474345012","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1058","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘占非亥，曰何𠁅而尋限絶。","logicSentenceId":"7679048949474361396","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1059","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生午占騐，如果有靈，何不多存一二，以為浚法？","logicSentenceId":"7679048949474377780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1060","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殊不知死生事大，三言兩句，何以能盡？","logicSentenceId":"7679048949474394164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1061","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尚謂推之深者，雖日時可知，予不信也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048949474410548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1062","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如问我能貴乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679048949474426932","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1063","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍為文翰，虎為武衛，以龍乕而㝎文武，周昜之理如此。","logicSentenceId":"7679048949474443316","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1064","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易郎又曰：三為守牧，五為臺省，初爻二爻，竟不知是何職也，朦","logicSentenceId":"7679048949474459700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1065","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580909428772"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1066","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朧混過，後學何以為法？","logicSentenceId":"7679048949474459700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1067","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：问子忌子虚，问財忌財陥空與幍，便是斷其無財無子耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679048949474476084","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1068","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聖人仆易，以前民用。","logicSentenceId":"7679048949474492468","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1069","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"浚人问卜，無過身命，身命之外，夫復何求？","logicSentenceId":"7679048949474508852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1070","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"浚學淂其精者，煩前人傳授，淂法问者，淂其趨避，頼卜人識理之㣲。","logicSentenceId":"7679048949474525236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1071","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此書身命，較之他章，愈加詳细，反復通明，足為敎人之法也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048949474541620","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":7,"content":"椘江李坦坦我午鍳㝎，湖南李文輝覺子増則。婿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":7,"content":"陳文吉茂生，男茹芝山秀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":7,"content":"全訂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"儒業者，父母世爻同旺，終湏變化成龍。","logicSentenceId":"7631095691930746930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日月動爻相生，㝎是王家儲器。","logicSentenceId":"7631095691930763314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻、父母爻皆冝旺相，或動而變吉，或父毋持世，日月動爻生合世爻，攀龍附鳳，指日可期。","logicSentenceId":"7586703021087408128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580909690916"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財動卦中，青燈不乆。","logicSentenceId":"7586703021087424512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫持世，白首無成。","logicSentenceId":"7631095691930779698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財動尅文章，讀書中途而廢。","logicSentenceId":"7586703021087440896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子動，無官之象，皓首必不成名。","logicSentenceId":"7586703021087457280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九流者，財興官旺，道重人欽。","logicSentenceId":"7586703021087473664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄動世衰，有無譽。","logicSentenceId":"7631095691930796082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財持世，官持世，財、官、世爻皆宜得地。","logicSentenceId":"7586703021087490048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄動卦中，兄爻持世，只可湖口，難許成家。","logicSentenceId":"7586703021087506432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：古以九流皆以官鬼為吉。","logicSentenceId":"7586703021087522816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殊不知天師家及驅邪治鬼之家，里師、醫家，皆以子枉能扵治鬼，必以子孫持世，及子孫發動而為吉也。","logicSentenceId":"7631095691930812466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580909707300"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"百工皆以財為用神，子孫為元神，最忌兄爻持世，及兄爻旺動者，勞碌終身。","logicSentenceId":"7586703021087539200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘以求財章同斷。","logicSentenceId":"7586703021087555584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以上皆不宜。","logicSentenceId":"7586703021087571968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻空破，墓绝休囚，諸事無成。","logicSentenceId":"7586703021087588352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世若休囚，而又随鬼入墓，及受日月動文冲尅成動而化鬼、化绝、化尅者，不惟學業難成，且防不測。","logicSentenceId":"7586703021087604736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"治經章弟四十二","logicSentenceId":"7586703021087621120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古以金仆春秋，木作毛詩，水為書經，火為禮記，王為易經。","logicSentenceId":"7586703021087637504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：不可槩问，湏𢯡一經而卜之。","logicSentenceId":"7586703021087653888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禱扵神曰：我","logicSentenceId":"7586703021087670272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580909723684"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"習此經何如？","logicSentenceId":"7586703021087670272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文旺官典，玉家棵棟。","logicSentenceId":"7586703021087686656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世空子動，蓬菓寒儒。","logicSentenceId":"7631095691930828850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官持世，父動相生，或日月臨。","logicSentenceId":"7586703021087703040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母生世，或官爻旺相，父久持世，乃世爻動而化𠮷，皆飛騰處化之。","logicSentenceId":"7631095691930845234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兆也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世空世破，及動而變凶，或子孫財爻持世，父母官鬼空破，湏冝另習一經，虔誠再卜。","logicSentenceId":"7586703021087719424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如酉月内子日，占本經能發否","logicSentenceId":"7586703021087735808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"？","logicSentenceId":"7586703021087735808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淂益之觀。","logicSentenceId":"7631095691930861618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世卯巳未𫝕寅。","logicSentenceId":"7631095691930878002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子父。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄子財，財兄未。","logicSentenceId":"7631095691930894386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580909740068"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：卦中枉官合世，不冝。","logicSentenceId":"7586703021087768576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"初爻朱雀，子水文章皆被未土回頭之尅，冝扵攺經。","logicSentenceId":"7631095691930910770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼问：冝改何？","logicSentenceId":"7586703021087784960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：古法有之。","logicSentenceId":"7586703021087801344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予占不騐，意欲何徑？","logicSentenceId":"7586703021087817728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再占一卦，卽卜易经，得天火同人。","logicSentenceId":"7631095691930927154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世戊申午亥丑卯，子財，兄官、子父。","logicSentenceId":"7631095691930943538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：旰官持世，雖以為吉，父臨月破，再宜更之。","logicSentenceId":"7586703021087834112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又占書经。","logicSentenceId":"7631095691930959922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乂世。","logicSentenceId":"7586703021087850496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申午亥丑卯","logicSentenceId":"7631095691930976306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580909756452"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳","logicSentenceId":"7631095691930976306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7631095691930976306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父財、兄官、子。","logicSentenceId":"7631095691930992690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺父持世，官動生之。","logicSentenceId":"7631095691931009074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只因今日子日冲動，午火傷金，此经相冝","logicSentenceId":"7586703021087866880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下科壬于冲去午火，管許髙發，果扵子科中魁。","logicSentenceId":"7586703021087866880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父爻旺相，就而正焉。","logicSentenceId":"7631095691931025458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母爻旣為師長，又為詩書，延師受敎，卽以此爻為用神，宜旺相成臨日月，及動而化吉，可式可矜。","logicSentenceId":"7586703021087899648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如若休囚空破绝，及動而化凶，有伴食之誅，無師","logicSentenceId":"7586703021087916032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580909772836"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"資之盖。","logicSentenceId":"7586703021087916032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世位相生，愽文善誘。","logicSentenceId":"7586703021087932416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父旺生合世爻，成人有徳。","logicSentenceId":"7586703021087948800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若尅世爻，而世爻淂地者，有責成之功。","logicSentenceId":"7586703021087965184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世若休囚，必受師尊之累。","logicSentenceId":"7631095691931041842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父入墓中，懶术教訓。","logicSentenceId":"7586703021087981568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父爻入三墓及臨絶者，若非偷间懶惰，㝎是師教不嚴。","logicSentenceId":"7586703021087997952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財臨世上，懦弱不嚴。","logicSentenceId":"7586703021088014336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財爻持世，乃我尅父母，若非師敎不嚴，㝎是我凌","logicSentenceId":"7586703021088030720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580909789220"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"師長。","logicSentenceId":"7586703021088030720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼化文書尅世，訟由乎學。","logicSentenceId":"7586703021088047104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼動化父母，冲尅世爻，異日必主争讼。","logicSentenceId":"7586703021088063488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"即使曰月動爻制服鬼爻，六不相宜，此故何也？","logicSentenceId":"7586703021088079872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神兆機扵動，目前雖可制服，他日鬼逢生旺，必見火非。","logicSentenceId":"7586703021088096256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不惟鬼動化父，但係鬼動尅世，或世動變凶，皆不冝從。","logicSentenceId":"7586703021088112640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月扶世爻日助，青出扵藍。","logicSentenceId":"7586703021088129024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻旺相，或父母持世，㦯官星持世。","logicSentenceId":"7586703021088145408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日月動爻生扶，及世爻動而化吉，必有長進","logicSentenceId":"7586703021088161792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青出扵蓝。","logicSentenceId":"7586703021088161792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580909805604"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動衰變，旺先惰浚動。","logicSentenceId":"7586703021088178176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動旺變哀，先動浚怠。","logicSentenceId":"7586703021088194560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父爻衰，而化生、化旺、化日月、化進神，皆主浚動。","logicSentenceId":"7586703021088210944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父爻旺，而化空破、墓絶、化退神，皆主後怠。","logicSentenceId":"7586703021088227328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父化父而殊狸，父化財而多病。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452311388195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父化鬼，貴顯之交。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452311404579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父化兄，貪財好利。","logicSentenceId":"7631095691931058226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三合連年受敎，六中半載難淫。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452311420963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世與父爻無日月作三合者，情同父子，速年受業，门墻始洛成就。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452311437347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦淂六冲，或世尅父爻，及父爻尅世者，彼此不投，難收一歳之功。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452311453731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580909821988"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父為子而延師者，應為西席。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452311470115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世乃東家，冝世應相生相合，不冝相尅相冲。","logicSentenceId":"7631095691931074610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應生世，我淂其益。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452311486499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應空破，延之不就。","logicSentenceId":"7631095691931090994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應動，他心有變。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452311502883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世空，我意不專。","logicSentenceId":"7631095691931107378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：雖以世應為主，父爻不可缺之。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452311519267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父旺與子孫相合，名實兼收。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452311535651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父動傷尅子孫，無益有害。","logicSentenceId":"7631095691931123762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子動化尅，不冝延之。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452311552035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子動化鬼，還冝辭绝。","logicSentenceId":"7631095691931140146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如寅月戊午日，占子從師。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452311568419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：凢占小考，甞見占淂吉卦，後竟道考無名。","logicSentenceId":"7631095691931205682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何也？","logicSentenceId":"7586703452311617571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神之應近而不應逺，已應府縣之有名也。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452311633955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必湏先占縣考，再占府考，又占道考，俱淂吉卦者，許之。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452311650339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内有卦而不吉者，勿望道考而成名也。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452311666723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
