{"lines":[{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父旺宦𦥷，堪期首選。","logicSentenceId":"7631095691931238450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官衰父發，故許掄𠬧。","logicSentenceId":"7631095691931254834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官星持世，淂日月動爻相生相合者，首𨕖無疑。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452311699491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580909854756"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父爻持世，淂日月動爻相生合者，𡖋要官星有炁，始許成名。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452311715875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子興財發扵卦中，難逰泮水。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452311732259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子動尅官，財動尅父，或持扵世爻者，皆不冝也。","logicSentenceId":"7631095691931271218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世破身空棄墓絶，再奮芸窓。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452311748643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻空破墓绝，或被曰月動爻冲尅，及動而變凶者，不能遂志。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452311765027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文旺𮞸傷𠬧而復棄，冲中逢合，見棄夏収。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452311781411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母旺相，若化休囚空破墓绝，化回頭之尅，及被","logicSentenceId":"7586703452311797795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580909871140"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冲尅者，始取终棄。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452311797795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世與父爻動而逢冲，若淂日月動爻相合者，謂之冲中逢合，必獲續取。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452311814179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父衰變旺，愈出愈奇。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452311830563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文化退神，日長日短。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452311846947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父衰動而化旺，及化回頭，生化進神，文章淂意，浚勝扵前，皆不冝化退神，旺化退神者，前篇植遂，浚勁不力。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452311863331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衰化退神，及化尅、化空破墓绝，或回頭尅者，窻下十日之長，臨塲一日之短。","logicSentenceId":"7631095691931287602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如友月丙戌日占","logicSentenceId":"7586703452311879715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580909887524"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"道考，淂豐之单。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452311879715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母持世，化進神日建仆官而生世，文章愈出愈奇，後勝於前，㝎蒙首取，果取案首。","logicSentenceId":"7631095691931336754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如卯月壬子日，占道考，淂小畜。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452311896099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世。","logicSentenceId":"7631095691931353138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯巳未辰一寅子。","logicSentenceId":"7631095691931369522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄子財，財兄父。","logicSentenceId":"7631095691931385906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子水父母臨日建，旺文持世，佳作㝎然淂意，但不宜酉金官星臨月破，伏藏不露，幸得辰土仆飛神","logicSentenceId":"7631095691931402290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580909903908"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，破而逢合，若在三月考之，必取，果扵扵三月取之。","logicSentenceId":"7631095691931402290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如辰月丁巳日，淂单變既濟。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452311912483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未酉","logicSentenceId":"7631095691931418674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"亥水兄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥丑卯。","logicSentenceId":"7631095691931418674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼父、申金兄、官子。","logicSentenceId":"7631095691931435058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文冝旺相，最忌休囚。","logicSentenceId":"7631095691931467826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官冝生身，不冝尅。","logicSentenceId":"7631095691931484210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世","logicSentenceId":"7586703452311961635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父與世爻旺相，又淂日月動爻生扶，及動而化吉，","logicSentenceId":"7586703452311961635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580909920292"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"全無破绽者，㝎考超等。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452311961635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若此两爻旺而逢生，旺而無生，相而遇扶，無刑冲尅破者次之；有一而遇刑冲者，又次之。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452311978019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻受尅，教刑不免，世父同受尅，劣等無疑。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452311994403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：此法是也。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312010787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六要人之通變，觀其父世兩爻輕重而言之。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312027171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦之全羙，世父同旺，有生扶，又無刑尅，卷之上上。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312043555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以此捱次查之。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312059939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或有生扶而得六冲變冲，反吟復吟，變尅化绝，卽是破從。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312076323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父爻受尅而無救，難免塗鸦。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312092707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻受尅而有扶，六蒙始貸。","logicSentenceId":"7631095691931500594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580909936676"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：此以父爻之旺衰而列等第是也。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312109091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易冒謂：卦淂進神，考扵上等，退神而考下等。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312125475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假使卦無渠退之神，何以㝎之？","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312141859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如申月乙巳日，占歲，考大過之鼎。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312158243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應","logicSentenceId":"7631095691931516978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"末土財，酉金官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥酉亥丑，","logicSentenceId":"7631095691931516978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巳火，未土。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父官、父財。","logicSentenceId":"7631095691931516978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嘗曰：財動尅父，乃不通變之論也。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312174627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦乃亥水父爻持世，申月生之，文旺而身六旺，巳日冲之為暗動。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312191011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未土財爻雖動，喜其生助，酉金酉官生世，名為接續相生，一㝎篇篇錦绣。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312207395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財生官旺，優等帮粮，果","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312223779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580909953060"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"取一等補廪。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312223779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：大凢墊逢六冲變冲，及六爻亂動，文旺世旺，還考平䒭。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312240163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘若文衰受尅，及世爻休囚被尅，及變凶者，劣等無疑。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312256547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"飛神無𦔳，身無尅，榮辱無施，父爻出現，不旺不哀，雖無生扶，六無尅制，而世爻不被冲尅者，可保平等。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312272931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"藏旺相，世遭傷，賞罰並見。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312289315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如午月乙卯日，占","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312305699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580909969444"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗考，淂地天𣳾。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312305699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世，酉亥、丑辰、寅子，子財兄，兄官財。","logicSentenceId":"7631095691931533362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午火月建為父母，而卦中之巳火伏蔵扵寅木之下，旺而又遇飛神之生爻，逢六合，只不冝日辰尅世，發落之日蒙宗師面叱，念字法古帖，姑取三䓁。","logicSentenceId":"7631095691931549746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後悟之，此巳午之火，非文旺也，乃字端也。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312322083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但此卦雖多，逢事却少見，存之為法。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312338467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以上總而言之，父與世爻旺相遇生扶為上，畧有破绽者次之，刑傷有救者又次之，刑傷無救而輕","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312354851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580909985828"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者又次之。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312354851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世父被刑冲尅破而重者，劣等必矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312371235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"全要通變，湏以卦之吉，𠔥用神旺衰之輕重也。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312387619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"増廪章第五十一","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312404003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：占廪君不淂其祕訣，而望靈者少也。","logicSentenceId":"7631095691931566130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何也？","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312420387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占廪用財，財乃文章之忌神，不知其竅。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312436771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卜歲考而無问廪，財爻若旺，父毋受傷，財如休囚，如何淂廪","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312453155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"？","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312453155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予有法","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312485923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312485923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先占嵗科之𠮷凶，再占一卦而问廪，卽其秘也。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312502307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"專以財爻為用神。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312518691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財爻持世，或動而生世為吉，與求財章同㫁。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312535075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580910002212"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有廪而恐失者，忌兄弟持世，兄爻發動，及財逢空破墓絶，動而變凶，皆有失也。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312551459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如官鬼兄爻尅世者，輕則单糧，重則追罰。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312567843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘卦中三合兄局者，六主单廪。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312584227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"考遺才章第五十二","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312600611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡告考，同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官爻持世，生世我必蒙𭠎","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312616995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母，空破墓绝，他不見用。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312616995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如世爻受尅，及空破墓絶，或動而化凶，或子孫持世，或動扵卦中，皆不録之。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312633379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母生世，持世者吉，休囚空破者凶。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312649763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"發案掛榜章第五十三","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312666147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580910018596"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父為用神，衰者冝生肚之日，旺而静者，逢值逢冲之曰動，而逢值逢合之日。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312682531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空與入墓，必待冲𫔭，破與旬空，湏期填實。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312698915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予又淂騐，心有女懼。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312715299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若得子孫持世，值子孫之日而發案，心有盻喜者。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312731683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若淂官星持世，逢官鬼之而掛榜。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312748067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"𢌜試章第五十四","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312764451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"與會塲兼㫁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官星為用爻，父爻次之。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312797219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若持世爻，淂日月、嵗五生合者，㝎蒙首拔","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312813603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580910034980"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312813603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官父世爻三合，㝎蒙異𠖥隆恩。","logicSentenceId":"7631095691931582514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世與官爻有一，而逢空破墓、絶、刑、冲尅害，及動而變凶者，不祥之兆。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312829987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗五官鬼冲尅世爻者，不測之災。","logicSentenceId":"7631095691931598898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
