{"lines":[{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父旰官興，姓標虎榜。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312862755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父官持世而旺相，或臨日月，或日月動爻生扶，及動而變专，名登龍乕。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312879139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子揺財動，名落孫山。","logicSentenceId":"7631098845018980379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580910051364"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫財爻持世，及動扵卦中，终湏下第。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312895523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312911907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"弟乃奪標之惡客。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312911907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"俗傳兄弟爻興難上榜。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312928291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡見兄爻持世及動者，皆以為之不吉，殊不知有喜有忌。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312944675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜者，卦中財文同與，喜其兄動以制財也。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312961059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中父官两動者，又喜","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312977443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄爻持世，父動以生世也。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452312977443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟持世，若臨曰月，或旺相，再淂官文兩旺，或官動生父，父動生世，必忝科名，只不能掄元而奪魁也，故謂之兄弟","logicSentenceId":"7586703452313010211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃。","logicSentenceId":"7586703452313010211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"奪標之客。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：卦中官鬼子孫同動，官臨旺相遇生扶，子","logicSentenceId":"7631098845018996763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580910067748"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孫衰弱而被尅，再冝父動，最怕兄興。","logicSentenceId":"7631098845018996763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日月爲制煞之将軍。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705991299112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官星父母世爻，有一而被動爻尅制，或化回頭之尅，若得日月中制尅神，𡖋許淂意，故謂之制惡之将軍。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705991315496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如世爻旺相，而官父两爻，若有一而伏藏不現，倘得日月中制飛神，提出伏神","logicSentenceId":"7586703705991331880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，六許髙發。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705991331880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如","logicSentenceId":"7586703705991348264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官父世爻有一而不旺者，若得日月生扶亦同。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705991348264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此意。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三合無冲，連登甲弟。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705991364648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580910084132"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官父世爻，合成父局。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705991381032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官局不遇日月冲破者，㝎許連登。","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019013147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘若合成兄局，淂遇日月生扶，官星六旺者，亦許淂意。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705991397416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟忌合成子孫局者，不為吉也。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705991413800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合成財局，雖不為美，然六淂騐扵吉者。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705991430184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如卯月甲申日，占會試，淂艮之益。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705991446568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應，寅","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019029531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戍","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019029531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午，","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019029531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辰兄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官巳兄，辰父子。","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019029531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅木旺官持世，申日冲之，暗動又淂曰辰會成財局，不惟不尅世爻，反米生世，一㝎髙捷，果得及第。","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019045915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580910100516"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六爻競發，空赴科塲。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705991462952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊係六爻競發，功名怳惚以難成。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705991479336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此論是理。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705991495720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余見占㓛名之必中者，卦象一成，若非旺父生身，㝎是旺官持世，功名若無成者，不是子孫持世，卽子孫財爻發動，或是世破世空，或是六爻亂動，名必無成。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705991512104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出現無情，難遂青雲必志。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705991528488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父與官星雖則出現，若不生合世爻，或不持世，或世爻空破，亦屬無盖。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705991544872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580910116900"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父與官星合世爻，若又被日月動爻冲壞者，六仆無情之喻。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705991561256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伏藏有用，終辭白屋之人。","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019062299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官父有一而不上卦，湏看伏神，若伏而旺相，或淂","logicSentenceId":"7586703705991577640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日月冲去飛神，生起伏神，一准登科。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705991577640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太𡻕作官星，终登黄甲。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705991610408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太嵗乃人君之爻，官臨太𡻕，動而生合世爻，乃人臣面君之象，當主君臣契合，連捷無疑。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705991626792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太歳必要入爻，入爻六要發動，或持世爻始。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705991643176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如","logicSentenceId":"7586703705991659560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580910133284"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：月冲尅世，且守青燈。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705991659560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中官父雖旺，而世爻休囚，空破墓絶，及動而變，凶惑。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705991675944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日月冲尅世爻，湏知求名在我，我位旣失，何以成名","logicSentenceId":"7586703705991692328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705991692328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦遇六冲，此去難題塔。","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019078683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻逢六合，這回必奪鳌頭。","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019095067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍元、虎蛇、勾朱。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705991725096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應，","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019111451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未酉亥，丑卯巳，父兄、子父、財官。","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019111451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如午月丙辰日，占","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019127835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"郷試，得兊卦。","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019127835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580910149668"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊註：卦逢六冲，冲之即散。","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019144219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予見此卦雖係六冲，世爻皆逢旺地，不敢决之。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705991741480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"請之再占一卦，又得臨之師。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705991757864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世，酉亥，丑，丑卯。","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019193371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019160603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子、財兄、兄官。","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019160603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦官星持世，雖則不旺，初爻官生文旰，與前卦相合，計之必發，果浔成名。","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019176987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡淂六冲卦，官父世爻俱旺者，不必再占，竟許必發。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705991774248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如欠旺者，須再占一卦，再淂吉者，以吉斷之；後凶者，卽以凶非。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705991790632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580910166052"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡淂六合卦，六要官父世爻淂地，有一失陷，不遇生扶者，雖六合六無益矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705991807016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父旺官衰，终湏下第。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705991823400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父爻旺相，官臨空破墓絶，及動而變凶變尅，雖有錦绣文章，終遇江紗","logicSentenceId":"7586703705991839784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔽日。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705991839784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父衰官旺，堪許登科。","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019209755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官爻旺而生世持世，若是父爻不旺，謂之福齊。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705991872552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文不齊，反許逐志。","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019226139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應合日生，必資鸮薦。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705991888936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580910182436"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官文兩旺而世爻不旺，㦯淂日月扶肋，又得應爻動而生合世爻者，必淂推薦之力。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705991905320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動傷日尅，還守鷄宓。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705991921704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應爻動爻，雖米生合世爻，而應爻動爻又被日月冲尅者，薦六無功。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705991938088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世動化官化尅，蝶夢堪憂。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705991954472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊有身官化鬼，月扶連歩蟾宫。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705991970856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：身與變鬼，来試方成。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705991987240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：身動化空用旺，豹變翻成蝶夢。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992003624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580910198820"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"皆以卦身而言。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992020008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予試終無應騐，惟騐扵世爻，而世爻化鬼，六有两騐。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992036392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中父母旺相，而世爻化出官星者，若不回頭尅世，乃變為官，今科即中，豈待来科","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992052776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"？","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992052776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世若休囚被尅，動而化出官星者，乃為化鬼，不惟不中，且見危火化虫，鬼爻尅世者，更凶。","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019242523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如卯月戊辰日，占鄊試，淂離之旣濟。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992085544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應，","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019258907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巳火，未酉，兄子財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥丑卯，","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019258907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子水鬼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊申。","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019258907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼子","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992101928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992101928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580910215204"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊註：身官化鬼，月扶則鵬程連歩蟾宫。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992118312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂卦身如得官父臨之，必有成望。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992134696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若淂出現發動，化出爻又淂月建生合者，必主聮捷。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992151080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：此卦巳為卦身，又是世爻變去子水官星，又得月建生合，正合此説，竟未見其連捷。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992167464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不惟不能連捷，且難保其長年。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992183848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其故何也？","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992200232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因變出子水之鬼，回頭尅世，客夗扵途。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992216616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如酉月丁巳日，占郷試，淂小過之泰。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992233000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戍申，","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992249384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"午申午辰，官兄官父。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父兄，","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992249384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丑父。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅子。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992249384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580910231588"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻午火，官星化出丑土，文章官文两旺。","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019275291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因丑父旬空，午歲郷試得意，丑年甲榜先登。","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019291675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：若以世動化空，用旺豹變，翻成蝶夢，此卦豈非世動化空邪？","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992265768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午年登科，丑年發甲，而未見其蝶夢。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992282152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所以化空者，必應實空之年也。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992298536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身興化旺化生，龍池變化。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992314920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻旺相，動而變出官星，回頭生合世爻者，不仆愛鬼乃變官。","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019308059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如卯月乙未日，占㑹試，得觀之履。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992331304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應，卯巳","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992347688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"未父。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯，","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992347688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巳未，官父。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580910247972"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992347688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"午，官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財卯巳。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992347688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未土，父母臨日建而持世，化出午火官星，回頭生世，二爻巳火又生世爻，初爻未土又来拱扶，許之高發，果中會魁。","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019324443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世退，官星化退，窓下囊萤。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992364072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世與官父俱旺，内有一而化進神者，名姓髙縣。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992380456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占鄊試者，必然聮捷。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992396840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㯮不喜之。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992413224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化退神，世化退神，若非臨塲之阻，必無","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992429608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勇泩之心，父化退神，學问日頽，文鄣漸腐。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992429608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官化退","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019340827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580910264356"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神，皓首無成。","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019340827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當扵進退章中叅考。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992445992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財臨白虎持身，幃前枕塊，舊係","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992462376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財臨白虎，必丁憂。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992462376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三六不惟臨虎，凢遇財爻持世，或財動卦中父母，又值休囚空破，及财動化父，父動化財，皆有騐之。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992495144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾卦如天六，要官文两旺，雷聲如震，猶有空破。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992511528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"為𭒡","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992527912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古以乹震二卦卽以為吉，予試務必官文兩旰，始以吉㫁，否則未見為吉。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992527912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580910280740"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衰旺尅冲，輕重湏冝细玩。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992544296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"墓絶空破，應期章内詳之。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992560680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前應期章湏宜熟記，各门各類，無不问其應期，熟則觸類旁通，随心應口。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992577064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡遇用神，衰要有根，旺冝中和，尅要有救，冲要逢合。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992593448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"陞遷候補章第又五十五","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992609832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官爵榮身，湏冝持世，財恩養，最喜生身。","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019357211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺官持世，及日月動爻，作官星生合世爻，或世爻","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992626216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580910297124"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"發動，化出官星生世，皆吉。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992626216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：財動生官淂美缺，官臨日月必超遷。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992642600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫持世，休望榮除。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992658984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官位空破，勿思陞遷。","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019373595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫持世，子孫動扵卦中，陞遷無期。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992675368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官臨空破墓絶，及動而變凶，補陞尚早，雨露承恩，合中逢合，世與官星三合，官局財局或生世，或世在局中，成官星持世，與日月動爻相合，得逢六合卦，及卦動變六合者，皆是","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992691752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"承恩之曰。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992691752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580910313508"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如申月乙亥日，占會缺，淂否","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992724520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"井之莭。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992724520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應，子戊申","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019389979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"酉官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥，","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019389979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丑財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父財官，丑父巳。","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019389979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：内卦己酉丑合成官局，而生應爻，不来生世，正所謂出現無情，此缺不淂。","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019406363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：如何不淂？","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992757288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余曰：官生應爻，一㝎不淂。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992773672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼果另㸃他人。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992790056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"風雲未際，冲上逢冲，世官不旺，又淂六冲，或是官被日月相冲，或是卦浔六冲變冲，乃風雲未際之時也。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992806440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580910329892"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元神衰静，洩氣爻揺，问陞遷以無期。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992822824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假令官爻屬木，水爻衰而不動，火爻發動是也。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992839208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992855592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世乆發動，官化進神，望榮除而在。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992871976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992888360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻發動，或動而化吉，或禄馬貴人臨世，及官動化吉，生合世爻，皆可束装以待。","logicSentenceId":"7586703705992888360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世官破而𠇲望，世福空而六陞。","logicSentenceId":"7586703706112917539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世臨月破，即使官星持世，不獨不能陞遷，且妨","logicSentenceId":"7586703706112933923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"他變。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫持世，值旬空，亦不當陞。","logicSentenceId":"7586703706112933923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若占三兩曰之内者，","logicSentenceId":"7586703706112950307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580910346276"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"許之必淂。","logicSentenceId":"7586703706112950307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其故何也？","logicSentenceId":"7586703706112966691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫尚未出空，不尅官也。","logicSentenceId":"7586703706112983075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：占過三人，俱皆淂官，得官之後，随卽死亡。","logicSentenceId":"7586703706112999459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申月戊寅日。","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113015843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占得差否，澤天夬。","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019422747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應，未酉亥辰寅，子兄子財兄官財。","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019439131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷曰：子孫持世，此差不淂，世空亦不得，豈知不岀三日淂差，行至中途而死。","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113032227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其故何也？","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113048611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三日之内而淂差者，子孫未去空也。","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113064995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中途而火者，世爻空也。","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019455515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又寅月庚辰日，","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113081379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580910362660"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占淂需。","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113081379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應，子戍申辰寅，子財兄子兄官财。","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019471899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"475","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：余凢占得不騐之卦，刻刻在心，因見此卦，悟前㸃差之卦。","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113097763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦亦是子孫持世，遇旬空，亦是只在三两日命下。","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113114147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予竟許之，果淂缺，不出两月。","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019488283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"而亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又辰月丁丑日，占起用，己列名矣，","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113130531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得漸之觀。","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113130531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應，卯巳未，","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019504667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"申子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午辰。","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019504667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼父兄、卯父兄。","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019521051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦與前二卦大同小異。","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113163299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前二卦子孫持世，遇旬","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113179683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580910379044"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空未曽發動，此卦動而變官，况亦係三两日之事。","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113179683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫尚未出空，竟許必得，果得起用。","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113196067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"起程六日，家内死","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113212451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子。","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113212451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"到任八個月，终扵任身子乃應世，舆子孫同變鬼也。","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019537435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：後二卦余淂騐者，乃因前卦不靈，刻刻甾心之故耳。","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113245219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今人占過卽忘，何得精奧","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113261603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"？","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113261603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"随官入墓，世旺者官陞。","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019553819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"助鬼傷身，身衰者袖至。","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019570203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古以随官入墓，助鬼傷身，皆以為凶，余屢試之，世旺者竟陞，世衰者不𠮷。","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113294371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561580910395428"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"助鬼傷身，元神同動者，其官必陞","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113310755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世。","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113310755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若休囚者，必有禍至。","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019586587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如寅月乙未日，占陛，淂比之觀。","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019602971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世，","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113343523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子水財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌申，","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113343523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卯木。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳未，卯木。","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113343523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄子官父兄。","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019619355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：卯木旺官持世，子水財動相生，雖則墓于未日，幸世爻淂𦔳無妨，果淂陞扵亥月。","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019635739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如戌月辛酉日，占何月補官，淂蹇之需卦。","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113359907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應，子戍申申。","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019652123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"午辰，鬼父。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子父兄，兄寅子。","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113376291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561753579880491"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅木財爻生助，午火之见火鬼尅世，乃為助鬼傷身。","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019668507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"幸辰土生申金，午火貪生忘尅，今年冬月必陞，果淂陞於冬月。","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113392675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應冬月者，辰土化子水空亡，十一月則不空矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113409059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古以晉升為言，又云：屯蹇為凶。","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113425443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"晋卦升卦果淂屢驗。","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113441827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦要世爻得地，若失陥，六不為吉。","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113458211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"屯卦蹇卦，世爻任相者何妨。","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113474595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前篇亥月丙寅之占，騐世爻旺相，竟得超陞，豈非屯卦耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113490979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561753579896875"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"陞遷何方章第五十六","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113507363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"526","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官金而應西土，木官必應扵東水，北火南土陞中土，此古法也。","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019684891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余之淂騐，木官而應山東六，有應廣東者。","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113523747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金官應山陕六，有應江西、廣西者。","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019701275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又有以住𠁅而分東西南北者，如未月己巳日，住在京都占地方，淂歸妹變觯。","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113540131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世，戌申午、丑、卯，","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019717659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父兄官，父財寅。","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019717659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼時有山東、真㝎兩缺，此卦巳火官星，許之真运。","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113556515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561753579913259"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：何也？","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113572899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：巳火官星乃南方也，必淂真㝎。","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113589283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"真㝎乃都门之南也，果淂真定。","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113605667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又有以初爻為内地，以五爻、六爻為遣缺。","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113622051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應初爻者，世與自星皆在初爻者是也。","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113638435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應五六爻者，或世在五爻，官在六爻；或世在六爻，官在五爻；或官星持世，同在五六爻上是也。","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113654819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若在二三四爻，仍以五行决之。","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113671203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如丑月癸支日，占","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113687587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陞何方，淂山風蛊。","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113687587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"544","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世，寅子戊酉亥丑","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019734043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561753579929643"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，兄父財官父财。","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019734043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"547","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦酉官持世，許任西方。","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113720355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及至次年見𨕖单，又占官陞何方。","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113736739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"549","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅月甲戍日，淂震卦。","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113753123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"550","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應，戊申午辰寅子，財官子財兄父。","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019750427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余猶記淂前卦，酉官持世，曽許西方。","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113769507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今見此卦，又見官屬申金，西方必矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113785891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但見世在六爻，必是遑缺。","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113802275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"问之：陕西有邊缺否？","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113818659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：有慶陽。","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113835043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：卽此缺也。","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113851427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果陞慶陽。","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113867811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561753579946027"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：大槩问其地方，雖則有騐，然又不如指其缺而问之。","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113884195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此缺我淂否？","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113900579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我淂詞林否？","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113916963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我淂部屬否？","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113933347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我得科道否？","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113949731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我得正印否？","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113966115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官星持世者，必淂官動；生合世爻者，必淂三合官局；生世者，必淂","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113982499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世空世破。","logicSentenceId":"7586703706113982499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官破官空，俱不淂。","logicSentenceId":"7631098845019766811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫持世，子孫發動，不淂；","logicSentenceId":"7586703706114015267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官臨應爻，不得；三合官局而生應爻，不得。","logicSentenceId":"7586703706114015267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561616434724918"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2","lineNum":0,"lineType":4,"content":"增刪卜易卷八","logicSentenceId":"7586690343094927412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"3","lineNum":0,"lineType":7,"content":"野鶴老人著","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":7,"content":"椘江李坦我平鑒㝎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":7,"content":"湖南李文輝覺子増刪","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":7,"content":"婿陳文吉茂生、男茹芝山秀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":7,"content":"仝訂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"占面聖上書、叩閽獻策、條陳劾奏章第六十二","logicSentenceId":"7586690343094943796","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡占文書，亦須採用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺文持世，冝日月嵗五以维持。","logicSentenceId":"7630791705194053658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母為文書章奏，持世合世，奏必見准。","logicSentenceId":"7630791705194070042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再浔𡻕五及日月動爻生合者，見用無疑。","logicSentenceId":"7586690343094960180","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561616434741302"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟臨身，喜父母化吉而拱合。","logicSentenceId":"7586690343094976564","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟持世，日月生之，或世爻、父母爻動而化吉，或世化父母生世，以上皆淂喜動龍顏，因文見用。","logicSentenceId":"7630791705194086426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財爻持世破文書。","logicSentenceId":"7586690343094992948","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財爻持世，財爻發動尅破文書，無盖之奏；倘淂父母持世，財官同動者，而又喜之。","logicSentenceId":"7630791705194102810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其故何也？","logicSentenceId":"7586690343095009332","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以財動而生官，官動而生世也。","logicSentenceId":"7586690343095025716","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子福臨身防降罰。","logicSentenceId":"7586690343095042100","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561616434757686"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫為尅官之神，有職之官，章拳者不冝見之。","logicSentenceId":"7586690343095058484","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㦯持世，或發動，輕則降罰，重則休官。","logicSentenceId":"7586690343095074868","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無職之人而章奏者，有兩論之，湏察来人之念。","logicSentenceId":"7586690343095091252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼行此事，原為求名者，見之必不成名；彼行此事，悲其有禍者，見之無禍。","logicSentenceId":"7586690343095107636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世臨空破，難以回天。","logicSentenceId":"7586690343095124020","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世值旬空、月破及臨绝、化絕及入三墓者，不蒙見准，宜早知機。","logicSentenceId":"7630791705194119194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世動變凶，或嵗五日月動爻冲尅世爻者，不惟難","logicSentenceId":"7586690343095140404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561616434774070"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以囬天，且防不測之禍。","logicSentenceId":"7586690343095140404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫臨身，力能折槛。","logicSentenceId":"7586690343095156788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：前說子動尅官，不冝見之，此喜子孫持世者，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7586690343095173172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：湏看事之大小，有職之官行此事者，豫料此事卽不准行，無過扵革職而己。","logicSentenceId":"7586690343095189556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫者，卽為尅官之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7586690343095205940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲保全㓛名，子孫發動，切勿行之。","logicSentenceId":"7586690343095222324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘若條陳将相，諫諍君非，若淂准行，名垂青史。","logicSentenceId":"7586690343095238708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如不見，惟禍及其身。","logicSentenceId":"7586690343095255092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所以反喜子孫持世，卽使殿折庭争，","logicSentenceId":"7586690343095271476","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561616434790454"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可保無禔。","logicSentenceId":"7586690343095271476","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古以子發乾宫為吉，非也。","logicSentenceId":"7586690343095287860","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫為制鬼之福神，未闻獨在乾宫而為福神也。","logicSentenceId":"7586690343095304244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1tpjii/1-7630734443494588454_QQ_1776669242465.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=MzFfi%2BcqxkV3z%2Fm4G3Wa7qnZYPQ%3D","pictureHeight":512,"pictureWidth":232,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1tpjii/1-7630734443494588454_QQ_1776669242465.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=ZRSYMEHWgkBpbwgZCmHglWM%2BHrA%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1tpjii/1-7630734443494588454_QQ_1776669242465.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如己年己月丁卯日占劾奏，淂旅卦。","logicSentenceId":"7586690343095320628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：有人執此卦而問予曰：我欲劾奏權奸，恐其彼之根固，反𮞸其害。","logicSentenceId":"7586690343095337012","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爾看𬼘卦何如？","logicSentenceId":"7586690343095353396","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：彼雖帶固根深，今已壊矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586690343095369780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"問曰：何以知之？","logicSentenceId":"7586690343095386164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：應爻酉金長生扵巳年巳月，豈非盤根耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586690343095402548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今被歲月之尅，卯","logicSentenceId":"7630791705194135578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561616434806838"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日冲之，有傷無救，所以知其彼之權勢自此衰矣。","logicSentenceId":"7630791705194135578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又问曰：我有害否？","logicSentenceId":"7586690343095418932","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：子孫持世，何害之有？","logicSentenceId":"7586690343095435316","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果蒙准行，奸勢败矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586690343095451700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"最忌官爻尅世，猶嫌助鬼傷身。","logicSentenceId":"7586690343095468084","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官鬼尅世，已兆凶徴。","logicSentenceId":"7586690343095484468","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再加財動而肋鬼者，其禍難免。","logicSentenceId":"7586690343095500852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻變鬼動化回頭之尅，随鬼入墓，卦淂反吟、卦變绝、世被冲尅者，事非重大，急冝止之。","logicSentenceId":"7586690343095517236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歳五生身防受制，六爻怳惚且休行。","logicSentenceId":"7586690343095533620","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太𡻕生世，必要入爻，不在爻中，不能生世。","logicSentenceId":"7586690343095550004","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如今","logicSentenceId":"7586690563865329664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561616434823222"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲子年，湏看卦中有子父爻者是也。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563865329664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖以五爻生世為吉，飲防受尅，及空衰破絶，有生之名，無生之實。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563865346048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1tpw5m/1-7630734470711083018_QQ_1776669478345.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=MU1J9c0NoLITDkkv%2B5091WwiOno%3D","pictureHeight":520,"pictureWidth":158,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1tpw5m/1-7630734470711083018_QQ_1776669478345.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=2D2xn2ak85TiZ53mkfH9OnlUJIE%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1tpw5m/1-7630734470711083018_QQ_1776669478345.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如申月戊辰日占上書，淂中孚之損。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563865362432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：五位巳火生世，不冝巳火受尅，此書冝止。","logicSentenceId":"7630791705194151962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"问曰：有害否？","logicSentenceId":"7586690563865378816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：巳火雖則不能生世，卦中無尅世之爻，利害皆無。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563865395200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後上之，果不准行。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563865411584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：凡上書劾奏，果有典利除害，益扵國者，捨身為國，雖蹈湯赴火而不辭，何用占卜？","logicSentenceId":"7586690563865427968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘若事無","logicSentenceId":"7586690563865444352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561616434839606"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"阅係，或目怠而抱不平，或以直而報怨，事在両可之间者，必得世與父爻皆無刑冲尅破，及歳五日月相生，方可行之。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563865444352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘爻中亂動，而用神元神非旺非衰，或生少尅多，六爻怳惚者，卽冝止之。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563865460736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言出柚随，淂不慎乎？","logicSentenceId":"7586690563865477120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父旺官生，叨蒙贈爵；旺官持世，平歩登雲。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563865493504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺父持世，官動生之。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563865509888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺官持世，曰月生之，官則官上加官，士則身登甚阁，平人淂者，立見午步登雲。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563865526272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：斷卦者最重来人之念。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563865542656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此行有為人者，有","logicSentenceId":"7586690563865559040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561616434855990"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"為己者，有為自身父母而雪怨者，有為保全人己之切名，有為財利而行者，有為免自己之貽累者，有為辨下屬之賠累者。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563865559040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"事之多端，在人通變。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563865575424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"士民上書，雖則亦有忠心為國，亦有借此以仆惜梯而求名也。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563865591808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘淂官旺而文不旺，心可許之贈職封官。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563865608192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其故何也？","logicSentenceId":"7586690563865624576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼之初念，原為淂官，文乃敺门之兒耳，所以重官而不重文也。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563865640960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我念為名，忌子孫之發動；我念為利，忌弟兄以臨身。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563865657344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1tq8sq/1-7630737244625747968_QQ_1776669780445.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=ssFf5cwi8IQrsj5tw8svNNW1Wic%3D","pictureHeight":518,"pictureWidth":90,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1tq8sq/1-7630737244625747968_QQ_1776669780445.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=m%2FYDzIWSsebFjZkEGBb11Df6MFs%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1tq8sq/1-7630737244625747968_QQ_1776669780445.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如丑月丙辰日占","logicSentenceId":"7586690563865673728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561616434872374"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其文伸枉、保全功名，淂大壮之夬。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563865673728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母持世，月建文書極旺，但不冝子動傷官。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563865690112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七八月申金淂令之秋，切名壞矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563865706496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果豪上䑓應保，未蒙准行，八月削職，此乃為名文旺，亦屬無益。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563865722880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1tqlfu/1-7630737305964298246_QQ_1776669826633.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=m%2F4jZuO5%2FfE8R09RABalViarWdA%3D","pictureHeight":506,"pictureWidth":154,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1tqlfu/1-7630737305964298246_QQ_1776669826633.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=O9SUN8cH5rBx4XPeSywvxmhC0u8%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1tqlfu/1-7630737305964298246_QQ_1776669826633.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如卯月辛北日占具文辨懇開銷，淂訟之履：","logicSentenceId":"7586690563865739264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03by33r4sgr/1-7630735585543946266_QQ_1776669913778.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=7l7P2rSku%2BWcqX1v1KTg8xt7em0%3D","pictureHeight":508,"pictureWidth":230,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03by33r4sgr/1-7630735585543946266_QQ_1776669913778.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=1b%2B5NZMis1E9s5at%2FqQ1d7GJ%2FT4%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03by33r4sgr/1-7630735585543946266_QQ_1776669913778.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：旺文雖則生世，不冝兄弟持世，上司之章奏","logicSentenceId":"7586690563865755648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561616434888758"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必行，我財終湏要破，後果已蒙題辨，不准𫔭銷。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563865755648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占防叅劾、慮大計，及已有事尚未结案者：","logicSentenceId":"7586690563865772032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世旺官崇，憂心氷解；旺官持世，喜照雙睂。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563865788416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世與官星旺相，何慮何憂？","logicSentenceId":"7630791705194168346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再得曰：月動爻生扶，或淂世爻官爻臨乎？","logicSentenceId":"7586690563865804800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日","logicSentenceId":"7586690563865821184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月及動而變吉，防㕘劾者何慮，已叅而未結案者無憂。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563865821184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"慮大計者，不獨無憂。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563865837568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"公慿卓異。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563865853952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡得旺官持世，亦同此推。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563865870336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
