{"lines":[{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如未月戊申日占因遲悮軍糧，已被","logicSentenceId":"7586690563865886720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561616434905142"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"叅劾，得豊之旅。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563865886720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：世臨日建、月建生之，動出戊官，又来相生，官爵無恙。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563865919488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸人不以為然，豈知因獲奇功，保亦随至，功名仍復保全。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563865935872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：卯木子孫發動，如何不尅官？","logicSentenceId":"7586690563865952256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：木絕扵申，所以有救。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563865968640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03by33r5hqz/1-7630740255808684038_QQ_1776670207110.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=bq3AE%2FbNma8ixP469JUPFGFWYMQ%3D","pictureHeight":516,"pictureWidth":84,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03by33r5hqz/1-7630740255808684038_QQ_1776670207110.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=Rz97%2FHIUVsVBO2vuc4dJHBxeraQ%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03by33r5hqz/1-7630740255808684038_QQ_1776670207110.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福","logicSentenceId":"7586690563865985024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世孫揺身化福，空官鬼破變爻傷。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563865985024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫持世，子孫動於卦中，世動化子孫，官破官空，及動化回頭之尅，皆主罷職休官。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563866001408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03by33r5ue3/1-7630738352342843418_QQ_1776670319652.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=SSoGvrDnduE2CosYTSkSgraZOG0%3D","pictureHeight":500,"pictureWidth":84,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03by33r5ue3/1-7630738352342843418_QQ_1776670319652.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=B%2FWb%2FWl687owgDMVJAiVACb1zVQ%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03by33r5ue3/1-7630738352342843418_QQ_1776670319652.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如寅月丁巳日占","logicSentenceId":"7586690563866017792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561616434921526"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"慮大計，淂旅之明𢑱。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563866017792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：子孫持世，雖化回頭之尅，世心受尅。","logicSentenceId":"7630791705194184730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外卦己酉丑雖則金局，以生伏神之官，𡖋無用矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563866034176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果削職。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563866050560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03by33r6717/1-7630739581960896531_QQ_1776670394323.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=qqmTRxlpdAjTRds7HRnk1%2Bq5ZGI%3D","pictureHeight":502,"pictureWidth":150,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03by33r6717/1-7630739581960896531_QQ_1776670394323.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=r04gF45l2xerg1%2BfKUyr3jKMLjo%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03by33r6717/1-7630739581960896531_QQ_1776670394323.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子動財空，减祿罰俸。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563866066944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟持世，兄弟發動，或則破財空，及財動化凶，倘淂官爻旺相，罰俸","logicSentenceId":"7586690563866083328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而己；官失䧟，利名復失。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563866083328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身衰鬼尅，貶責凌辱。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563866116096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世衰不遇生扶。","logicSentenceId":"7630794973176135707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又有歳五、日月、動爻刑冲尅世，或","logicSentenceId":"7586690563866132480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561616434937910"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官動尅世，或世随鬼墓，世動化鬼化尅，及乕蛇刑尅世爻者，輕則張罰，重則刑獄。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563866132480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：何以謂之輕重？","logicSentenceId":"7586690563866148864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：輕者，乃也爻之有救也。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563866165248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重者，乃世爻休囚，又被刑傷冲尅也。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563866181632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦静世空官又陥，林下闲人。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563866198016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世空者，退休之兆。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563866214400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官又空破休囚者，削職無疑。","logicSentenceId":"7630794973176152091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世陷逢生，殺興何碍？","logicSentenceId":"7586690563866230784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古有身空殺動，避禍之徵，予以為非。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563866247168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殊不知忘神動扵卦中，世爻空者，待世爻出空之月日，必𮞸其","logicSentenceId":"7586690563866263552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561616434954294"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"害，豈能避之？","logicSentenceId":"7586690563866263552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟世空逢元神動而相生，卦中雖有忌神發動，志無碍矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563866279936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"待世爻出空之日，忌神反生元神而生世也。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563866296320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官隆世陷，身辱官存。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563866312704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古有“身邊伏鬼若非空，官職猶在。”","logicSentenceId":"7586690563866329088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂凢遇凶兆。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563866345472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若浔官爻持世，或官伏世下而旺，雖見責罰，而官職猶存。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563866361856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：歳遇五爻之尅，若淂旺官生合世交，及旺","logicSentenceId":"7586690563866378240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561616434970678"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官持世，雖則逢辱，仍復為官。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563866378240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03by33r6job/1-7630764288382730240_QQ_1776676459083.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=wUXqY0epabX10%2Bng2UoVJp%2FNcrk%3D","pictureHeight":496,"pictureWidth":220,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03by33r6job/1-7630764288382730240_QQ_1776676459083.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=HELXFYtRBHCd89dDjoh9ZHRuCPA%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03by33r6job/1-7630764288382730240_QQ_1776676459083.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如丑月戊辰日占防叅劾，淂井之","logicSentenceId":"7586690563866411008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中孚。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563866411008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此","logicSentenceId":"7586690563866443776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"公因新換督撫，有防叅劾。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563866443776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：此卦甚奇，世空以逢日冲，不為空矣；","logicSentenceId":"7586690563866460160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世不受尅而晴動，雖無叅論，離任不免。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563866460160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：旣無𠫭論，如何離任？","logicSentenceId":"7586690563866492928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：世爻暗動，必主動搖，内卦已自丑合成官局，以生應爻，故知𬼘位已屬他人矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563866509312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"浚因裁他䖏之缺，上䑓題溜","logicSentenceId":"7586690563866525696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561616434987062"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"他䖏之官，頂此公之位，換此公回亰另補，此亦少徑見之事。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563866525696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"知㡬者神也。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563866542080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身實官陥，位去身安。","logicSentenceId":"7586690563866558464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻旺相，不受傷尅，官破官空，及被刑冲尅害，或動而變凶者，官禄雖失，身不逢傷。","logicSentenceId":"7630794973176168475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"功名到何品级章第六十六","logicSentenceId":"7586693914086916130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561616435085366"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古法，水一，火二，木三，金四，土五。","logicSentenceId":"7630794973176250395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官臨火者，官居二品；官星属水，一品之尊。","logicSentenceId":"7630794973176266779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：水止一數，位至公侯者，何以㝎之？","logicSentenceId":"7586693914086932514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官設九品，數止扵五，六、七品者，何以㝎之？","logicSentenceId":"7586693914086948898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余淂其法者，指占之法也。","logicSentenceId":"7586693914086965282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我能公侯否？","logicSentenceId":"7586693914086981666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我能将相否？","logicSentenceId":"7586693914086998050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我能一品否？","logicSentenceId":"7586693914087014434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我能八座否？","logicSentenceId":"7586693914087030818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺官臨日月，指日可期，官破及刑冲，終身失望。","logicSentenceId":"7586693914087047202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫持世，猶如止渇望梅；官動生身，恰似探嚢取物。","logicSentenceId":"7586693914087063586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曽有邑宰问：将来官至方面否？","logicSentenceId":"7586693914087079970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己月乙卯日占，淂","logicSentenceId":"7586693914087096354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561616435101750"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雷山小過，午火官星持世，浚果官至命事。","logicSentenceId":"7586693914087096354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又子月乙亥日官至方伯，问将耒能扵開府否？","logicSentenceId":"7586693914087112738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"連占三卦，子孫持世，浚果降調而歸。","logicSentenceId":"7586693914087129122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又因占會試，許之必中。","logicSentenceId":"7586693914087145506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又問：可能鼎甲否？","logicSentenceId":"7586693914087161890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：必湏再占一卦。","logicSentenceId":"7586693914087178274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯月甲申日，淂節之蹇。","logicSentenceId":"7586693914087194658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：古以蹇為不吉。","logicSentenceId":"7630794973176283163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予重用神，此卦世臨巳火，卯月生之，申日合之，青龍持世，中鼎甲而無疑，但非","logicSentenceId":"7586693914087211042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561616435118134"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今科之鼎甲也。","logicSentenceId":"7586693914087211042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"公曰：何也？","logicSentenceId":"7586693914087227426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：世爻變出辰土之官，乃辰年之鼎甲也。","logicSentenceId":"7586693914087243810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"公曰：此𡢏暗合我機，我少年浔一預兆，亦","logicSentenceId":"7586693914087260194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應辰年。","logicSentenceId":"7586693914087260194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"塲畢即回。","logicSentenceId":"7630794973176299547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至甲辰科殿試，果得首唱傳臚。","logicSentenceId":"7586693914087292962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所以教人指其事而占者，無不騐也，何必諄諄執古法而猜耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586693914087309346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父旺官動相生，日月作官星而生父母，父旺化官，父官動而化吉，皆許成名。","logicSentenceId":"7630794973176315931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財尅父，子動傷官，父官動而變凶，日月尅官尅父，","logicSentenceId":"7586693914087342114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561616435134518"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或父爻官爻衰墓破絶，皆許無益。","logicSentenceId":"7586693914087342114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如卯月壬辰日占父何時起用，","logicSentenceId":"7586693914087358498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淂風水渙變夬","logicSentenceId":"7586693914087358498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7586693914087358498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内卦寅木父母旺而化出子水之官，許寅年起用。","logicSentenceId":"7630794973176332315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果應寅年，仍以原品起用，後終扵未年。","logicSentenceId":"7586693914087391266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又以此卦悟之，杓爻寅木，父寅年而起用，上爻卯木父動而化未墓，墓扵未年。","logicSentenceId":"7586693914087407650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占時未墓爻空，謂之空墓以待死，所以終扵實墓之年。","logicSentenceId":"7586693914087424034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又囙用神重疂，逢墓庫以","logicSentenceId":"7586693914087440418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561616435150902"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"收藏。","logicSentenceId":"7586693914087440418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如辰月戊申","logicSentenceId":"7630794973176348699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日占","logicSentenceId":"7630794973176348699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父在京候補，淂觀之渙。","logicSentenceId":"7630794973176348699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未土父毋持世，巳火官動生之，果得缺補扵四川，巳月卽歸，巳火生世之故耳。","logicSentenceId":"7586693914087456802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"李我平曰：問何時，問地方，須冝分占，不可一卦而棄㫁。","logicSentenceId":"7586693914087473186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若乗新者，假使官值申金，必陞扵七月。","logicSentenceId":"7586693914087489570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論分野者，申乃西晋之地，豈七月之陞遷，必淂西方之缺邪？","logicSentenceId":"7586693914087505954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古法之謬者明矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586693914087522338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又以八宫雠南坎北，又以二十八宿","logicSentenceId":"7586693914087538722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561616435167286"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以㝎分野。","logicSentenceId":"7586693914087538722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：“食祿扵此土，以祿㝎方。”","logicSentenceId":"7586693914087555106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：“逰魂逺而歸魂近。”","logicSentenceId":"7586693914087571490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易冒以五行、六神、八宫為徑，諸星為偉以叅之，此可説而不可行也。","logicSentenceId":"7586693914087587874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行、八宫及二十八宿，尚亦近理，若以六神而𠔥星形者，乃妄談也。","logicSentenceId":"7586693914087604258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假使丁日占得雷風恒卦，酉金官星持世，必司兵權。","logicSentenceId":"7586693914087620642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神淂滕蛇，蛇乃馳聚差遣之官。","logicSentenceId":"7586693914087637026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁以酉為文昌，文昌為翰林，執彼之法而新者，酉官為经，螣蛇、文昌為師，㝎是掌兵權扵翰苑，聼差遣馳釋之詞林也。","logicSentenceId":"7586693914087653410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸書之論求財，弗如黄金策，理真論確，屢試屢騐，惜乎未绖分别。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683140968463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今以前段為緫論，以後段分門，使浚賢易曉。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683140984847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内有屢試而不騐者則之，余另淂其騐者増之。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141001231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財旺福興，公私穪意。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141017615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財空福絶，上下違心。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478909321216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561753580617771"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上至國課，下至營謀，無不以財為用。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141033999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"公占私卜，皆以財為用神。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141050383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫者，乃生助財爻之元神也，俱冝旺而化吉，又冝生合世爻，公私皆淂如意。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141066767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若逢裹墓、绝空、刑冲、尅害，動而變凶，日月冲破者，上下皆違心矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141083151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟乃刼財之神，占财之最忌也。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478909353984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財𫤰兄爻同動，必主阻隔破耗。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141115919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘若財爻静而不動及不上卦者，若淂子孫與兄弟同動，又為可喜。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141132303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄動生子孫，故","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141148687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561753580634155"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂之有望。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141148687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財爻、兄爻、子孫爻俱動扵卦中者，更為可喜。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141165071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其故何也？","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141181455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄動生子，子動生財，其利甚厚，且有久逺源流之利益也。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141197839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄興財振，官爻發動，□堪求。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141214223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄爻與財爻同動，而官鬼六動者，亦許得財，以官鬼尅制兄爻之故耳。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141230607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財與子孫爻俱不現卦，或現扵卦中，又值休囚空","logicSentenceId":"7633451478909370368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561753580650539"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破墓绝，或被刑冲尅壞，湏冝株守，圖則無益。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478909370368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：倘得曰月為財，或伏而旺者，□可求也。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141263375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父兄爻動，無殊縁木求魚。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141279759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父動尅福神，兄動尅財爻，此二爻動扵卦中，凡有所圖。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141296143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水中撈月。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141312527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應如酉月戊午日，未酉亥亥丑卯。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478909386752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占求財，淂单卦鬼父兄兄鬼子，斷曰：卦中財爻不現，度水兄文持世，父臨月建，生助兄爻，如緣木以求魚也。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478909403136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561753580666923"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多財反覆，必湏墓庫以収截。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141328911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中財臨日月，謂之太旺，或動變俱是财爻，日月又作財星，謂之重疂。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141345295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若許求財淂意之時，湏待財爻入墓之日，且如水仆財神辰日而淂，餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141361679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無鬼分争，又怕交重而阻滯。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141378063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟乃争奪阻隔耗財之神，冝官鬼動而制之，以免分争之患。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141394447","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：兄爻發動，喜鬼動以制之。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141410831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘卦中兄文安静者，又不冝乎鬼動，鬼動，反洩財爻之氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141427215","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且有","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141443599","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561753580683307"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口舌。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141443599","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄如太過，反不尅財。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141459983","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊註：卦中一位兄爻動者，最為利害。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141476367","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如若兄弟支多，動者，反不劫财。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141492751","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：非也。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141509135","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄爻多者，淂兄爻入墓之日，及尅損兄爻之曰，必刦其財。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141525519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂之太旺者，損之斯成。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141541903","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如巳月丙辰日","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141558287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"，應世乂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占放印子錢，淂","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141558287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巳火未酉兄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午火辰","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141558287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"，寅，木父。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未濟之歸妹，戊土子財兄，子，","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141558287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巳火兄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561753580699691"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦月建世爻動文變爻俱是兄爻，占卦之浚，雖則順，遂，浚至九月，乃兄爻入墓之月，因姦情而破耗，豈可謂之兄爻太過，反不刼其財？","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141558287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"郥世遇兄臨，必難求望。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478909419520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古以卦身臨兄爻，難扵求望。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141574671","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予囙卦身不騐，只以世爻為圭，兄爻持世，難遂圖謀。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141591055","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：全在人之通變。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141607439","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟而持世者，雖則為忌，心有不當忌者。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141623823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應如未月丁卯日，","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141640207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己未酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金卯水巳未","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141640207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561753580716075"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141640207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占借貸，得晋卦，鬼父兄財，鬼父。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478909435904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷曰：雖則兄爻持世，而曰無財，但喜卯曰卽是財星。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478909452288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古以財爻尅世，冲世者必得，况應爻未𡈽旺而生世，明日必獲，果扵辰曰淂財。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141656591","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應辰日者，世動逢合之日也。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141672975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㐅應○世乂。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141689359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"〇又如巳月丁巳日，占","logicSentenceId":"7633451478909468672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子水，戌，申亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水","logicSentenceId":"7633451478909468672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兄兄丑𡈽，卯木官子孫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"求財，得旣濟變渙卦，","logicSentenceId":"7633451478909468672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卯木。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼","logicSentenceId":"7633451478909468672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子孫父。午火辰𡈽寅卯，財官、子孫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：若占久逺之財者，則無財也。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478909468672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若问目下之財，明日戊午必淂，其故何也？","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141705743","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄臨世爻。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141722127","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破月破，不","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141738511","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561753580732459"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅變出之財，况日月俱仆，財来冲世，只因應爻而逢空，明日冲實，㝎送財来。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141738511","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141754895","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" {"lines":[{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如己月戊寅日，占○世應何日淂財？","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141771279","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淂離之豊","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141787663","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"。巳火兄，未酉亥丑卯。戌圡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141787663","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財鬼子父。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141787663","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷曰：酉金財爻不動，明日卯曰：中動，財爻，明日必淂。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478909485056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：兄弟持世，如何淂財？","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141804047","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：兄爻動而化墓，不尅财爻，果扵次日淂之。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141820431","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：余非他書之比，偶然凑合，皍以為式，務必","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141836815","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561753580748843"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"屢試而屢騐者，故敢敎人以為法也。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141836815","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予凡占淂兄爻持世，而世值月破、旬空、化墓，及日月作財，冲世、尅世，或世爻兄弟變去財爻，皆許得財，屢占淂騐，方敢告之。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141853199","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若世持兄弟，非此類者，不可如此斷也。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141869583","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財来就我終湏易，我去尋財必是八。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141885967","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊註：凢遇財爻生世、合世、尅世、持世，皆謂之財来就我。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141902351","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若卦中雖有財動，不来生合世爻，□非我之財也。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141918735","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：山説财不生合世爻，非我之財。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141935119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽如前二","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141951503","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561753580765227"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦，兄爻持世，何嘗財来生合？","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141951503","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"總要㫁卦之人靈機應變，叅悟其理，自然觸類旁通，不可執之。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141967887","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福變財生，利源滚滚。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683141984271","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財淂子動生之，如财之有源也，其利豊厚。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683142000655","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘得子動化財，則動化子，皆同此推。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683142017039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄傷鬼尅，口舌纷纷。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683142033423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財爻持世，兄爻□動者，不獨刦財，還防傷已，","logicSentenceId":"7586677683142049807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"口女。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若鬼動尅世者，更凶。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683142049807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：黄金策云：兄連鬼尅，口舌難逃。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683142066191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂兄動變","logicSentenceId":"7586677683142082575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561753580781611"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼，冲尅世爻者，不獨無财，還防口舌。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683142082575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殊不知兄動變鬼，卽是兄化回頭之尅，自顧不暇，又焉能冲尅世爻。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683142098959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應㐅世，如酉月丙午日占貿，酉","logicSentenceId":"7586677683142115343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"亥水兄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑午火辰寅，易有利否，淂師之坎父","logicSentenceId":"7586677683142115343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戍圡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼","logicSentenceId":"7586677683142115343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財鬼子午火財爻持世，亥水兄動刼之，幸淂交水化戊圡。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683142115343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄爻被尅，不来刼財，許之可行，必有利息，果淂利益。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683142131727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"浚扵九月，此人胞弟淂暴病而死。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683142148111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予悟此卦□水兄弟變鬼之故耳。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683142164495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦问財带出丧弟，如此者，","logicSentenceId":"7586677683142180879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561753580797995"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余屢見之。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683142180879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"浚學不可不留心也。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683142197263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財局合，福徳萬倍利源。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683142213647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可許。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478909501440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世與子爻，或與子孫爻，三合成局，諸占物阜財豊。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683142230031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：湏要在局中，或是合成子孫，財局生世，方為全羙。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683142246415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘如合成父局，劳碌辛苦。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683142262799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合成兄局，破耗多端；合成鬼局，口舌災非。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478909517824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅世者更凶。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683142279183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗君逢刼殺，一年生意無聊。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683142295567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刦煞者，乃兄弟之爻也。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683142311951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄臨太嵗，一年破耗。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683142328335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"謁貴求財章弟六十九","logicSentenceId":"7586677683142344719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561753580814379"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世尅官，官生世，湏冝謁見。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683142361103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財臨破，鬼尅世，枉費奔馳。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478909534208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：見貴有两问也。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683142377487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"為名者用官，為利者用財，皆冝持世，及生合世爻為吉。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683142393871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如逢空破墓绝，及動而變凶者，徒勞奔馳之力耳。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683142410255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘若世爻化鬼化尅，及随墓肋傷者，更不冝行。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683142426639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若非到彼之凶，㝎在中途遇禍。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683142443023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴謁貴者同斷。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683142459407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世動遇空，身興遇破，世動化空破者，勿曰不吉，乃應到彼之月日也。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683142475791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如申月丁卯日應世，","logicSentenceId":"7586677683142492175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561753580830763"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占出行見貴，淂戌申午亥出卯，同人子財，兄官子父，㫁曰：官星持世，而空出空度，曰：淂見官府，則利如心。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683142492175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵出空之日見官，財利得意。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683142508559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月建財爻生世之故耳。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683142524943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官持世，財動相生，財持世，官無缺陌，再淂日月照臨，彼此縁投。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683142541327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有幸日月照臨者，乃曰月生世生財，或世與財爻而臨日月是也。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683142557711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561753580847147"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"為名冝父動，目利忌兄興。","logicSentenceId":"7586677683142574095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占謁貴，旣淂世與官星相合相生，必然淂見。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935952625704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若為名利，湏冝另占，不可就以此卦断之。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935952642088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"為名者，冝父官兩旺，為利者，冝財福両旺。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935952658472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如申月甲辰日，世應占謁貴求題薦。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935952674856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳未酉辰寅子淂噬嗑子財官財兄，父，㫁曰：差求题薦，全仗文書。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478909550592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中財爻持世，父母受尅，離許如心。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935952691240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：差果浔財，□，不負此一行。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935952707624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：","logicSentenceId":"7586677935952724008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561753580863531"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"非此論也。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935952724008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爾之来意，原為求名，此财爻持世者，乃是破文書之忌神，非許角以得財也。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935952740392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：嘗見人㫁卦，竟以此財爻斷之有財。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935952756776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殊不知財爻持世，破文書，求薦舉而不淂也。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935952773160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"誤仆雖不成名，必淂其利，相去逺矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935952789544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六合六冲湏看用，反吟化退枉奔馳。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935952805928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"交逢六合，六要用神旺相，或世與財爻相合，乃為吉非。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935952822312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦逢六冲，必須用神受尅失𨹞，始作凶徴。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935952838696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦淂反吟，及世動化退，多見離扵行動，勉强而去，","logicSentenceId":"7586677935952855080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561753580879915"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空反而歸。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935952855080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人謁貴，冝世應以相生。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935952871464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平人見貴，冝官鬼而相合。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478909566976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人謁貴人，冝扵世應相合相生。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935952887848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平人見貴人，冝官貴相合相生，及官星持世。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478909583360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：有心而问見貴求名者，官星持世，生世，必淂官。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935952904232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有心问謁貴人者，官星生世，合世而淂見㔹，勿以此淂見貴人之官星，誤作成名而所也。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478909599744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人謁貴，世應若相冲尅，財伏而空，去之何益？","logicSentenceId":"7586677935952920616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官鬼尅世，世變鬼變尅更凶。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935952937000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561753580896299"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平人見貴官尅世，世變鬼變尅，勿去，去則湏防不測。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935952953384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官生世，持世為吉。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935952969768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡云行求財謁貴出行章叅看。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935952986152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"為貴人奔走劾力求財章第七十","logicSentenceId":"7633451478909616128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"最重財官两旺，不冝世應皆空。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953002536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世遇財。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953018920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應臨福，我盖他損。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953035304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應臨官，世逢破，他損我益。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478909632512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄爻持世，不如闲𠁅安身。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953051688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應尅世爻，防慮他人反目。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478909648896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世遇財星，官星臨應，無不遂也。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953068072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世逢空破、墓绝，及動而夑凶者，皆非吉也。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953084456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應尅世，兄尅世，見災還淺。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953100840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561753580912683"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼尅世，世化鬼，淂禍不輕。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953117224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"𫔭行𫔭店及各色鋪面章第七十一","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953133608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世為己，應為人，大冝相合。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478909665280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財為𠥽，福為基，最喜同興。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953149992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古法應為夥計，又為下顧之客。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953166376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黄金策曰：開行㝎主有人投","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953182760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953182760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子曰：湏在来人之念，有心而问夥計。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478909681664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應為夥計，若淂世應相生相合，彼此同心。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953215528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應生世，他益扵我。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953231912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世生應，我盖扵他。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478909698048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相尅相冲，両情有變。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953248296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應爻尅世，我彼他瞞。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953264680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世尅應爻，他従我願。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478909714432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應臨元武，兄爻，暗","logicSentenceId":"7633451478909730816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561753580929067"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中盗騙。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478909730816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應臨官，鬼尅世，明降災非。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478909747200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世財應兄，受他之累。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953281064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世財應子，淂他之力。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478909763584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應空合，彼此有虚詐之心也。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953297448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未人之念，重在賣買者，湏以應爻為下儀之客。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953313832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應爻生世，合世生客，未交成故舊。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953330216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應相冲相尅，熟人终久變成仇。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953346600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼作災非湏忌，動，則為活計畏刑冲。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953362984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼動招非，尅世最忌法去鬼現爻中。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953379368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是非曰：有鬼揺尅世，災禍連绵。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953395752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"湏看鬼值何神。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953412136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅世，湏扵家宅","logicSentenceId":"7633451748367007778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561753580945451"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"章内詳之。","logicSentenceId":"7633451748367007778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財為資本，忌衰墓空破，及動而變凶，或日月刑中尅害，更忌世與財空，俱開不成。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953428520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼兄發動，有制何妨。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953444904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"随墓助傷，多凶小吉。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953461288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼動招非，若淂子孫制鬼，或日月冲尅鬼爻，謂之有制。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953477672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：凡遇兄鬼同動者，不可。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953494056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰鬼動招非，以鬼動能制兄，文不刼財也。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953510440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟又為阻隔破耗之小人，淂此鬼動，可以制服，獨不冝世随鬼墓，或世動","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953526824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561753580961835"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而變凶，皆凶兆也。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953526824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占貿易，雖冝財動，若遇鬼爻尅世，又不相冝，乃為助鬼以傷身也。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953543208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦得及吟，多及復，卦得反吟，欲行不行，行而又止，或𫔭而又剪，剪而又開。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953559592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘店𫔭久矣，遇此一㝎更遷。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953575976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冲中變合再重興。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953592360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻逢六合及六冲，卦變六合盛世與財爻子孫共成三合，㝎是剪浚重興，惟六合變冲則不冝也。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953608744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953625128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561753580978219"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前熱闹，終父消條，合夥不嫌。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953625128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟乏本，内外無財。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953641512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應臨兄，不吉，兄爻發動，不吉。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953657896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘若世臨兄爻，日月作財星，冲尅世者，反為𠮷也。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953674280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内外無財，伏而又空，必然乏本，屢試果騐。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953690664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"投行損益章第七十二","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953707048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官若興隆，行主可千金之托。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953723432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應如空破，牙人無毫忽之能。","logicSentenceId":"7633451748367024162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官旺應旺，生合世爻者，其人可托。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953739816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如若静衰空破，","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953756200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561753580994603"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽是奸險小人。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953756200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘若交財，㝎遭欺騸。","logicSentenceId":"7633451748367040546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世破應，傷，𮞸他陥害。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953772584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財逢兄尅，慮彼相瞞。","logicSentenceId":"7633451748367056930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應尅世爻，帳目難清。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953788968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄尅财爻，己入套矣。","logicSentenceId":"7633451748367073314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄動貨難脫卸。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953805352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子興，物易交卧。","logicSentenceId":"7633451748367089698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄動阻隔，貨難罄脱。","logicSentenceId":"7633451748367106082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子興財旺，利息豊亨。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953821736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄雀並搖，難逃口舌。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953838120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"武鬼同發，湏慮穿窬。","logicSentenceId":"7633451748367122466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雀臨","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953854504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兄鬼，動而尅世者，口。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舌官災，元武臨兄，鬼動尅世者，湏防𥨸益。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953854504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"囤貨賣買章弟七十三","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953870888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561753581010987"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財爻衰者，湏停榻，妻位，當時可脫之。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953887272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"積貨賣貨皆不冝。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953903656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財逢空跛，及動而變尅，財衰宜囤，財旺以脱。","logicSentenceId":"7633451748367138850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如春天占淂財爻屬木，謂之旺，冝速發賣。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953920040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若臨金、水、𡈽者，冝惟積也。","logicSentenceId":"7633451748367155234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨火為相，法不冝堆。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953936424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此論四時之衰旺也。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953952808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：衰惟可買，須要查其根蒂。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953969192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖衰六冝有根，将来再發。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935953985576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若無根蒂，終久難扵出脱，不可不知。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935954001960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如寅月己亥曰，世應","logicSentenceId":"7586677935954018344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561753581027371"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，占𭠎貨，得頤卦，寅子戍辰。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935954018344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅子兄父，財財兄父，古以財爻衰者當収。","logicSentenceId":"7633451748367171618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦辰戊之財衰而不遇生扶，謂之無根，将来终不淂價，不可収買，不聴浚来堆積，四季杇懷太半，大虧其本。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935954034728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貨有㝎時，湏憑時令。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935954051112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"物無㝎者，指朴而占，㝎時者，有責賤之時也。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935954067496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"比之麻葛，淂價扵夏令花。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935954083880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"绵淂價扵冬天，又如木料细假無㝎時也，則化進神，其價正長。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935954100264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561753581043755"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財化進神，不可𭠎積，化退者，其價将落。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935954116648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有貨速冝出脫。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935954133032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄爻持世，破敗之端。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935954149416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：美甚命，问甚卜，虧人是禍，饒人是福。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935954165800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財将義取者，神告顯然。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935954182184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"财之不義者，神不告矣。","logicSentenceId":"7633451748367188002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"昔有一人，虧損夥計，獨得其利，人人知而吐罵，因占貨當賣否，卦淂兄爻持世，又占不賣，何如，又是兄爻持世，占過又占不□兄動。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935954198568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予六知其此人虧損夥計而淂貨，抑且素行不端。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935954214952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予悟兄動者，破財之兆也。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935954231336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561753581060139"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有利無利，神不告之。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935954247720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961014312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此人不賣者，其價一日賤似一日，不淂不賣。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961014312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及至急急賣，果其價大長，折本漂流，難回故里。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961047080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所以喪心之人，何湏占卜。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961063464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財值旺襄墓絶，自有淂令之秋；妻逢破伏空，豈無乗除之日。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961079848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財太旺者，淂利扵墓庫之月；休囚者，出脱扵生旺之時。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961096232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入墓必待冲𫔭，遇绝當逢生旺。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961112616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月破者，填實之候，被尅者，冲去尅神之秋。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961129000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伏蔵者，得價扵出現之時；旬空者，中空實空之月。","logicSentenceId":"7633451748367204386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財逢合住，点待冲𫔭。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961145384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561753581076523"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如子月己丑日，占應乂世，何時淂價，得歸妹戌","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961161768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"申金午兄丑卯木巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之兌父","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961161768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"酉金。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼、","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961161768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父財鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961161768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：卯木財爻，子日生之，財有根蒂，目下不淂價者，被申金動而尅制，待寅月冲去申金，其價必長，果扵正月勃然大長。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961178152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此乃財爻被尅，冲去尅神之月也。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961194536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㐅應世。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961210920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如：巳月戊申日，占買","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961227304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"酉金亥子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑辰寅子水台連帋，有利否？","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961227304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淂復","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961243688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961243688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"。頤木財兄兄鬼財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561753581092907"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：子水財爻持世，日𫝕生之，酉金動而生之，但嫌金水逢扵夏令，元神用神俱值休囚，秋冬必長，冝於多叔。","logicSentenceId":"7633451748367220770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵堆時，每塊九錢，浚賣至三両六七。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961260072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此乃財值休囚，云脱扵生旺之時也。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961276456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如：卯月乙未日，占㐅世賣貨，淂家人之小畜。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961292840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯巳未亥","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961309224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"埀財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯兄子財父","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961309224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寅本旡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961309224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：丑𡈽財爻持世，卯月尅之，未日冲散，叉化寅木回頭之尅，不獨財爻被尅，世爻六被冲傷，六月","logicSentenceId":"7633451748367237154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561753581109291"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世臨月破，不獨破財，且防不測。","logicSentenceId":"7633451748367237154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵六月回祿，貨成灰燼，身被火傷，過七日而死。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961325608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：歸妹與小畜両卦，俱是財爻受尅，前卯木之財，有子日之生，謂之有根，所以逢寅月冲去尅神而淂財。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961341992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"浚卦丑𡈽財交，并無生扶，謂之無根，所以財命两傷，豈可点許冲去尅神之月而旺耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961358376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須宜通變。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961374760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財逢合而當遇合者，有應動而逢合之月而淂價也。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961391144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦有财爻衰","logicSentenceId":"7633451748367253538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561753581125675"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"静，占時得遇日月生合者，其價目下以及時也。","logicSentenceId":"7633451748367253538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如寅月己酉日，占應世脱貨，扵何時淂責寅子戍亥丑卯卦，官財、兄財兄鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961407528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
