{"lines":[{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561753581158443"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應則外而世財内，須查動静。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961587752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應爻以外，财爻持世者冝内，必須應爻動而生合世爻。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961604136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不然，應財雖旺，與己何于？","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961620520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六冲湏冝别圖，六合還宜㘴守。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961636904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦淂六冲，雖冝改圖，余屢試之。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961653288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財旺者何湏更改，財哀者，攺点無盖。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961669672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：凢得此象，湏令本人再占，占问更攺何如。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961686056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦淂財𠀍两旺，許之攺圖。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961702440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再逢衰者，還須耐守。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961718824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦淂六合，点看財爻衰旺。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961735208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財持世而動者，不可㘴","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961751592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561753581174827"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"守，哀而静者，守待旺時可也。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961751592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財衰變旺，先曲浚伸，財旺變衰，先金浚土，謂財爻動而變也。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961767976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財衰變旺，目下雖賤，将來必長。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961784360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財旺而變衰絶者，如若賣貨，冝扵急賣。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961800744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘若収貨，㔹不可収。","logicSentenceId":"7633451748367302690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"買貨與賣貨相反。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961817128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財爻旺而可賣，衰者冝買。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961833512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内卦，財衰，冝扵外賣。","logicSentenceId":"7633451748367319074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻財旺，近地相冝。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961849896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財化進神，宜徃外方發貨。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961866280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻化退，宜回舊地出脫。","logicSentenceId":"7633451748367335458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"徃何方賣買章第七十五","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961882664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561753581191211"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古法有之，屢試不騐，須指其方而卜之。","logicSentenceId":"7633451748367351842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如午月戊子日，應世占徃椘買荳，淂酉亥丑丑卯巳。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961899048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨卦，子财兄，兄鬼父，㫁曰：亥水財爻，休囚扵外，椘荳必贱。","logicSentenceId":"7633451748367368226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子水日建而生世，必淂厚利，湏冝行之。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961915432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但嫌间爻兄弟，月生日合，耗費者多，","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961931816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690896508108811/1-08db3def7201094f.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=yDei1F0yS4jq7s%2BskTEVax%2BHqdQ%3D","uri":"read/HY0745/2/ref/1kol66q3mvf2r/1-08db3def7201094f.webp","fontType":1,"components":"氵","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690896508108811"},"logicSentenceId":"7586677935961931816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果牙行仆𡚁，鳴之扵官，遲誤一月，花費些湏，幸到地頭，其價大長，果淂厚利。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961931816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此乃指其地而占者，無不騐也。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961948200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古以金財而象珠寳玉石，水財以類，魚䀋，火𧴫，陶冶菓品，木財、𡈽為五穀，青龍木利，又𠔥喜慶之用。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961980968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白乕金財，訾儀屠宰之物。","logicSentenceId":"7633451748367384610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元武水利，朱雀火冝，滕陀利扵出入，勾陳利農工。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935961997352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：此乃揣摩五行之論，非經騐也。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935962013736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"屢試不騐，间有騐者，乃奏合耳，不可為法，必湏意屬何類，指其事而占之，無有不騐。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935962030120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朱龍、元、白、蛇、勾。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935962046504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如未月戊申日，應世","logicSentenceId":"7586677935962062888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561753581223979"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徃粤東探親，可帶己未酉、申午辰何貨歸米淂？","logicSentenceId":"7586677935962062888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"利淂旅卦，兄子財，財兄子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷曰：爻逢六合，世應相生，此行遂意。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935962079272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如问置買何貨，予無此法，不敢相誤。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935962095656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但喜旣淂吉卦，任匍冬天賣扇，夏月賣毡，六有厚利。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935962112040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"浚此人買檀杳翠毛而歸，俱淂大利。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935962128424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若執古法而斷者，此卦酉金為財，可買珠寳玉石耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586677935962144808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財臨元武，可買水利魚监耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586677935962161192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財若空破休指","logicSentenceId":"7586677935962210344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561753581240363"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"望，財興子發可干求。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935962210344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應內爻皆不冝，月破旬空，兄弟一爻，不可臨身及動世。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935962226728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"〇應。","logicSentenceId":"7633451748367400994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○如未月丁卯日，占未","logicSentenceId":"7586677935962243112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"酉〇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥丑","logicSentenceId":"7586677935962243112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兄，卯巳財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"借貨，淂免之。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935962243112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"震父","logicSentenceId":"7633451748367417378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"申兄，子父寅財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼哉。","logicSentenceId":"7633451748367417378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：兌卦屬金，變震卦屬木，金尅木為財。","logicSentenceId":"7633451748367433762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯木財爻化退神，酉金兄動，六化退神，幸淂財臨日𫝕，旺而不退。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935962259496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明曰：辰日合住酉爻必得，果扵辰日得之。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935962275880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此乃酉金元爻，得辰日合住，不能尅阻其財。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935962292264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄臨世，放則無歸，第爻應，索則不獲。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935962325032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應鬼尅身防負義，應财生世㝎懷忠。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935962341416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古以世應同人，放債必然連本绝，謂不獨世臨兄弟忌之。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935962357800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應臨兄者，飲忘。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935962374184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官鬼尅身，美意終成慈意。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935962390568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山野禽獣，湏尋福徳。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935962423336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"家畜牛犬，六看子孫，不拘家禽野獣，皆以子孫為用神，兼看财爻。","logicSentenceId":"7633451748367450146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財爻持世，子動生之，或日月生助，或財動化子孫，乃𠮷","logicSentenceId":"7586677935962439720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561753581273131"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"象也。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935962439720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不拘買賣畜養，多多益善，大有利息。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935962456104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫持世，財爻合世，六有利益。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935962472488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獨防鬼變子孫，子孫變鬼，父化子，子化父，父兄持世，財臨空破，不可行之。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935962488872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如丑月丁卯日，占應，世乂買馬，徃南發賣，淂巳未酉酉亥","logicSentenceId":"7586677935962505256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"母土子孫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼎之大有。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935962505256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄子。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935962521640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財則鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7633451748367466530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子水官冠。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷曰：内卦子孫雖臨月建，不冝動而變鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935962538024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外卦未𡈽子孫，又臨月破，不冝買之。","logicSentenceId":"7586677935962554408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"幸而间爻酉財暗動","logicSentenceId":"7586677935962570792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561753581289515"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生世，馬雖多，","logicSentenceId":"7586677935962570792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" {"lines":[{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561753581322283"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"請會湏冝財旰，更冝世應相生，卦遇六冲，財雖旺而不久，六冲變合，世應相尅，𡖋成。","logicSentenceId":"7633451748367548450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六合變冲，有始無終，則逢绝破，速冝止之，揺會淂否。","logicSentenceId":"7586677936036675584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺财持世，必淂。","logicSentenceId":"7586677936036691968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如占何時可淂，則破。","logicSentenceId":"7586677936036708352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財空填實之月，財若伏蔵出現之月，財太旺者，逢墓之月，財哀绝者，逢生旺之月。","logicSentenceId":"7586677936036724736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘得財化回頭之尅，及衰静而逢空破，又遇六冲者，會塲必散，終無淂會之日矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586677936036741120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561622983442466"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"恶心之事也。","logicSentenceId":"7586695833350766611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行此恶心之事，亦敢告之扵神耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586695833350782995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣告之於神，而神若以𠮷凶而報者，乃神之教人，而仆丧心之事也。","logicSentenceId":"7586695833350799379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可謂之大道之易卦邪？","logicSentenceId":"7586695833350815763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可謂之伏羲大聖之神耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586695833350832147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然不獨山，凢有非義非禮之事，不忠不孝之謀，一念之惡，惡神随之。","logicSentenceId":"7586695833350848531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"郎不告之扵神，亦𮞸天譴。","logicSentenceId":"7586695833350864915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"書曰：惠迪吉，従逆凶，何湏问卜。","logicSentenceId":"7586695833350881299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：男家占女，不拘父母親朋，而代占者無不以財為用。","logicSentenceId":"7631229984325910574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女家占男，皆以官為用神。","logicSentenceId":"7586695833350930451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用官者，官有生扶；用財者，財爻旺相，卽許成婚。","logicSentenceId":"7586695833350946835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今見古今諸書，又以財旺傷尅父母。","logicSentenceId":"7586695833350963219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予不知冝財之旺而為𠮷也，","logicSentenceId":"7586695833350979603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561622983475234"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冝財不旺而為吉也。","logicSentenceId":"7586695833350979603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：黄金策云：翁姑不睦，皆因妻位交重。","logicSentenceId":"7586695833350995987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"海底眼曰：財動喪䨇親。","logicSentenceId":"7586695833351012371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易冒亦曰：妻財動，父母㕘商。","logicSentenceId":"7586695833351028755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"俱以財動傷尅父母，未說荘也。","logicSentenceId":"7586695833351045139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：動則能傷父母，旺則不能傷耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586695833351061523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假令春天占卧，財爻屬木，謂之女命，旺而可取，但父母爻㝎然屬土，如此當權淂令之財爻，不尅休囚之父母耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586695833351077907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何必曰動？","logicSentenceId":"7586695833351094291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殊不知昔人言動而不言旺者，正恐後人驳論，所以諱言其旰，不淂巳而言動也。","logicSentenceId":"7586695833351110675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豈知亦被看破。","logicSentenceId":"7586695833351127059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：據甫之論，何以為法？","logicSentenceId":"7586695833351143443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：分占之法也，","logicSentenceId":"7586695833351159827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561741131186216"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先要财官旺相，旣淂吉卦，再占防尅父母。","logicSentenceId":"7586695833351159827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是其","logicSentenceId":"7586695833351176211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"法也。","logicSentenceId":"7586695833351176211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黄金策專以應為妻位，易冒亦以應為妻，欲其旺相，乃為賢良發福之女。","logicSentenceId":"7631229984325926958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又以應為女家父母，謂之應爻旺相，必是富貴之家；應若休囚，必主貧寒之宅。","logicSentenceId":"7586695833351192595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"執此論之，旺相賢良之女，皆出扵富貴之家。","logicSentenceId":"7586695833351208979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"種","logicSentenceId":"7586695833351225363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"種悖謬，予不知千百年来，竟無一人道破。","logicSentenceId":"7586695833351225363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男卜女姻財要旺，女占男配鬼冝興。","logicSentenceId":"7586695833351241747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男家代占女，專以則為用神，以應爻乌女家，財冝旺相，動而化吉，應爻不冝空、破及尅世爻。","logicSentenceId":"7586695833351258131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561741131202600"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女家代占男，專以官為用神，以應爻為男家，冝官星旺相，動而化吉，應爻不冝空、破、墓绝，不冝尅世。","logicSentenceId":"7586695833351274515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男人自占妻者，亦以財爻為用，兼以應爻為女身，財與應爻皆冝生世，持世、合世，湏忌破、墓、绝。","logicSentenceId":"7586695833351290899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空則旺生身，應取破空。","logicSentenceId":"7631229984325943342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"取應爻生世，則爻破绝勿求。","logicSentenceId":"7631229984325959726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：財爻應爻同来生合世者更吉。","logicSentenceId":"7586695833351307283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵以財爻為重，應爻為附和耳。","logicSentenceId":"7586695833351323667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黄金策曰：應為百世之妻，重應而不重財，謬也。","logicSentenceId":"7586695833351340051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽如子年未月巳未日。","logicSentenceId":"7586695833351356435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世臨母官，雖臨月破日破，幸得動化財爻，回頭之生，目下雖破，終有不破之時。","logicSentenceId":"7586695833351389203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明歳母年定逢住偶，果扵次年四月得配良姻。","logicSentenceId":"7586695833351405587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應丑年者，世爻實破之年也。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112138547243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此非財爻生世，應爻尅世耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586697112138563627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子月癸酉日，自占婚，淂桓變鼎。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112138580011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"断曰：酉官持世，戊土財爻動而生世，又淂世應相","logicSentenceId":"7631229984325976110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/3/ref/1le3cy4t9njn7/1-7539561741131218984_86498_259883.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=vvCI2wjlSYe2Nb%2Brcwu6jth0CVc%3D","pictureHeight":385,"pictureWidth":173,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/3/ref/1le3cy4t9njn7/1-7539561741131218984_86498_259883.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=r2YTg3%2Bo7XaDDQz5Qgfg%2F3kD4hc%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/3/ref/1le3cy4t9njn7/1-7539561741131218984_86498_259883.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561741131235368"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生，戊土雖值旬空，動不為空，明日出空之日，求之必允。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112138596395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵次日巳時允婚，夫婦白頭相守，児女","logicSentenceId":"7586697112138612779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成行。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112138612779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如寅月丙午日，女家代占婚，淂臨之旣濟。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112138629163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/3/ref/1le3cy4t9nwab/1-7539561741131235368_240498_406880.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=9bgHJYkprdqjl2DSrUKDyksCZLg%3D","pictureHeight":382,"pictureWidth":166,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/3/ref/1le3cy4t9nwab/1-7539561741131235368_240498_406880.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=2HuHUQiKvhdR%2BrRYfvT3nupmvG8%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/3/ref/1le3cy4t9nwab/1-7539561741131235368_240498_406880.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：女家占男，以官為用，以應爻為男家，此占法也，亦𢀸法也。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112138645547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁卦之時，湏要人之活變，未必全淂顯而易見者。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112138661931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽如此卦，女家占男，卯木旺官持世，其婚必成，而應爻受尅，又為男家不允，似此何","logicSentenceId":"7586697112138678315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561741131251752"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以决之？","logicSentenceId":"7586697112138678315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要知財官為重，世應為輕，雖是女家占以，亦要財爻不致扵失陷。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112138694699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此一卦也，缺乎男女兩人，財被回頭尅，又逢丑土之尅，如何能生卯木之官？","logicSentenceId":"7586697112138711083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男女不能相合相生，婚姻雖成，終有他變。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112138727467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後果聘㝎扵四月，未及成婚，被賊兵刼去。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112138743851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應巳月者，亥水逢月破也。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112138760235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財值休囚罷散，終非舉案之姻；官逢衰墓绝空，難遂齊睂之願。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112138776619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財爻官爻不冝，墓绝空破又不冝。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112138793003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動而化破化散、","logicSentenceId":"7631229984325992494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561741131268136"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化魁化鬼，乃夭折貧寒之命。","logicSentenceId":"7631229984325992494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男占忌財爻犯之，女占忌官爻犯之。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112138809387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男女自占，世爻忌犯，勉强成婚，叅啇即見。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112138825771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世静空亡，動化退，终湏失望。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112138842155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動而空者，實空之月日必成。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112138858539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靜而空者，終不成也。","logicSentenceId":"7631229984326008878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世動化進神，事在在成；若化退神，終湏難就。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112138874923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應爻静而空破，及化退神，亦同此推。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112138891307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應静旬空，财化進，夙有良綠；應空，他人不實，若動化退神，必有退悔之心。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112138907691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若淂","logicSentenceId":"7586697112138924075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561741131284520"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財爻動化進神而生世者，雖見退悔，终是良姻。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112138924075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若世應動而破者，亦應實破之時。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112138940459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應皆空徒費力，反吟多變事難成。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112138956843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應俱空，事無准實。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112138973227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"反吟卦變，反覆難成。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112138989611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：湏淂空而逢旺，財鬼相生，先湏不允，變後還成。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139005995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如巳月戊子日，占婚允否。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139022379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"恒變井。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139038763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/3/ref/1le3cy4t9o8xf/1-7539561741131284520_83497_255872.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=QrWl9vWU66bWLO5G%2B%2BUwSQ6JeqQ%3D","pictureHeight":375,"pictureWidth":172,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/3/ref/1le3cy4t9o8xf/1-7539561741131284520_83497_255872.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=uaZ3k11Craj0LtRjFDf6l5FyYXw%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/3/ref/1le3cy4t9o8xf/1-7539561741131284520_83497_255872.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：内卦反呤，反復多變，允而復悔之象。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139055147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：果","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139071531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561741131300904"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然，不知将来成否？","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139071531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：應爻臨財，動而生世，八九月必成，果扵酉月成之。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139087915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃應世爻值月，又冲去卯木之月也。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139104299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男占𠔃兄動，卦中非配偶；兄爻持世，或兄弟發動，乃傷妻阻隔之神，婚必難成。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139120683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"已成之婚，遇此者，刑傷不免。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139137067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：余得之騐。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139153451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄持世，財爻合世，必成。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139169835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世臨兄爻，化出財爻，亦成。","logicSentenceId":"7631229984326025262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女卜𠔃，官爻持世是良缘。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139186219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561741131317288"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女占男，不冝子孫持世，子孫發動，子孫乃尅夫之神，未成者不成，已成者丧夫再嫁。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139202603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟官星持世、合世、生世旺相者，不獨姻缘必就，還期舉案齊睂。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139218987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中官星重舋者，法主再嫁。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139235371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官世應冲刑，夫妻及目。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139251755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如已月乙亥日，占夫婦不和，将来和好否？","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139268139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得需之大過。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139284523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/3/ref/1le3cy4t9olkj/1-7539561741131317288_90493_257880.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=bypmP1HO4K%2FYnMXcO0TG%2BSH5BA8%3D","pictureHeight":387,"pictureWidth":167,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/3/ref/1le3cy4t9olkj/1-7539561741131317288_90493_257880.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=DOO1M5Owa5NtKqgktBLF2ZEArlo%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/3/ref/1le3cy4t9olkj/1-7539561741131317288_90493_257880.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：女占夫，不冝子孫持世，乃尅夫之象。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139300907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛寅木","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139317291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561741131333672"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子水相生，不能傷之，𠩄以不和。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139317291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今兼應爻為夫，應逢子母作合，尊夫已有外遇，水木相生，兩人情宻。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139333675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：果然，後来何如？","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139350059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：爾兩人不是姻緣，雖則不能𢀸别，必有生離。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139366443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵次年寅月，休其此人，六月再取彼婦。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139382827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應寅月者，夫臨寅木而冲世也。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139399211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應六月者，未土冲𫔭初爻丑土，子水来生其寅木也。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139415595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺相爻逢六合，彼此同心。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139431979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻逢六合，占婚最冝。","logicSentenceId":"7631229984326041646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更要財官旺相為吉。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139448363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男忌則逢破墓，女防官位尅绝。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139464747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六中變六合者更吉。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139481131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"求婚","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139497515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561741131350056"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，目下不允，終必成之。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139497515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"已成不睦者，終必和美。","logicSentenceId":"7631229984326058030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟忌六冲卦，若無財官兩旺，㔹不可成，勉強成之，若非𢀸别，㝎是生離。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139513899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六合變冲，先雖許允，后必更張，已成者，終湏折枕。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139530283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽如戌月庚申日，占己娶活人之妻，夫囘成訟，㫁離否？","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139546667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淂困之兌。","logicSentenceId":"7631229984326074414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/3/ref/1le3cy4t9oy7n/1-7539561741131350056_135493_304872.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=g1Vh9ep19S8XuynTWZYT6UEw3ys%3D","pictureHeight":379,"pictureWidth":169,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/3/ref/1le3cy4t9oy7n/1-7539561741131350056_135493_304872.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=Sxf7l5WLCswvzLXfx5XNZB79lNo%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/3/ref/1le3cy4t9oy7n/1-7539561741131350056_135493_304872.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：財爻持世，乃是美姻緣也。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139563051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凋零之木被日辰冲散，又是六合變冲，不獨斷離，還防有罪。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139579435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：業","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139595819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561741131366440"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"已状告姦謀，不知何如？","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139595819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：世爻變爻，與日辰共仆三刑，爾両人皆不免扵刑杖。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139612203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後果審出姦娶，男女俱被杖刑，卽㫁離異。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139628587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古用咸臨節泰，忌逢暌革解離。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139644971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：易冒有云：卦淂咸臨郎泰，若不遇合冲變冲，雖財官衰陷，随墓助傷，皆不為凶。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139661355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"暌、革解離，則為凶兆，雖用神全備，而化合亦不為吉。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139677739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此言用神未勝扵卦騐也。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139694123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曽扵巳月丁卯。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139710507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561741131382824"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日占婚，扵何時淂","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139726891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"泰卦。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139726891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予見此卦，兄爻持世，亥財臨月破、旬空，子水之財，世爻尅之，日辰刑之，古雖以泰卦為吉，予焉救取人之婚，相人事而試卦耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139743275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命之再占，又淂坤卦。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139759659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/3/ref/1le3cy4t9q04z/1-7539561741131382824_137501_313874.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=3vcwlU4KbPtpI8rCTy45gBvu8oQ%3D","pictureHeight":373,"pictureWidth":176,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/3/ref/1le3cy4t9q04z/1-7539561741131382824_137501_313874.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=BZZk6nksgJxhNuU63uQhliaexAk%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/3/ref/1le3cy4t9q04z/1-7539561741131382824_137501_313874.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻休囚為日破，亥水財爻臨月破，卦遇六冲，大凶之兆。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139776043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故知前淂泰卦，非為吉也，仍用財官世應","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139792427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561741131399208"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者為是。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139792427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然亦不可竟以為是。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139808811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡有𠩄疑，勿執古法而㫁，湏以再占之卦而决之。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139825195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後卦若吉，即以吉㫁。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139841579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後卦云者，則以凶推。","logicSentenceId":"7631229984326090798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神不欺人，彼此両無誤矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139857963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財化財，未必婚姻兩度；鬼化鬼，難曰相守百年。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139874347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黄金策曰：財爻重疂，重仆新人。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139890731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予屢試之。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139907115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男家占女，財爻重疂旺相生合世爻者，多至賢妻美妾。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139923499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則化財者，或應㕠娶，或應婢妾同来，或應妻妾之多，或應桩奩甚厚。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139939883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟忌爻中兄動，及日月冲尅財爻，花燭重重，所不免耳。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139956267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561741131415592"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女占男家，得遇財化財，財爻重舋生世者，必主百輛盈門，千金為聘，不冝鬼動化鬼，必主夫亡。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139972651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及鬼爻重骨尅世，若非争婚奪娶，㝎然反復災非。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112139989035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男占遇之，亦主更變，尅世者，亦可止也。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112140005419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻化鬼者，更冝止之。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112140021803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄臨元武防卦骗，鬼臨白虎遇凶丧。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112140038187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"况鬼動臨元武，防局中奸詐骗財。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112140054571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"従使世應相生，財官無害，必湏大費。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112140070955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼臨虎動，或未過门，或過门不見，必見喪事。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112140087339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561741131431976"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應財世鬼，夫唱婦随；應鬼世財，夫權妻奪。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112140103723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世持鬼、應持財，謂之隂陽浔位，必然鸞鳳齊鳴。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112140120107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼臨應財持世，牝鷄鳴晨，妻奪夫權，惟贅婿淂之","logicSentenceId":"7586697112140136491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"反吉。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112140136491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"此婚子嗣有無章第八十三","logicSentenceId":"7586697112140152875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫旺相，或休囚而動，及動而化吉，皆主有子。","logicSentenceId":"7631229984326107182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子化進神，化回頭生，有子必多。","logicSentenceId":"7586697112140169259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如逢子孫墓絶，動而變鬼，鬼變子孫，父化子，子化父，父動尅子，皆因我命無児，不成此婚，亦無子也。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519761981446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟多積隂徳以培之。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519761997830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如申月丁丑日。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762014214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561741131448360"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因有妾多，占何命者有子。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762030598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淂革之夬。","logicSentenceId":"7631229984326123566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：卯木子孫绝扵申月，鬼變子孫，又逢月破，公命無子，與女命何干？","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762046982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽出八字觀之，甲寅、甲戌、甲子、戊辰。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762063366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：八字雖奇，纯陽包隂，兵權顯赫，但嫌平頭煞重，疂疂魁罡，亦主無子。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762079750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"公曰：有何法耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762096134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：多積隂徳以培之。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762112518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"公曰：不孝有三，無後為大。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762128902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嗣后施濟貧寒，全人夫婦，修橋砌路，施藥施棺，速生二子。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762145286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨终囑其子曰：我非隂功，不能有爾。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762161670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爾若成","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762178054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561741131464744"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人，多冝積徳。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762178054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"此婚有冝扵父母否章第八十四","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762194438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"專以父毋為用神，父母爻或旺或衰，皆不忌也。","logicSentenceId":"7631229984326139950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𠩄忌者財爻發動，必此婚之有妨也。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762210822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如財化父毋，父母化財，鬼化父母，父毋動化墓、絶、空、破，及回頭尅動而玻散，或日月尅父母，乃桑榆日暮之秋，不成此婚。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762227206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦難免耳","logicSentenceId":"7631229984326172718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"納寵章第八十五","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762243590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"為子嗣者，子孫為用神，與前段占子嗣同断。","logicSentenceId":"7631229984326156334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"否則專看財爻，亦與占婚同㫁。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762259974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561741131481128"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占配僕，財爻為用。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762276358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財爻持世，㦯動而生合，世爻動而化進、化生財、化財，皆得忠誠効力。","logicSentenceId":"7631229984326189102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"散、破、空、绝，非懶惰，卽疾病。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762292742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財爻尅世、冲世，負義忘息之徒也。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762309126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財化鬼、化绝、化墓、化尅，及鬼化財爻，貧窮夀夭。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762325510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"取離婦跳娼婦章第八十六","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762341894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"防患者，用子孫，子孫持世，子孫發動，皆無憂也。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762358278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財爻持世，子動相生而更吉","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762374662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762374662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼兄尅世，随鬼𦔳，傷。","logicSentenceId":"7631229984326221870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼爻持","logicSentenceId":"7631229984326205486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世，婚姻雖就，禍患随之。","logicSentenceId":"7631229984326205486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財尅世，兄持世，落人之局，必","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762391046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561741131497512"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人財両失。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762391046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"防攔阻者，兄動不成，鬼動有禍。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762407430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄爻持世，到底難成。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762423814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財動相生，不謀而就。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762440198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六冲變冲為凶，三合六合者吉。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762456582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六合變冲，成而不久。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762472966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六冲變合，終必有成。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762489350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奪强婚，遂私约，非禮非義，勿告扵神。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762505734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出妾休妻，原非𠩄欲，有不淂已而出者，心去難留。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762522118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"李我平曰：古法卜婚，不言正理，多尚浮辭，議論多端，緫無憑據，不知先賢何以指人之迷也","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762538502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"？","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762538502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黄金策曰：夫若才能，官占長生之位；妻如醜拙，則落墓庫之郷。","logicSentenceId":"7631229984326238254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此猶近理。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762571270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易冒","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762587654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以八宫而推客貌，六神而㝎財情，則不","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762587654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561741131513896"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可也。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762587654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假令卯月戌日浔否卦，旺財持世，推客貌以八宫者，此卦財在乾宫，乾為天，謂儀名端正，質性聰明，配天徳之淑女。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762604038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然財臨白乕，若兼六神而㫁，白虎乃悖逆之星，成婚之後，配天徳之良女，而悖逆者，未之有也。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762620422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以客貌才情，不必卜之。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762636806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豈不闻在徳不在色，婚姻自有一㝎之縁；財旺官與，定遂唱随之願。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762653190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相生相合，自有悅己之容。","logicSentenceId":"7631229984326254638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉者求之，凶者棄之，用財官𠔥世應而断足矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762669574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必欲両命，不冝入墓，六親俱不相妨，父母不可淪，子孫不可溺，財爻不冝動，官鬼不冝没，","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762685958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561741131530280"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫婦勿二，隂陽莫悖，事事求全。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762685958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不惟世無此十全之女，卽六十四卦之中，無此十全之卦也。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762702342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"浮辭誑世，實誤後人。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762718726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"胎孕章第八十七","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762735110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卜胎之虚實，占孕之安危，问產婦之吉凶，测胎中之男女，各冝分占。","logicSentenceId":"7631229984326271022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"親占代占，皆用子孫，惟子占母孕，以弟兄爻為用神也。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762751494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福神旺相遇生扶，麟種兆瑞；子孫休囚逢破散，胞孕空虚。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762767878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561741131546664"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫臨日月，或遇日月動爻生扶，或動而化吉，皆許成孕。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762784262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若臨空、破、散、绝，或被刑冲尅害，或動而變鬼，化绝化破，或鬼變子，父變子，子化父，水泡風燈，惟動而空者不妨。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762800646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子化子，所生有准。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762817030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子動化子孫，或卦中子孫多動，或巳有旺相之子孫動者，他爻又變出旺相之子孫，皆主㕠胎。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762833414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卜筮元龜云：子孫両旺，㝎是㕠胎。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762849798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：両動兩旺者，此㫁是也。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762866182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内有一衰者，一死","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762882566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561741131563048"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一生，一隂一陽者，一女一男，両現一不動者，非也。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762882566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽變隂，男女可辨。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762898950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六爻静，先看卦包。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762915334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隂包陽，生女，陽包隂，生男。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762931718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隂包陽，坎卦、大過、小過、咸、恒卦是也；陽包隂，離卦、中孚、頤、損卦是也，其餘非也。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762948102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六爻卽静，若無卦包，須看子孫，值陽為男，值隂","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762964486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"為女","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762964486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦有動爻者，雖有卦包而不用。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762964486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神兆機扵動，先看動爻。","logicSentenceId":"7631229984326287406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一爻動者，陽動為女，隂動為男；両爻動者，看上爻，若有三爻發動，看中爻。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519762997254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中多動者，來意不","logicSentenceId":"7586697519763013638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561741131579432"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"誠，改日再占，即刻連占，亦不騐也。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519763013638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如辰月戊辰","logicSentenceId":"7586697519763030022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日","logicSentenceId":"7586697519763030022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，占孕男女，淂小過之豫。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519763030022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：爾之来意，還是问妻孕平安，還是问甭之男女？","logicSentenceId":"7586697519763046406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：両事俱问。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519763062790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：日浚湏宜分占，不可同问。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519763079174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"幸此卦両事俱現，兄爻雖動，不尅變岀之，則爻尊正，㘴草無虞。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519763095558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中陽動變隂，必然生女。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519763111942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：小過卦謂之隂包陽，如何生女？","logicSentenceId":"7586697519763128326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：神兆機扵動，先重","logicSentenceId":"7586697519763144710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561741131595816"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動爻，果扵壬申日生女，產母平安。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519763144710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：占妻平安，及占男女，原冝分占。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519763161094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼若闲時而问兼問者，還可同㫁；若在臨產危急之時而问者，切不可以男女而㫁。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519763177478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如辰月戊子日，女人自卜孕，淂艮之剥。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519763193862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/3/ref/1le3cy4t9repf/1-7539561741131595816_210503_368872.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=keYG0xbOCkQDGzRIpZAsZIAlFLo%3D","pictureHeight":369,"pictureWidth":158,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/3/ref/1le3cy4t9repf/1-7539561741131595816_210503_368872.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=FWXdGpzUBWwVh8aGNJggoGB6FCs%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/3/ref/1le3cy4t9repf/1-7539561741131595816_210503_368872.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此女人生產，已有一曰一夜矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519763210246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予㫁曰：明日申時得生。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519763226630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼","logicSentenceId":"7586697519763243014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫曰：何以知之？","logicSentenceId":"7586697519763243014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：卦中申金子孫一爻獨發，自占者官鬼持世，明日申時，子孫當時岀現，","logicSentenceId":"7586697519763259398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561741131612200"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅去身邊之鬼，而無憂也。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519763259398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：何不許今日申時？","logicSentenceId":"7586697519763275782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：今曰子日冲動，午火尅金，今日不能。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519763292166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又问：是男是女？","logicSentenceId":"7586697519763308550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：爾不知其易理，此卦如何㝎淂男女？","logicSentenceId":"7586697519763324934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神卦随人之念，占此應此，占彼應彼，若在闲暇無事之時而问者，必有男女之念。","logicSentenceId":"7631229984326303790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此時性命在呼吸之间，只願離身淂命足矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519763341318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神現生產之時，不報男女，果生男扵次日申時。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519763357702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦若以陽動變隂，牵扯𠔥㫁者，不知易理之人也。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519763374086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"问產婦安否章第八十八","logicSentenceId":"7586697519763390470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561741131628584"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㘴草臨盆嫌鬼動，胎前產後忌兄搖。","logicSentenceId":"7631229984326320174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財臨绝破妻難保，鬼化妻財命不牢。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519763406854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"问產婦，夫占代占，皆以財為用神，雖則不冝鬼動，倘若兄動尅財，又宜鬼動制服兄爻，不冝財變鬼、鬼變財，兄化財、財化元，及妻逢月破，休囚、墓绝，化墓、化池，或日月中尅，皆為凶。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519763423238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"非覺子。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519763439622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：问胎问婦，雖冝分占，常有不待分占，而卦中先現者，湏冝留心。","logicSentenceId":"7631229984326336558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如子月乙亥日，占妻。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519763456006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷曰：午火妻財臨月破，又被亥日尅之。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519763488774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冬天之火，休囚被尅，全無生扶，命之難保。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519763505158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：卯木子孫動而生火，何謂全無生扶？","logicSentenceId":"7586697519763521542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：卯木子孫動而變鬼","logicSentenceId":"7586697519763537926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519763537926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：母子皆喪，非生火之卯木也。","logicSentenceId":"7631229984326352942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁卦者湏冝知機會神之意。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519763570694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼又曰：財雖不旺，卯木子孫淂子月亥日以生之，何謂子亦不保？","logicSentenceId":"7586697519763587078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：變鬼之子孫，總臨日月，亦無益矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519763603462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦得六冲，財旺子強終是喜；爻逢六合，財空子破六","logicSentenceId":"7586697519774564358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561741131661352"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"為憂。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519774564358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"產期有逺近之分，逺則應月，近則應日。","logicSentenceId":"7631229984326369326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫動者，逢合逢值，静者逢值逢冲，空者，冲空實空之日；破者，實破逢合之期。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519774597126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白乕兄弟而動，值日而生，子孫臨绝，待生旺之日，又有子孫遇長生胎飬之日，伏蔵者，出現之日而生也。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519774613510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
