{"lines":[{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人為利名，奔馳道路，風波不測，占卜當先。","logicSentenceId":"7631229984326402094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻旺相宜行，應若空亡冝止。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519774662662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世為出行人，生旺有氣則吉，動而化吉，及化子孫者，更吉。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519774679046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如若休囚空破，動而化凶者，不冝行也。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519774695430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應為地頭，又為傍倚人。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519774711814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"他若空破墓绝，或動而變鬼變絶化回頭尅者，去之無益。","logicSentenceId":"7631229984326418478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世傷應位，不拘逺近相冝；應尅世爻，公私皆主不利。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519774728198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我去尅他，所向通達。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519774744582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應来刑冲尅世，不可行之。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519774760966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561741131694120"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八纯亂動，在𠁅皆凶。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519774777350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩间齊空，獨行則𠮷。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519774793734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六冲卦及動而變冲，世爻休囚被尅者，終去不成；有始無終，去亦諸般不就。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519774810118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雨间爻者，乃同行附載之人，動而尅世，必𮞸其害。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519774826502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動臨兄爻，破我之財，生合我者為吉。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519774842886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘兩间齊空，若非中途梗阻，㝎然無伴孤行。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519774859270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"静遇日冲必去，動逢合住而留。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519774875654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻暗動者必去；世爻旺靜，逢冲之日必去。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519774892038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻動而化合，𢦙被日月動爻合者，必有事故阻滯","logicSentenceId":"7586697519774908422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不行。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519774908422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561741131710504"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：予甞得騐，亦有應在冲開之日而行。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519774924806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官鬼交重，災禍重；武鬼動，憂盜賊；雀鬼發，防訟非。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519774941190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乕鬼疾病绵纏，蛇鬼風波驚險。","logicSentenceId":"7631229984326434862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勾陳鬼動，事有勾連。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519774957574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼動逢龍，戒扵嫖賭。","logicSentenceId":"7631229984326451246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼發震乾車馬患。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519774973958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼發兌坎，慮風波。","logicSentenceId":"7631229984326467630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坤艮之鬼，山间嶺野逢殃。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519774990342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巽離之官，火厰林窰被難。","logicSentenceId":"7631229984326484014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘在趨避章中詳之。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775006726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福神發動患殃消，出行得遇，子孫發動，子孫持世，世化子孫，程途萬","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775023110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561741131726888"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"里，百禍潜消。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775023110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫尅世者，亦𠮷。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775039494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父尅世爻，風兩舟車行李。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775055878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母持世而動，或被父動冲尅世爻，予淂騐者，有應舟車行李之累，有應風雨淋漓。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775072262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻旺者無妨，最怕休囚而化㐫也。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775088646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄冲世位，花月破耗災非。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775105030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財爻持世，兄爻冲尅者，有應花朝月夕，無端浪費。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775121414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有應小輩，明欺暗騙，致成災非，破耗百出。","logicSentenceId":"7631229984326500398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"返吟化退中途返，六中適墓始終㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775137798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561741131743272"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦得伏呤世動者，冲開之日月必行。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775154182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦得反吟，去到中途亦返。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775170566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世逢冲尅，大㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775186950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六冲卦，世静世空，必不能行，随鬼入墓，世若休囚，不返之兆。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775203334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六合化冲不吉，六冲化合方亨。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775219718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六合卦變六冲，及卦變尅绝者，㘴家亦恐凶危。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775236102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"舟行章第九十二","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775252486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"登舟问何日而到。","logicSentenceId":"7631229984326516782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻發動，合日值日而到。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775268870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若淂子持世，及子孫他爻發動者，值日而到。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775285254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世化退及反吟卦，中途而返。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775301638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561741131759656"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"问舟行平安否？","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775318022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫持世，尅世，生世、合世，一路平安。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775334406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官鬼持世，憂欝驚恐。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775350790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官鬼中尅世爻，災非必見。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775367174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄動破財，風阻者，勿以兄弟為風雲，乃以子孫為順風。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775383558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動而逢","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775399942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合、逢值、静而逢冲之日，空逢冲實之日，與天時章隂晴同㫁。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775399942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"同舟共行章第九十三","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775416326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"同行共𠁅應為尊，同路同舟一描論。","logicSentenceId":"7631229984326533166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應傷世位𮞸他害，墓绝空破負吾恩。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775432710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只冝生合相扶助，永頼维持如","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775449094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561741131776040"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至親。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775449094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三合同途皆遂意，六中半路便灰心。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775465478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"起居為害摇兄鬼，水陸清平動子孫。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775481862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占他人以應為用，占親戚必看用神，不冝","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775498246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄鬼動","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775498246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而尅世，最冝相合相生。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775498246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"行人章第九十四","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775514630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"问行人之歸期，有逺有近。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775531014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逺則應月，近則應日，亦有去久，若在目下當歸，又可以日断之。","logicSentenceId":"7631229984326549550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"问行人之否泰，另占一卦，不可一卦而氣斷也。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775547398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世尅用𠔃人未動，用爻尅世必然歸。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775563782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561741131792424"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占親人，在用神章中詳之。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775580166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"踈者以應爻為用神，世尅用神，且無歸志；用神尅世，指日回家。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775596550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予試果騐。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775612934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"墓絶空破，歸信杳然；明摇暗動，歸鞭發矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775629318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伏藏者，出現之日，動而逢合之日，動化進神不返，用神化退必歸。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775645702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動逢合，有事阻隔；動化鬼，在外危災。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775662086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"最怕動而化尅，還防卦變反吟。","logicSentenceId":"7631229984326565934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻空者，行人卽至；用神静，逢休囚、空破者，且不思歸；動空旺空者，實空冲空之月，曰必回。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775678470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟恐卦變尅绝，及反吟卦用神被冲被尅者，皆難望","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775694854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775694854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歸也。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775694854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561741131808808"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用神三合冲開之月日而来，卦逢六冲，行人無㝎而不返。","logicSentenceId":"7631229984326582318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用爻静者，冲動之日；","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775727622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用爻墓者，開墓之日，用爻無病，可㫁歸期。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775727622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用爻有病，在外不安。","logicSentenceId":"7631229984326598702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：用神墓絶，空破受傷，謂之有病。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775760390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"来人问行人在外平安否，須看有病無病。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775776774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若问歸期，只可看卦象来與不来而斷也。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775793158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如酉月戊申，曰：占母在外何時来？","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775809542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得旅","logicSentenceId":"7631229986627649582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之艮。","logicSentenceId":"7631229986627649582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦若问父母平安否？","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775825926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母卯本日月，動爻冲尅，","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775842310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561741131825192"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必不安矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775842310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今问其来否，不以此斷，只可㫁用神伏蔵受尅而不来，六合變冲也不来。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775858694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後果不来，在外平安。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775875078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"476","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦若问僕人在外之吉凶者，必不歸矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775907846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何也？","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775924230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午火財爻伏而被日月之尅，今问何日可到，不以此㫁。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775940614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世空者速至，此人来矣，己巳日必到。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775956998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應己日者，冲空之日也。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775973382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"已火又是財爻，果扵巳日到。","logicSentenceId":"7586697519775989766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561741131841576"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未月戊戌日，占伯何日來？","logicSentenceId":"7631229986627682350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得屯之随卦。","logicSentenceId":"7631229986627698734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前卦家人占，主父毋為用神，父母真空；此卦兄弟為用神，又落眞空，大凶之兆。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257056809","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再命親人卜之。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257073193","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"次日辛卯，家人又占，得坎之困。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257089577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"527","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：淂此卦者，我為爾以放心矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257105961","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：何也？","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257122345","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：前両卦用神落真空，乃凶亡之兆。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257138729","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今見此卦，申金父母生世，四月必歸。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257155113","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：前二卦父兄落真空，不","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257171497","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561741131907112"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"作准耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257171497","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：何淂？","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257187881","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不惟只因此公大壽無多耳。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257204265","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神報未年之死，不言目下之事。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257220649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：何以知其未年？","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257237033","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：占主者，父臨未土；占兄者，兄臨未土，俱彼日月尅害，因在旬空，所以無禍。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257253417","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未年出空，被日月之傷，得不危乎？","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257269801","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰年占卦，果𢀸扵未年。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257286185","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：連占两卦，俱報未问之事，第三卦中，始報目前之事也矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257302569","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前賢以一卦竟㫁吉凶，不知将此占逺應近、占近應逺之卦，錯斷千千禹萬矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257318953","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"既不能悟出，尚牽强辨論，留作後人之法。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257335337","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"544","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561741131923496"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥月甲子日，占夫在外，還徃他省去否？","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257351721","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淂大壮之大過。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257368105","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"548","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：妻占夫，官為用神，申動尅之，寅八夫爻受尅，不徃他𠁅去矣，不日必回。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257384489","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：何以知其回也？","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257400873","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：日月生夫，夫生世爻，必有歸志。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257417257","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"问曰：何日可到？","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257433641","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：巳日必到。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257450025","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應巳日者，合住申金之日也。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257466409","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵巳日到。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257482793","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：用爻有病，莫问歸期。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257499177","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦申金化進神，以尅寅木，如何許囘？","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257515561","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：彼问夫之平安，卽以","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257531945","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561741131939880"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不利㫁之。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257531945","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今问徃他𠁅去否？","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257548329","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫爻受制，不徃他鄊。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257564713","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁卦者各有取用耳。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257581097","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"563","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰月丙申日，占差家人报書得否？","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257597481","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何日來？","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257613865","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"566","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：書子不淂僕人。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257630249","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今曰自時必到。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257646633","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"问曰：何以知之？","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257663017","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：巳火父化回頭尅，不淂書矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257679401","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申金子孫持世，化卯木鬼，人不到，必有憂。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257695785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今日酉時，冲去卯木，則無憂也。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257712169","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵酉時到，不淂書。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257728553","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉月癸酉日，占","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257744937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"575","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561741131956264"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄何日回？","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257761321","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淂師之臨。","logicSentenceId":"7631229986627764270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"579","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷曰：亥水兄爻旺相而空，出空之日必到。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257777705","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：後日卽是亥日，日前有信至，约在今日起身二千餘里，三日如何淂到？","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257794089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：不獨亥日出空，凡卦中子孫持世，及動而生合世爻，皆是喜悦之神。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257810473","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"許亥日而歸者，寅與亥合，又是合起子孫之日也。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257826857","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"管許歸扵亥日，豈知水路而來，凑得順風，日夜行舟，亥日果到。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257843241","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561741131972648"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：泛常占風，兄動為風，木動生風，惟行舟而上風者，以子孫而為風也。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257859625","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其故何也？","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257876009","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行舟不淂順風，我心憂也。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257892393","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫發動之日，乃淂順風之日也。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257908777","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舟行淂風，我無憂也。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257925161","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此六千古之未傳也。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257941545","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"591","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予扵戌月丙戌日，由江右登舟，占一路平安否？","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257957929","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得蠱之巽。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257974313","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"594","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予疑酉金鬼爻持世，一路憂疑之象，初不知風阻之說也。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520257990697","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及至戊子日，風雨大仆，舟泊南康，始悟此","logicSentenceId":"7586697520258007081","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561741131989032"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520258007081","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子水父動，子日之風兩也，見其化出巳火子孫，卽知巳日方晴，果灣。","logicSentenceId":"7631229986627780654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五曰：巳日天𫔭，淂順風矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520258023465","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自此始悟子孫乃行舟之順風也。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520258039849","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又扵辰月甲成日行舟，占順風，得升之恒。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520258056233","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"603","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午火子孫回頭生世，今日午時，必淂順風，但嫌今日戌日，午火子孫入墓之日，風必不久。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520258072617","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵午時，子孫當令順風𫔭舟，至未時而風止矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520258089001","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"608","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷曰：變爻寅木子孫，尅制丑土之鬼，必到寅日而得順風。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520258121769","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果渊灣船三日，至戊寅日寅時，順風而開舟矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520258138153","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如亥月癸亥日，占風，得未濟之艮。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520258154537","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"612","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一位老先生，楊州人也，由淮回楊，余附載之登舟，","logicSentenceId":"7586697520258170921","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561741132021800"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼卽占風，予曰：明日辰時得順風，戌時卽到府上。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520258170921","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：何其速也？","logicSentenceId":"7586697520258187305","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：二爻辰土子孫，乃得順風之喜悦也。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520258203689","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第四爻戊土子孫，到家之喜也。","logicSentenceId":"7631229986627797038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵次日辰時起風，順行三百餘里，戌時抵家。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520258220073","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"636","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：昨日説在今日酉時，卦中如何不現？","logicSentenceId":"7586697520258351145","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：我心已知神不報矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520258367529","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今日酉時亦有風，必不大，神報明日之大風也。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520258383913","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子水子孫與世爻相合，若逢合住，湏冲破以成功。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520258400297","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明日午日中，因必有順風，果扵次日舟行三百里。","logicSentenceId":"7586697520258416681","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"憂慮官司，却喜官居。","logicSentenceId":"7586700941941637183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空破，最冝子動。","logicSentenceId":"7631229451317755914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子若持世，無非鬼雀同與，口舌不免。","logicSentenceId":"7586700941941653567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蛇鬼尅世，災患相侵。","logicSentenceId":"7631229451317772298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元武鬼，必目盜賊隂人；白乕鬼，㝎有傷痕見血。","logicSentenceId":"7586700941941669951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世動尅應，我與詞，應尅世爻，他有訟。","logicSentenceId":"7586700941941686335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561698363375651"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫動、子孫持世，必不成非；","logicSentenceId":"7586700941941702719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼持世，鬼尅世，應動尅世，㝎然成訟。","logicSentenceId":"7586700941941702719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼此相争，尋世應，不宜冲尅，喜相生。","logicSentenceId":"7586700941941751871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日月尅身，我必受辱；動爻尅應，他在遭刑。","logicSentenceId":"7631229451317788682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應尅世者他勝，世尅應者我嬴。","logicSentenceId":"7586700941941768255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世空世跛，世動化退，我心怯焉。","logicSentenceId":"7586700941941784639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應動應旺，應化進神，他淂勢耳。","logicSentenceId":"7586700941941801023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦遇六冲必散，卦逢六合必成，正不離乎","logicSentenceId":"7586700941941817407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫交。","logicSentenceId":"7586700941941817407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫發動，子孫持世，争性不成。","logicSentenceId":"7631229451317805066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日月動爻，宜扵尅應，不宜尅世，世宜旺，動尅應，及","logicSentenceId":"7586700941941850175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561698363392035"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動而化吉，官事必嬴。","logicSentenceId":"7586700941941850175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"興詞舉訟章第九十七","logicSentenceId":"7586700941941866559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官父同兴，公庭有理。","logicSentenceId":"7586700941941882943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父官尅世，受屈舎𡨚。","logicSentenceId":"7631229451317821450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世化退神，世空世破，卦變六冲，世被刑冲，终不成訟。","logicSentenceId":"7586700941941899327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財與子孫發動，尅破文書，官鬼亦不成之。","logicSentenceId":"7586700941941915711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"巳㝎重罪章第九十八","logicSentenceId":"7586700941941932095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福冝旺相，最忌官興。","logicSentenceId":"7586700941941948479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫持世，子孫發動，巳赴法塲，終須赦免。","logicSentenceId":"7586700941941964863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官鬼尅世，或官鬼持世，又被日月動支冲尅，或世","logicSentenceId":"7586700941941981247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561698363408419"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動化凶，雖㝎輕罪，防改重刑。","logicSentenceId":"7586700941941981247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"疾病章第九十九","logicSentenceId":"7586700941941997631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：人有七情，致生百病，急扵问卜，以慰其心。","logicSentenceId":"7586700941942014015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奈何卜筮諸書，舛錯悖謬，令人反無㝎見。","logicSentenceId":"7586700941942030399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣取用神，又用卦身、世身兼用本命。","logicSentenceId":"7586700941942046783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又有不看身命用神，单看卦驗，卦淂明夷、大觀、賁、蛊、夬、豊、同人、大畜、需卦，断之必死。","logicSentenceId":"7586700941942063167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：死氣喪門臨本命，早备衾棺。","logicSentenceId":"7586700941942079551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：蛇動主死，虎動主喪。","logicSentenceId":"7586700941942095935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以星煞六神而㫁生死。","logicSentenceId":"7586700941942112319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獨不想假使惡煞凶神臨身守命，若得用神二身旺","logicSentenceId":"7586700941942128703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561698363424803"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相㫁之，生耶死耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586700941942128703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予試多年，或生或死，全憑用神，餘皆不騐。","logicSentenceId":"7586700941942145087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内有不看用神而斷生死者，卦變與六冲是也。","logicSentenceId":"7586700941942161471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"六冲變冲乆病難扵調治","logicSentenceId":"7586700941942177855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"久病者，卦逢六冲，卦變六冲，不論用神之衰旺，乃不治之疾也。","logicSentenceId":"7586700941942194239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"近病逢之，不藥而愈。","logicSentenceId":"7586700941942210623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"卦變绝尅新病亦主危亡","logicSentenceId":"7586700941942227007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦變者，亦六冲而變六冲，何其近病亦危？","logicSentenceId":"7586700941942243391","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃因化回頭之尅也。","logicSentenceId":"7631229451317837834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如巽木變乾金，艮坤化震巽，皆謂之","logicSentenceId":"7586700941942259775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561698363441187"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"回頭相尅，雖非墓绝，亦主危亡。","logicSentenceId":"7586700941942259775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若化比和、化尅去，及化回頭相生，近病吉，乆病凶，六冲之故耳。","logicSentenceId":"7586700941942276159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"除此冲尅之外，必看用神。","logicSentenceId":"7586700941942292543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用遇旬空，近病何須憂慮；用逢月破，久病難許安寕。","logicSentenceId":"7586700941942308927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自占病世為用神，占父母弟兄取用神者，皆在用神章内詳之。","logicSentenceId":"7586700941942325311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用神動静而值旬空及化空者，若無日月動爻冲尅，許之冲空、實空之日即愈。","logicSentenceId":"7586700941942341695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘逢冲尅，病雖重而不死。","logicSentenceId":"7586700941942358079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若值月破，湏看用神之旺、衰，旺則愈扵實破之日，及出月而愈，衰而受尅者，必危。","logicSentenceId":"7586700941942374463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561698363457571"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"久病用神值旬空、月破者，卽使用神旺相，亦無法以治之。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060249485354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：海底眼、黄金策，皆云主空無救，中道而殂，不分近病、久病，非經验也。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060249501738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：予得騐者，近病值旬空，若逢三合、六合者，必成久病而終。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060249518122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用化鬼，鬼化用神防不測；忌化用，用神化忌最難醫。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060249534506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自占病，不冝世爻變鬼，及化回頭尅","logicSentenceId":"7586701060249550890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占","logicSentenceId":"7586701060249550890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"咒弟妻子，皆不冝。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060249550890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼變弟兄妻子，及弟兄妻子而變鬼，又不","logicSentenceId":"7586701060249567274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561698363473955"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宜。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060249567274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄變財，財化兄，父化子，子化父。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060249583658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：鬼乃父母之元神，父動化鬼，乃為化生，輕","logicSentenceId":"7586701060249600042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"病者卽愈，久病者，鬼化父，父化鬼，皆主危亡。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060249600042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：用神化鬼，卽為凶兆。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060249632810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假使又值旬空，近病者，何以断之？","logicSentenceId":"7586701060249649194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：曽有占騐，請試詳之。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060249665578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申月庚寅日，占子近病，恒之觧。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060249681962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：鬼變子孫，夭折之兆。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060249698346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"幸淂子孫值旬空，近病","logicSentenceId":"7586701060249714730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561698363490339"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽愈，恐其難過","logicSentenceId":"7586701060249714730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午年。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060249714730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果在出空之日而愈。","logicSentenceId":"7631229451317854218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰年占卦，後至午年出花而死。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060249747498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動墓绝、化墓绝，須憑生旺；日月尅、動爻尅，最怕休囚。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060249763882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用神逢墓绝，及動而化墓化絶，全看旺衰。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060249780266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用神旺者何慮，用神衰者堪憂。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060249796650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日月動爻尅者，亦看旺衰。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060249813034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺者冲去尅神之日而愈；衰者生助尅神之","logicSentenceId":"7586701060249829418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而日危。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060249829418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"散破無援，脱氣忌搖，元動仇興，用神臨散，遇破全無生扶，或脱氣。","logicSentenceId":"7631229451317870602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此四者若無根蒂，少吉多凶。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060249845802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561794612756480"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌神動尅用神，若有元神發動，許之有救。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060249862186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只恐忌神又動，當許凶危，須扵元神章内詳之。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060249878570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以有两説。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060249911338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自占病，官鬼持世，其病難痊，雖淂子動，尅去身邊鬼，目下雖愈，終不斷根，不然，遲遲又生他病。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060249927722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此之謂病不離身，身不離藥。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060249944106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世臨官鬼，以臨帝旺長生，必淂久逺殘疾。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060249960490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"代占六親之病。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060249976874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若見官鬼持世，乃憂抑之状，惟喜子孫發動，尅去我之憂疑，卽使用神衰弱，管許","logicSentenceId":"7586701060249993258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平安。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060249993258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561794612772864"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如申月壬子日，占子病，得遯卦。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250009642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/2/ref/1lbojz50hh7aq/1-7539561794612772864_415493_531870.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=50Re%2FIqQyEerWSKAPXlXCJro6QQ%3D","pictureHeight":377,"pictureWidth":116,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/2/ref/1lbojz50hh7aq/1-7539561794612772864_415493_531870.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=OHCWNf5fZmAVNYvS%2FTj%2Byc7Aaoo%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/2/ref/1lbojz50hh7aq/1-7539561794612772864_415493_531870.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷曰：令郎今日即愈，何以知之？","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250026026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：官鬼持世，甭之憂也。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250042410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今日子日冲去憂心，管許立愈。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250058794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵本","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250075178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日愈。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250075178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：如占自身及兄弟妻児者，此法是也。","logicSentenceId":"7631229451317886986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘占父母之災，官鬼為父母之元神，豈冝子動而傷耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250091562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻占夫病，官鬼為用神，又豈子動以傷官耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250107946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不惟不能觧憂，身臨福徳，勢雖險以堪醫。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250124330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561794612789248"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦有兩說","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250140714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"：自占病，子孫持世，不藥而痊；臨空破者，實空實破之日而愈。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250140714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"代占六親之病，不必看用神之衰旺，卽知其安。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250173482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何也？","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250189866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫乃喜悦之神，只要旺相動扵卦中者，亦為吉慶。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250206250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如寅月乙卯日，占妻病，淂屯之莭。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250222634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：尊正未日卽愈。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250239018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：妻財不上卦，何淂卽愈？","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250255402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：子孫化子孫，乃喜恱之神，嫌其太旺，許未日","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250271786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561794612805632"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"愈者，木墓扵未，未日而喜悦也。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250271786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尊正若不全安，何喜之有？","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250288170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵午日退災，未日大愈。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250304554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：占父母病，子孫持世而動者，尅去父母之元神。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250320938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻占夫病，子動傷父，皆非喜恍之神也，須冝通變可也。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250337322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼爻發動，病勢必重。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250370090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若長生扵日辰，或動化長生，病勢必増。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250386474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅用神者，為忌神；若動化進神，亦同此意。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250402858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌神化退，其病漸减。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250419242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561794612822016"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：鬼乃父母之元神也，占父母者，其病卽愈。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250435626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼乃女人占夫之用神也，占夫者，亦主卽愈。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250452010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福搖化尅，卦反呤，病必反復。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250468394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自占病及占兄弟病，淂子孫動者，制服官鬼，其病卽愈。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250484778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘子孫動而化尅，卽使病愈，愈後還發，反覆之象。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250501162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦淂反吟者，亦同此意。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250517546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用绝逢生，危而有救；生衰淂助，重亦何妨。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250533930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用爻受刑冲尅制，但得日月動爻有一而生扶者，乃為絶䖏逢生，臨危有救。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250550314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561794612838400"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用神不冝太弱，弱則軆虚，卒難痊可。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250566698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但淂生扶拱合，雖淂重病，亦不至死。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250583082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：用神不冝扵太旺，易理貴乎中庸。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250599466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"過猶不及，","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250615850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽如巳月、戊午日，自占","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250615850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"病，得未","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250615850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"濟之暌。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250615850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𬼘公壽逾八旬，占病淂此，予未敢言。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250632234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼親彭生，𣼛口賛好：世臨日辰，當摧浔令，又有寅木生之，不藥而愈。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250648618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸公見予沉吟，促问之急，予曰：過十八壬戌","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250665002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561794612854784"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日，則不碍矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250665002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果卒扵壬戌日寅時。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250681386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彭生问曰：卦之旺也，何故㫁其戊日之危？","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250697770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：正為不冝。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250714154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺極身噐滿則傾，理之常也。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250730538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衰極老人，而淂全盛之卦，日将墜而現霞，燈将燼而放亮，豈能久乎？","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250746922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"断壬戍日者，旺火入墓也。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250763306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今死寅時，逢三合也。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250779690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用臨日月，休尋伏卦。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250796074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無用神，淂日月作用神者，不必尋伏神，許之","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250812458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽愈。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250812458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伏神衰弱，再冝占。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250828842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡用神不現，再占一卦。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250845226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前卷伏神章中註觧明白，","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250861610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561794612871168"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宜細味之。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250861610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：野鶴輿","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250877994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予之占騐極多，不能𥁞刻，聊存數卦，以為湲賢之法。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250877994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如申月、癸亥日，占","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250910762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"友痣病，淂未濟。","logicSentenceId":"7586701060250910762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：以上數卦，敎人多占之法也。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128474296374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以數卦合而詳之，吉凶之日月可知矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128474312758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑月丙戌日，自占近病，淂比之革。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128474329142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561794612969472"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官鬼持世，申金發動，尅去身邉之鬼，及世化亥水回頭生，當許其愈。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128474345526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但世爻随鬼入空墓，又值三合，恐成久病。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128474361910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命親人再占，仝日，妻占夫，得中孚之兌。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128474378294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯木官鬼為用，化未土空亡，近病化空即愈，但不冝前後兩卦俱值三合，恐成久病而終。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128474394678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：防在何時？","logicSentenceId":"7586701128474411062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：未墓空而且破，若占防憂防患者，破羅","logicSentenceId":"7586701128474427446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561794612985856"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破網，容易而脫。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128474427446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今占病者，值三合而難痊，明年未月，犹恐填實其墓，果卒扵次年末月，存","logicSentenceId":"7586701128474443830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此為浚賢之法者，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7586701128474443830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要知近病逢空，化空卽愈，若值三合者，必成久病而終。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128474476598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如寅月乙酉日，占外甥久病，淂坤之乾。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128474492982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"久病逢冲必死，况淂六冲化六冲，三月必危，果卒扵三月。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128474509366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應三月者，酉金子孫為用神，動如逢合之月也。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128474525750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又是冲去成土，酉金而無生","logicSentenceId":"7586701128474542134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561794613002240"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，存","logicSentenceId":"7586701128474542134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此課而為法者，久病逢冲，用神雖臨日建，又有戊土生之，亦不活也。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128474542134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如子月丙寅日，自占瘟病，淂節之中孚。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128474574902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/2/ref/1lbojz50hniuq/1-7539561794613002240_296499_466867.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=45loMyM%2FTkkklA0JXmavgroy0bI%3D","pictureHeight":368,"pictureWidth":170,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/2/ref/1lbojz50hniuq/1-7539561794613002240_296499_466867.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=LZ12gdJxoaWWrIw9LAYqaOPA7mc%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/2/ref/1lbojz50hniuq/1-7539561794613002240_296499_466867.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：子水尅世，月建尅世，大凶之兆。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128474591286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"幸有寅日相生，若肯避瘟扵南方，夜卧南床，使火旰而水枯，可保無虞。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128474607670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果依𬼘行亥日，病勢危急，得遇良醫，寅日而愈。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128474624054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼時瘟疫流行，家家傳染，一人同日，亦淂此卧，予亦傳此法以避之。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128474640438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因此人病重，又信傍言，病","logicSentenceId":"7586701128474656822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561794613018624"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人不可移床，未肯迁移，卒扵亥日。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128474656822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：留此以為法者，使其知趨避之法也。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128474673206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如丑月，乙未日，占子發熱，是花痘否？","logicSentenceId":"7586701128474689590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"浔兌卦。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128474705974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：法以官鬼旺者，是花痘也。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128474722358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予試不騐，乃揣摹之説，只看子孫之旺衰。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128474738742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫旺者是花，何碍？","logicSentenceId":"7586701128474755126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦日月世爻尅子孫，卦淂六冲，花未開而先謝，不祥之兆。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128474771510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明早潔誠再占。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128474787894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷曰：父爻發動，雖有制服，不冝鬼變子孫，令郞須請明人治之。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128474820662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：何䖏醫人為吉？","logicSentenceId":"7586701128474837046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：古以子孫爻為醫人，今既占子孫，豈又以子孫爻為醫藥耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586701128474853430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占淂地澤臨變地水師。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128474869814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷曰：巳火父動尅子，北方醫人可治。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128474886198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果請北门醫","logicSentenceId":"7586701128474902582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561794613051392"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"家治之。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128474902582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至庚子曰痘變，又占得解之歸妹。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128474918966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
