{"lines":[{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷曰：子日中動午火，子孫遇寅木而生之，此卦非比前卦，巳有生機。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128474935350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：今日痘變，北门，還有一楊姓者，意欲請之，再占一卦，何如？","logicSentenceId":"7586701128474951734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：楊字有木，卦中寅木生午火，是此人也，不必再卜。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128474968118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果請此人治之，其花江艷，後淂安然。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128474984502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此乃敎人延醫之法也。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128475000886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561794613067776"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"痘疹章第一百","logicSentenceId":"7586701128475017270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平時而问男女，何時出花，鬼爻為用，鬼爻静者，逢值逢冲，鬼爻動者，逢值逢合，鬼衰逢生旺之年，鬼旺鬼多逢墓庫之嵗，鬼空鬼破，填實之時。","logicSentenceId":"7631229451317936138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼若伏蔵，","logicSentenceId":"7586701128475033654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出現之嵗。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128475033654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見花而问吉凶，卦忌六冲，兼忌子孫化鬼，及鬼化子孫，父化子，子化父，子孫伏而空破，皆非吉兆。","logicSentenceId":"7631229451317952522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"问花之疏宻者，鬼旺而臨日月，及動爻生扶，花必稠宻；如值空破、休囚、墓绝，痘在疏朗。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128475050038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼動亁宫，多生頭上；鬼搖坤宫，腹上多義。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128475066422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"艮宫多扵手，兌宫多扵口，坎","logicSentenceId":"7586701128475082806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561794613084160"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"離上身，震㢲下身，火鬼，其色红紫；金鬼，其色虚白，水鬼湏防黑陷，木鬼雜细；土為腫大。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128475082806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以上四條，分占四卦，不可一卦而㫁之，大抵全在子孫爻也。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128475099190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫臨日月，及日月動爻相生，動而化吉，不受刑傷，中尅爻不亂動，花雖宻而全生，痘雖䧟仍收功也。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128475115574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"病源章第一百一","logicSentenceId":"7586701128475131958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火屬心经，居熱咽干口燥；水歸賢部，惡寒盗汙遺精。","logicSentenceId":"7631229451317968906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金肺木肝土，乃病侵脾胃。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128475148342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衰輕旺重，動則煎迫身軀。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128475164726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561794613100544"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"螣蛇心驚，青龍則酒色過度；勾陳腫脹，朱雀則言語顛狂。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128475181110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虎有損傷，女子則血崩血晕。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128475197494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元武憂欝，男人則隂症隂虚。","logicSentenceId":"7631229451317985290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：此乃黄金策，占疾病之首論也。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128475213878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予以之為撞门槌，對俗人而言，不得不以此而動之。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128475230262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若知分占之法，另占一卦，以㝎吉凶，庶有浚騐。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128475246646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若即以此","logicSentenceId":"7586701128475263030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦而兼断其生死者，如若有靈，吾不信也。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128475263030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要知来人而问病有何所犯，何以治之，及问吉凶何如，我且以發寒發熟而妄猜，猜淂着者，哄此一時，而病","logicSentenceId":"7586701128475295798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561794613116928"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人不淂趍避之指，问卦何益？","logicSentenceId":"7586701128475295798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今見此章，𥁞是单言病症，並不言及何法治之。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128475312182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如果心经發𤍠，来人豈不知也？","logicSentenceId":"7586701128475328566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"請问治其熱者是何法也？","logicSentenceId":"7586701128475344950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無益之論。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128475361334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故𥁞删之。","logicSentenceId":"7631229451318018058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余常以来人问病，先命占其吉凶，卦淂吉者，許之調理，郎愈，不必服藥求神。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128475377718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦淂凶者，命之延醫；卦淂鬼動尅用神者，命之再占鬼神，或占家宅，或占墳塋，務必求其是何所犯，何法治之，庶不負来人之问也。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128475394102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"鬼神章第一百二","logicSentenceId":"7586701128475410486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561794613133312"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占鬼神，卦中鬼值休囚及空破墓绝，皆非鬼神之害也。","logicSentenceId":"7631229451318001674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官鬼屬金，旺相者，武神及西方之神；休囚者，刀劍身三之鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128475426870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼臨木者，旺則文神及東方之神，衰則倚草附木之妖，或是刑杖懸鿄之鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7631229451318034442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水為河海及北方之神，休囚者，池井江湖水死","logicSentenceId":"7586701128475443254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128475443254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火鬼火神及雷公、電母、窰竈之神；休囚者，湯火焚燒之魂也。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128475459638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561794613149696"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土鬼土神及中央之廟，或掌管山川社稷之神，休囚者，墻倒屋塌土死之鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128475476022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古以金、木、水、火、土各分其神，卽如金官者，謂之天将、関公、金剛、元神、伍公、岳公䒭神。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128475492406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予以為非武神者，不可盡数之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128475508790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有勅封者，有未封者，各方上俗不同，書之未載者更多，何淂各廟而祭之？","logicSentenceId":"7586701128475525174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須问病人，或扵某武神廟中許願，信而未還，或扵何廟穢汚仆踐心有疑，疑者，指其神而占之。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128475541558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼爻或旺或動，是此神也。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128475557942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如不上卦，再占他𠁅之神可也。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128475574326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561794613166080"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼值木火水土者，皆用此法。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128475590710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淂罪扵正神者，香死纸馬祭之。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128475607094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勾惹邪祟之鬼者，用漿纸錢，夜净之時，金鬼者向中","logicSentenceId":"7631229451318050826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"送之，水鬼者向北送，餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7631229451318050826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：凢得時災瘟瘴，照此法而祭送者，予屢騐之。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128475623478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘係瘋痨氣蠱，旣失調理扵前，酒色傷身，又失慎重扵浚，與神鬼何干？","logicSentenceId":"7586701128475639862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"祭之送之，皆無益矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128475656246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟莭飲食，逺色慾，息氣飬神，其病自減。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488255551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予遊遍江湖，曾歷滇、黔、蜀、粤，彼方不服藥，專信鬼神，先用三牲五牲，浚至殺牛宰馬，一次不愈，甚至二三十次，因病","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488271935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561794613182464"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"致窮者多矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488271935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殊不知害他命而救命，其罪愈彰，所以屢見害性命之多者，終不能救而死，可不戒欺！","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488288319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今下路讀書人，亦信此邪神者，予實不解。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488304703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神農甞百草，遺救生靈，未聞有何聖賢敎人宰性命","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488321087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以救命也。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488321087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"李我平曰：易冒以鬼臨金者為關公岳王，補遺又以青龍為漢夀亭侯，第不知関公之前，金鬼舆青龍，是何神也？","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488337471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：祭者降之以福，不祭者降之以殃，此乃仆福作威之邪神也。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488353855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正直之神，何淂有此？","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488370239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此書通前徹浚，無一不合扵理。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488386623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獨此疾病章中心言鬼神之事，","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488403007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561794613198848"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予實不服，疑因今人问病，𫔭口先","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488403007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"问鬼神，不淂不従俗耳，智者察之。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488403007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"延醫章第一百三","logicSentenceId":"7631229451318067210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：有人问余曰：问卜以求神，延醫而服藥，有是理乎？","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488419391","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：若無此理，伏羲畫卦，神農甞藥，作何事耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488435775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：然則又有不能救者，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488452159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：有根者可以救之，無根者則不能也。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488468543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人之星辰過宫，或是交運脱限，謂之移花接木之年，移其有根之花木者，上則遮盖，下冝浇水，則活矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488484927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不浇不盖，見日則枯。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488501311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"服藥求神者，卽此意也。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488517695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若使無根之木，無蒂之","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488534079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561794613215232"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"花，雖澆雖盖，亦無益矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488534079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自占求醫，應為醫人，代六親而求醫者，亦以應為醫。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488550463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼仆憂神休妄動，福為喜悅要生扶。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488566847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自占代占，鬼乃憂疑之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488583231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若持世及動扵卦中，得子孫動而制之，此醫可請，手到成功。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488599615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若淂子孫臨應爻者，乃明醫也。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488615999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其故何也？","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488632383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫乃制鬼之神，非真正能制邪魔之鬼也，乃尅去憂神，我無憂也。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488648767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應仆醫人，不冝空破墓绝。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488665151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561794613231616"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應爻空破墓绝，休囚衰弱，或旺相而被日月動爻冲尅，或動而化鬼、化绝，化回頭尅，藥不見效。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488681535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫制鬼，最喜旺相生扶。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488697919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫臨世應，或發動扵卦中，亦要旺相，不受刑冲尅害，不逢破墓绝空，藥必見效。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488714303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子動化鬼、化尅，其藥不精。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488730687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子動化空，實空之日","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488747071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有效。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488747071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子動化生、化旺、化近神者，其藥更靈。","logicSentenceId":"7631229451318083594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古以子動化子孫，其藥必雜，非也。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488763455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子動化子孫而旺相者，另改藥品，卽比仙丹。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488779839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561794613248000"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"醫尅用爻，近病卽愈。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488796223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自占病，應爻尅世者，尅制我之病也。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488812607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應爻尅用神，亦如此㫁，惟不冝乎久病及軆弱之人，非獨尅病，身亦受其傷矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488828991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應爻臨兄鬼而尅用神，及尅世爻者，不拘久病、近病，必𮞸其害。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488845375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父爻持世，妙藥難調。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488861759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自占病，父持世，藥不見㓛，冝扵静飬，逺色慾，息氣惱可也。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488878143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561794613264384"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟持世，有子孫動扵卦中者，醫可延之，惟嫌鬼旺鬼興，误服藥餌。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488894527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"财爻持世，切勿誤食肥甘。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488910911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺相遇生扶，良醫有覓；休囚逢冲尅，無藥可醫。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488927295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子不代父而占藥，妻不代夫而卜醫。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488943679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子占父，冝父爻旺相，占醫占藥，又以子孫為用神，父旺以傷子也。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488960063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一爻不能兩用。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488976447","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻占夫，冝官鬼旺相，占醫占藥，亦以子孫為用神，子旺又能傷父，所以不能代占醫也。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128488992831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561794613280768"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"延醫扵子孫之方，治病以應爻而㝎。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128489009215","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中子孫爻旺者，延醫扵子孫之方。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128489025599","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如午火子孫或旺或動，請南方之醫，餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128489041983","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中子孫休囚空破者，又看應爻旺否。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128489058367","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若淂應爻旺相，生合用神，即扵應爻之方請之。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128489074751","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如應爻臨申金，明醫必在西南，餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128489091135","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如卦中有一爻獨發而生用神者，又以此方","logicSentenceId":"7586701128489107519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而","logicSentenceId":"7586701128489107519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"延醫。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128489107519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以五行而㝎名姓。","logicSentenceId":"7631229451318099978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水爻動，㸃水之姓；火爻動，姓名像火，木爻卓頭，木傍土爻，姓名有之。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128489140287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561794613297152"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如占妻病，妻爻屬水，得申金發動以相生，請錢姓之醫以治之，餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128489156671","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不起之症，卦中不現其醫。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128489173055","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"立愈之災。","logicSentenceId":"7631229451318116362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻冲不報用藥。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128489189439","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"屢見占醫之卦，無藥可醫之症者，神不現其醫矣。","logicSentenceId":"7631229451318132746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若非用神化鬼，鬼化用神，卽是忌神化六親，六親化忌神，及用神化绝、化尅化墓，久病逢中逢空，随鬼入墓，此皆無藥而醫也。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128489205823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"病之卽愈，神亦不現","logicSentenceId":"7586701128489222207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其醫。","logicSentenceId":"7586701128489222207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"近病者，若非卦淂六冲，卽現用值旬空，或用神化回頭生，自占者子孫持","logicSentenceId":"7631229451318149130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561794613313536"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世，此皆不藥而愈也。","logicSentenceId":"7631229451318149130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：諸書皆曰：一卦之中，可决一家休咎，六爻之内，能分六事吉凶。","logicSentenceId":"7633451073467236392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以卦中之父母爻為屋宇，又以父母爻為獲親，旣為二親，又以五爻為父，四爻為母，扵山悖謬糊塗，尚自刋傳爲法，余實不觧。","logicSentenceId":"7586690414493745178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561741132775464"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假令戊月丙午曰，龍元虎蛇、勾朱，占得乹之小畜","logicSentenceId":"7586690414493761562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"世應戌申午火，官鬼辰寅子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父兄","logicSentenceId":"7586690414493761562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"未𡈽父母。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父財子。","logicSentenceId":"7586690414493761562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古法有云：卦無父母，不免堂上之憂。","logicSentenceId":"7586690414493777946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦不獨有父母，戊土父母臨月建，午火官動以相生，卽父母䨇慶之祥也。","logicSentenceId":"7586690414493794330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若又以五爻為父，四爻爲母断者，鬼臨四位，老毋多災。","logicSentenceId":"7586690414493810714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"執此问之，走母多災耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586690414493827098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"堂上無憂耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586690414493843482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：何爻受尅，卽此逢傷。","logicSentenceId":"7586690414493859866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今五爻申金被午火鬼尅，此又老父以生災也。","logicSentenceId":"7586690414493876250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：鬼動乾宫，老父","logicSentenceId":"7586690414493892634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561741132791848"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之咎。","logicSentenceId":"7586690414493892634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦鬼發乹宫，又為老父之咎。","logicSentenceId":"7586690414493909018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：火鬼動以防回祿，白乕鬼為喪服之憂。","logicSentenceId":"7586690414493925402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：世逢生旺，宅旺家安。","logicSentenceId":"7586690414493941786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦世巳旺矣，奈囙火鬼臨扵鬼動，可謂之囘祿乎？","logicSentenceId":"7586690414493958170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丧孝乎？","logicSentenceId":"7586690414493974554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"家興宅旺乎？","logicSentenceId":"7586690414493990938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又以官鬼為㕔，謂之官旺，屋宇軒昂。","logicSentenceId":"7586690414494007322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：鬼旺鬼與，為災為咎。","logicSentenceId":"7586690414494023706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦鬼臨日辰旺動，屋宇軒昂乎，為災為咎乎？","logicSentenceId":"7586690414494040090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：財興官旺，熱闹门庭。","logicSentenceId":"7586690414494056474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：財爻發動，父母𮞸傷，豈门庭熱闹之家皆無父母之家耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586690414494072858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：兄爻旺相，紫荆並茂扵堂前。","logicSentenceId":"7586690414494089242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：元弟持世，绿後再理。","logicSentenceId":"7586690414494105626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豈鴈行","logicSentenceId":"7586690414494122010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561741132808232"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隊隊者皆失履遺簪之宅耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586690414494122010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"種種悖謬，難以枚舉。","logicSentenceId":"7586690414494138394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予不得已而正之。","logicSentenceId":"7586690414494154778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"○盖造買宅賃宅章第一百六","logicSentenceId":"7586690414494171162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父旺持世，此䖏清安冝久住。","logicSentenceId":"7586690414494187546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父爻旺相，持世，生世合世，及世爻動而化父相生。","logicSentenceId":"7586690414494203930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或淂日月作父母生合世爻皆為發福之第。","logicSentenceId":"7586690414494220314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財爻發動，他方仁里，另冝求。","logicSentenceId":"7586690414494236698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財動以尅父爻，另扵他𠁅圖之。","logicSentenceId":"7586690414494253082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻逢六合，終見亨通。","logicSentenceId":"7586690414494269466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦遇反吟，多扵愁嘆。","logicSentenceId":"7633451073467252776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561926294569012"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻、父爻旺相，又淂六合卦者，事之必成，成而久逺，但不喜其六冲、六冲，不久之象。","logicSentenceId":"7586690414494285850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦遇反吟，倘如世被冲尅，大凶之兆。","logicSentenceId":"7586690414494302234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世動而化進，绵長百代。","logicSentenceId":"7586690414494318618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父興不化退，増置千间。","logicSentenceId":"7633451073467269160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世動化退，勉強成之，終湏退悔。","logicSentenceId":"7586690414494335002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世動而化進神者，成後長逺興隆，名隆利厚。","logicSentenceId":"7586690414494351386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父動化退神，成浚凋零破敗。","logicSentenceId":"7633451073467285544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘淂化進，従此再置千间。","logicSentenceId":"7586690414494367770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"最忌随官入墓，湏防鬼動傷身，世交随鬼入墓，財爻助鬼尅世，及世爻動而變凶，","logicSentenceId":"7586690414494384154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561926294585396"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或日月動爻尅世皆不宜行。","logicSentenceId":"7586690414494384154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父動尅世，及世爻、父爻空破墓他者，六不宜行。","logicSentenceId":"7586690414494400538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：凡盖造、買宅、賃宅，世與父爻旺相，不犯冲尅者，卽宜成之，自是榮華昌盛。","logicSentenceId":"7586690414494416922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如问一家之吉凶，雖則湏冝分占，𡖋待遷居入火之時，擇其吉日而占之，告扵神曰：今擇某日遷居，碍扵父母妻子否？","logicSentenceId":"7586690414494433306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若有防碍，湏宜另擇。","logicSentenceId":"7586690414494449690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一曰不然，或呌所碍之人，另擇一時以入门者可也。","logicSentenceId":"7586690414494466074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朝𢌜頒暦，以便民间之用者，此也。","logicSentenceId":"7586690414494482458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如若盖造買造，占问一家，俱宜吉慶。","logicSentenceId":"7586690414494498842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假令","logicSentenceId":"7586690414494515226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561926294601780"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"家有百口，欲使人人合其吉者，百年買不成矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586690414494515226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"創造宫室章第一百七","logicSentenceId":"7586690414494531610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"創造興工，卦忌六冲。","logicSentenceId":"7633451073467301928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼動為忌，尅世最凶。","logicSentenceId":"7586690414494547994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"随官入墓，禍患多逢。","logicSentenceId":"7586690414494564378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父爻旺相，世位興隆。","logicSentenceId":"7586690414494580762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世父両爻動化，吉人安宅，盛事亨通。","logicSentenceId":"7586690414494597146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561926294962228"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"同居章第一百十四","logicSentenceId":"7586690819533815846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與六親同居，用六親與外人同居，看應爻，世為己，應為人，世應相合相生，日月動爻生合世應者，彼此俱祥。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819533832230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅世我𮞸傷，尅應他𮞸害。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819533848614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世尅應，他畏扵我。","logicSentenceId":"7633451271164444707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應尅世，我被他欺。","logicSentenceId":"7633451271164461091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑冲者同。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819533864998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與六親同居，宜扵世與用神相生，不宜相冲相尅。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819533881382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"盖造官衙章第一百十五","logicSentenceId":"7586690819533897766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官府自占，世與官星皆宜旺相，子孫持世，及子孫動者，且勿行之。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819533914150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅變尅绝，反招奇禡，六冲化合，必獲","logicSentenceId":"7586690819533930534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奇祥。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819533930534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561926294978612"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"占衙宇章第一百十六","logicSentenceId":"7586690819533946918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：凢占舊衙署者，與占舊家宅同㫁。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819533963302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有目人口多病，有目連任傷官，有目久不陞轉，有目鬼崇現形，亦可指其所疑而卜。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819533979686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曾目衙署連任，不利扵官府，若非降削，卽見凶三。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819533996070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"迎扵府中，卜過半月，但有所疑，俱曽卜過皆不現爻。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819534012454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又卜後溝從浚流。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819534028838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"宜否。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊月己亥曰：應世，占浔鼎卦，邑未酉酉亥丑，兄子財，財、鬼子，","logicSentenceId":"7586690819534045222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561926294994996"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：卽此𠁅也，速宜改徃。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819534045222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"東流。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819534061606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後開溝，見許多屍骸白骨。","logicSentenceId":"7633451271164477475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予悟曰：乕鬼持世，是以有之。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819534077990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又請占一卦，世應修溝之浚何邑","logicSentenceId":"7586690819534094374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"未土，財酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰寅子，如得噬嗑之无妄子、","logicSentenceId":"7586690819534094374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"申金官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官財、兄父，斷曰：未土財化申金官，未年一㝎髙遷。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819534094374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"浚扵申年陞任。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819534110758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應申年者，值官之年也。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819534127142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"盖造寺院章第一百十七","logicSentenceId":"7586690819534143526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵與家宅同推，不宜正冲、變冲，卦變墓绝，及反吟、","logicSentenceId":"7586690819534159910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561926295011380"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伏吟住持與山主，占者皆宜世旺，日月動爻相生，宜子孫爻動，忌官鬼爻與兄爻持世，多費無益之財。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819534159910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官鬼持世，疾病災殃之累。","logicSentenceId":"7633451271164493859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄爻動而尅世者，欲造福，反成禍胎。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819534176294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官生世者，雖乏鈔，自有增助。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819534192678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫旺相而化進神，多招徒弟。","logicSentenceId":"7633451271164510243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財爻休囚而化退者，有始無終。","logicSentenceId":"7633451271164526627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"李我平曰：卜並諸書二十餘種，所論家宅，理不歸一，不知昔賢是何主見。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819534209062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卜筮大全。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819534225446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"初井、二竈，三床，四門，五爻為人，六爻棟宇。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819534241830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黄金策，初爻宅基，二爻宅舎，三爻為門，四為父母，五兄矛，六妻財。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819534258214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易冒以初爻為切，","logicSentenceId":"7586690819534274598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561926295027764"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二爻為妻，三弟、四母，五爻為父，上爻為老。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819534274598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"他書俱各不同，不暇细具。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819534290982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易冒又云：鬼動扵内，宅室之災；鬼動扵外，人丁之咎。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819534307366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"既以二爻為妻，三爻為弟，假令内爻鬼動，宅室之災乎？","logicSentenceId":"7586690819534323750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"弟妻之咎乎？","logicSentenceId":"7586690819534340134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至扵五行之鬼，八宫之鬼，既以之㝎官災火盗，又以之定頭目手足病災。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819534356518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼謂火鬼主囘祿，鬼在乹宫，主頭目之患。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819534372902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若以一卦而兼斷，豈失火盜之家，必染頭目之病耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586690819534389286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：合為门，衝為路，不論卦内之有無，但要暗冲與暗合。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819534405670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假使有冲無合，有合無冲，豈有门無路之家耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586690819534422054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殊不知占","logicSentenceId":"7586690819534438438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561926295044148"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"家定之趍避，願人口以為安，財福旺而宅興，鬼兄静而家寧，扵斯而己，何必多生枝葉，以亂浚人耳目。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819534438438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"塋𦵏章第一百十八","logicSentenceId":"7586690819534454822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：卜茔卜穴，古法之謬，與家宅相同，浚賢考諸書而自曉。","logicSentenceId":"7633451271164543011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予因求騐之法，每遇拜掃之時，到各塚上，命伊占之，或知人覔地，就而占之。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819534471206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如此多年，始淂其秘。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819534487590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"608","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"占地師章第一百二十三","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810230318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"609","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應為用神，旺相生合世爻，雖愚六用。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810246702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"休囚冲尅世位，賢亦不宜。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810263086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應俱空莫訪，應臨空破非奇。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810279470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應爻旺相，與世爻相生相合，㦯與世爻仆，三合，不論。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810295854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應臨財鬼、兄爻，人毁之而無才，我喜之而有縁。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810312238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561926295388212"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"休囚冲尅世爻者，卽使應臨官父，他有博學，我被他愚。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810328622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應皆空，彼此無縁。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810345006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應逢空破，無才無徳。","logicSentenceId":"7633451271165165603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"618","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"㸃穴章第一百二十四","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810361390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"619","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世在初、二爻，穴宜下，在五、六爻，穴在上，三、四爻，穴宜扵中。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810377774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水持世爻，穴近扵水，㦯是坑窩之地。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810394158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世臨土者，卽扵髙堆㸃穴。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810410542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世臨寅木，最木盛草之方。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810426926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申酉持世，石塊石堆，火乃枯焦，红泥集土，及草木枯草之䖏是也。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810443310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應如未月乙巳日戊申午辰寅子，","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810459694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561926295404596"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占穴淂大壮兄子父兄鬼財。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810459694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此地绖過，法眼皆言其吉，久占此地，亦許其吉。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810476078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目屢掘逢石，無𠁅尋穴。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810492462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"央予到塚，卜得此卦。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810508846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：世在四爻，穴在中段，因午火持世，卽性中段。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810525230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觀看，見有一𠁅，草木枯焦，有成朶野花红色，别𠁅皆無。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810541614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：卽此穴也。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810557998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"掘之必逢土穴。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810574382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"東家尚疑。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810590766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：我有一法，将錢一文，㸃記红硃，亂入數百錢内。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810607150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"公可設下香案，禱告扵天，得红硃錢者，卽其穴也。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810623534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"令人遍地灑之，果淂硃記之錢，扵红花之下，掘之，僅有周","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810639918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561926295420980"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"圍丈餘皆泥土也，餘皆石塊。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810639918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"640","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此公次年開府，两公即五年之内，俱登甲榜。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810656302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"641","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"謀地偷乘章第一百二十五","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810672686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"642","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：謀地偷𦵏，乃損人利己之事。","logicSentenceId":"7633451271165181987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以此䘮心之為，而問扵神，卦若有靈，是神教人而作嗇心之事也。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810689070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殊不知先有心地，而浚得遇隂地。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810705454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"昔有人恃財倚勢，欺滔貧人，謀奪其地以矣親。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810721838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後遇識者，而曰：此地不發，必無地理。","logicSentenceId":"7633451271165198371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此地若發，必無天理。","logicSentenceId":"7633451271165214755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"既有天理，循環之報，能久逺昌盛者，未之有也。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810738222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"649","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561926295437364"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"祖塋舊塚章第一百二十六","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810754606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"651","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"祖父之墓，成𦵏多年，㦯𦵏未久，如來卜者，必有其因，湏冝審明，方可决斷。","logicSentenceId":"7633451271165231139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有囙連年困苦，疑祖塋之不利。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810770990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有因屢科不發，或有子入塲，疑此風水可能發科甲否。","logicSentenceId":"7633451271165247523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"為己者，湏宜自占，為子孫者，命子孫来占。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810787374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有因仕途蹭蹬，連歳不陞，其風水有碍。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810803758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有囙子孫不存，疑其風水相闌。","logicSentenceId":"7633451271165263907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有囙六親中父母、兄弟妻児，或自身多生災病，疑","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810820142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561926295453748"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"囙風水所致。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810820142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有囙連年官非火盗，有因風水被傷，卜其何法而修補。","logicSentenceId":"7633451271165280291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有闲問祖塋有地脉否，有问祖塋有傷損否皆以父母為用神。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810836526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦遇六冲，全無地脉，卦變化绝，勢若倒懸。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810852910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻遇㐲吟，欲遷不遂。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810869294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"反吟卦現，不遷亦遷。","logicSentenceId":"7633451271165296675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦變六冲，龍已去，子孫有凌替之危。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810885678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冲中變合，運将来，後代有興滛之象。","logicSentenceId":"7633451271165313059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正卦六冲，變卦六冲，全無脉氣，卦變化尅，如倒懸之勢，危之急矣，凶災立至。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810902062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"668","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伏呤卦，地脉全無，雖有","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810918446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561926295470132"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遷意，而不能遷。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810918446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦淂反吟，心不欲遷，而终遷矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810934830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦變六冲，有龍已去，子孫従此衰頹。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810951214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六冲變合，先無地脉，目今地運将興，後代徔此發矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810967598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母旺相，祖坟安然。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819810983982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"墓绝休囚，浚裔零落。","logicSentenceId":"7633451271165329443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳𦵏之地，父母為用，宜旺相，或日月動爻生扶，或動而化生，化日月，化比助、化進神，乃吉地也。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811000366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"児孫與發之象，亡者安而生者樂，旺而又遇帝旺長生者，來龍久逺，世代興隆，不宜墓絶空破，及動而破散，化破散，化退神，化他墓，化回頭尅，化旬空，乃凶","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811016750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561926295486516"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"象也。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811016750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亡者不安，生者寥落。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811033134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻變鬼，占者不祥。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811049518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼化六親，各屬不吉。","logicSentenceId":"7633451271165345827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻變鬼，及随墓助傷，所占之人不吉。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811065902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟妻子，動而化鬼，鬼化弟兄、父毋妻子者，查其所犯而斷也。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811082286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又有子命化鬼，𣆨命者殃，午命變鬼，馬命不利。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811098670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"686","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811115054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"687","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：古以父爻不宜旺相，父旺父動，子孫不安，予以為謬。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811131438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占舊塚，以父為用神，父母旺相，及動而","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811147822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561926295502900"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化吉，祖父安然，又扯到傷尅子孫者，是冝旺耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811147822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不宜旺耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811164206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟子孫動以化鬼，及父動化子孫，不利扵子孫者是也。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811180590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"693","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"因何事而所傷章第一百二十七","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811196974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"694","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：湏宜另占，不可以前卦兼斷，專看冲尅父母之爻為忌神。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811213358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如淂六爻安静，父母有氣，乆浚自安，不必修補。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811229742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅神臨火，或臨朱雀，禍必起扵窰竈。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811246126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘臨圡動，或無元武，㝎囙偷𦵏相傷。","logicSentenceId":"7633451271165362211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金虎囙受其驚，朱雀有蟠根之","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811262510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561926295519284"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"碍，尅神以帶螣蛇，蛇蟻為巢，𡈽鬼勾陳，挖掘動土。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811262510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元武臨水，水浸衾棺。","logicSentenceId":"7633451271165378595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅神臨火，恐近𠁅𫔭窰作竈，或囙火燭之事。","logicSentenceId":"7633451271165394979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土尅父母，兼元武者，必有偷𦵏。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811278894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨勾陳、滕蛇者，貧樯盖屋，以致相傷。","logicSentenceId":"7633451271165411363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金虎地震山搖，木乕䂨伐𣗳木，木逢龍動，穴下有竹木根傷。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811295278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火與蛇興，塚内有蟻蛇為害。","logicSentenceId":"7633451271165427747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元武水爻尅父母，穴中黒水相侵，父毋被冲，地風水浸，金尅父母，石塊山崗。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811311662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水冲尅者，低窪泉湧。","logicSentenceId":"7633451271165444131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木爻尅父，樹木相傷。","logicSentenceId":"7633451271165460515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火尅者，穴蔵蛇蟻。","logicSentenceId":"7633451271165476899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土","logicSentenceId":"7633451271165493283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561926295535668"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動者，盖造墙垣。","logicSentenceId":"7633451271165493283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母爻被日月動爻冲尅，及卦動化冲，如在艮坤之宫，卦淂亥卯未合木局尅父，必有地風冲歪棺槨。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811328046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"715","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如在離宫，卦得申子𫝕水局尅父者，穴中水湧，水泛棺歪。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811344430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如在震㢲宫金局冲尅者，山崗石塊。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811360814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如在乾兌宫，逢火同冲，尅父母者，㝎囙窰火雷驚，爻中水動，地窪水浸。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811377198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦淂木動，竹木根藤，火主䖝蛇，土囙動土，果有犯之，速宜修補。","logicSentenceId":"7633451271165509667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父無亂動，湏觀五行之有無","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811393582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561926295552052"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811393582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦若安逸，又看地支之缺䧟。","logicSentenceId":"7633451271165526051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六爻安静，並無冲尅父母之爻者，又看五行之所少也。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811409966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中無土，須寻墻垣。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811426350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦無金星，石碑，可五，六爻。","logicSentenceId":"7633451271165542435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火星缺陷，可立煙竈，或安看守墳塋之宅舎。","logicSentenceId":"7633451271165558819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水爻不現，可作池塘，及𫔭河道。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811442734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木爻不現，多栽樹木。","logicSentenceId":"7633451271165575203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𬼘言五行之所少者，非獨不上卦也。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811459118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有現扵爻，空破墓绝無氣者，亦如無也。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811475502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"731","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如未月己巳日，應世未酉亥，","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811491886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卯木巳未土財父。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561926295568436"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父兄子","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811491886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"麦水于","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811491886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卯木財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𬼘位，而卜祖塚。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811491886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子曰：目何事而卜，彼曰：當年地師。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811508270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曽許𬼘地𦵏浚，必出科甲。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811524654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"愚弟兄四人俱忝在庠，並無發者，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811541038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：塚傍必有大𣗳。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811557422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：果有，𦵏時還小，連年茂盛而長大矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811573806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：𣗳根長到棺傍，棺被損矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811590190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：何法治之？","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811606574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：湏在墳傍挖一小坑以探之。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811622958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果有根者，扵逺䖏挖一大坑，令人入之，橫挖一坑，以到墳傍，将利鏟輕輕去之，仍命道安墳則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811639342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴昆仲之發者，須令本人自占，親翁下科，","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811655726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561926295584820"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太歲在午，拱起世爻，巳火之官，管許髙發。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811655726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果依此行，卽扵午歲登科。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811672110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"752","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"修補秘法章第一百二十八","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811688494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"753","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因窰竈而傷者，命道祭火神，設火醮而安之。","logicSentenceId":"7633451271165591587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"偷𦵏及動土相傷者，命道設醮以安土神。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811704878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因受驚恐而傷者，命道設醮安墳。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811721262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㦯囙有竹木蟠根及石塊相傷者，須扵墳榜挖坑三尺以探之，輕輕去其竹木石塊，仍命道安墳則吉矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811737646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"757","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"囙蛇蟻為巢者，多栽苦練樹，其蛇蟻自散，勿信人言，以焚其巢穴，傷損性","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811754030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561926295601204"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819811754030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曾親見兩家，見蛇為巢，用火禁之後，子孫衰敗不堪。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819961126958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘穴中囙水淹没者，若有消水之䖏，設法以消之；倘囙地窪，终無消水之法，不淂不擇地而遷也。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819961143342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或囙地風吹歪棺木者，前後挖坑一二尺以探之，若果歪者，仍歸扵正向，命道安墳則𠮷。","logicSentenceId":"7586690819961159726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
